text: The game is really fun: nice mechanics, great visuals, and tons to do. I just wish the daily/weekly events/games came with more instructions. Like, you click on the info button and almost all of them say something along the lines of "participate, earn points, get rewards," which doesn't help at all. I've been playing for nearly 2 months and love this game a lot, but I really wish there was more explanation, especially with prominent events.

This was a decent game that I have been playing for a long time. Then, one day, a player decided to attack me 26 times consecutively, absurd! I get maybe 5 times, but apparently there is no limit to the number of consecutive attacks. Devs told me to move to a stronger alliance or move to a different server, or to use base shields. Well, you are limited on the number of shields and timeframe of the shield. Have to spend $ to protect yourself or to really become elite. Game is NOT for casual play.

Was a decent game until I switched phones and lost all my progress. Which included money spent in the game. Got ahold of "service," and they needed all the information, including screenshots of all my information for the account I no longer have access to. If you don't plan on switching devices anytime soon, if you don't plan on spending money, or if you don't mind starting over at square one, it's not a bad game to play.

This "game" is nothing like the ads. It's become such a drain to "play" all it wants you to do is pay to play, eventually everything takes hours or multiple days to upgrade or research, unless you use speed ups which of course cost money. The events are nothing but a way to get you to spend money and of course they aren't worth doing because the rewards aren't worth it. Your limited to only a few characters since most legendaries are locked behind the paywall. Honestly I would skip this

Not a survival game and not as advertised. Pro-tip: run from merge for as long and as hard as you can. You think it might be okay, but it is just the devs feeding literally everyone who isnt a whale to the whales. Why? I guess we aren't spending enough money anymore. Just transfer as high as you can every transfer until you can no longer do that and then play for as long as you can as a F2P. Then, do the same thing in whatever their next game is (for now, Kingshot is a STRIAGHT rip off.)

First of all, if you're expecting this game to be like the ads, it's not; it's more complicated. You have a whole gameplay of needing to protect your city and also able to join an alliance. The events do have some advertising aspects, but that's as far as it goes. Secondly, this is a pay-to-win game, going from needing to wait for your building to finish upgrading (which may take up to 30 days), to needing to pay a lot to get skins or just great heroes, but I love it

I played the add for this game and it was super fun. then downloaded the game and came across smth completely different from the ad. the ad was like where you make swords and stuff to fight a giant polar bear. fighting the polar bear gave you meat so you could upgrade stuff. but the game is nothing like the ad. it made me mad. what a waste of my time! its literally just building and upgrading. boring if I do say so myself

The game can't decide what kind of game it wants to be other than a game that wants to sell you stuff. Pops up stuff to buy every login. Every menu, every tab has something to sell you. Worst part is that it doesn't tell you that some servers are behind other servers so even if you decide you want to spend money on this, you'll end up getting characters that are 9 seasons behind but you won't know it. Doesn't respect you or your time.

After playing for a few days, I uninstalled. A great concept of a game. If you have a lot of money to spare, you will enjoy this game because its definitely pay to win. You cannot enjoy the whole concept of it because paid players can buy literally almost everything that can make you advance, and leaving free to play players at extreme disadvantage.

This game is nothing like the ads or the pictures of the game above. I wanted a nice little game where I killed cute cartoon polar bears and built a fort. Instead it's a time resource game and not cartoony at all. It might be fun if that's what you want, but it's not what was advertised and not what I wanted to play. I'm uninstalling.

Aaaaaaand it's nothing like the demo ads. It was cute for a bit but what is the point of advertising one style of game and then tricking people into playing one that's completely different? Frustrating. Your voice actors are really good and deserve their due diligence but I am so bored of games that advertise a demo and don't deliver on the actual thing.

There are free to play as well as pay 2 play players on here. It is borderline disrespectful how devs create rewards on here, especially for the pay to play players. In the beginning a little money takes you a long ways, but as you progress, you'll spend more money but you'll find out that the rewards become less. The devs specifically target those that are impulse spenders.

Doesn't differentiate itself from other idle apps/games of the same genre. The tasks/games lose their initial satisfaction after a few days. They do not become more challenging but rather just take more time or money. Like most games of this genre, they start to feel more like work after a week of playing daily. It is what it is, thus three stars. I did not spend any money on this app. The actual gameplay differs significantly from the playable ads and images on this page.

A winter themed city management game with A LOT going on. It's more time investment than I was willing to make but your mileage will vary. You won't run out of things to do, that's certain. The game is generous with boosts and premium currency and I never felt pressured to watch ads or pay money. One word of warning, the ads for this game do not represent what the game is really like. But IMO, that's ironically a good thing, because the game is more interesting than the ads make it appear.

Not at all like the advert. Very repetitive game play, fast at the beginning but after a few days everything takes for ever to upgrade/research to"encourage" payment fir speed ups. Like most of the so called free games they are full of micro transactions and adverts. I found it dull frankly there are much better prettier games out there.

Great game if your in a good state that works together like I am! Upgrading your stuff gets really expensive late game. Wish WoS did offers and deals for packs in playstore like most games do. There froststar store doesn't really get you much extra, more of a hassle then it's worth. Only get a few extra gems and it's separate from the app. Guess it's mostly for countries that don't allow the normal in game pack buying. Really fun game. Been playing for close to 2 years now and loving it!

It's an awesome game. It's almost real life, lmao, because everybody is playing live and communicating, etc. There are different people from literally all over the world so the time zones might be difficult but it still works once you've joined an alliance and there are people in your zone that's available to help with hunting etc. u can still lvl up without spending money, but it takes a while. very addictive and cx support is always available. 10/10!!!! 3 mths in, and I haven't missed a day.

I am addicted to this game. I saw an ad, and it had interested me enough to download WOS (Whiteout Survival). The ad was different than the actual game, but the game is obviously more fun than the ad! I love being in an alliance and being able to chat with the people in the world chat. Their discord is also helpful. A lot of people answered my questions when I had just started playing. Also, this game has NO ADS. I am completely in love. Keep up the amazing work WOS creators and support team!

OBSESSED! This game is so great, no words can express it. However, I do have some suggestions/slight complaints. The adverts. I'm sure we all came from them, but the game isn't actually like that. The game is great as is, it doesn't need any of them. The town itself. After so long, you get so good at the game that everything is upgraded, and you no longer have any input as a leader. The states. I wanted to play with someone, but they joined another state. Could there be a way to move? Thank you!

Listen, if you like to play or have played CoC , please play this game. The mechanic is almost the same, the difference is that you cant move or decorate your area , its not like the ads at all i can promise you , i downloaded it cuz of the ads just to kill time , but what do you know? its been a week now and im STILL playing it , NOT TO MENTION THERES VOICE ACTING??? perfect 5/5 rating

This game is microtransaction, pay-to-win hell. You can buy levels (speedups), power (military speedups), resources (diamonds) for money. Think it's a fair game? Wait until someone with $10k/mo disposable income attacks you. The pay-to-win is so bad that the top alliances REQUIRE you to spend a minimum amount to maintain membership. This is not a game of skill or time investment, it's a game of how big your wallet is and the only winner is the company collecting the money.

Endless game that you will never finish. It's a book without end, countless daily and weekly and monthly quests. This game is almost as demanding as a infant child. You will always be behind and just not able to make it if you play for free don't believe me download and try. You will never get time back once it passes.

Smooth gameplay.I like the features I like the detail I mean for what it's made.It's pretty decent game both character and team and I didn't receive my rewards for level 5 and 7 of completing the furnace, I'm almost on level 13 on completing the furnace, and it still hasn't gave me 5 and 8, so if y'all could please fix that error?\nAnd I'll take a screenshot

Not bad! I don't normally play mobile games but this one is really fun and pretty addicting. the only issue I have is the scaling as you progress could be a little more balanced. Other than that though, there's almost always something to do and the game doesn't try to force you to spend money

After playing for some time I notice that this game is really is for the rich and if you an average person just earning enough everyday, this will make you broke hahaha. Don't fall for it guys. Especially their event where you open a box. 1 with gold, 1 with silver and there is this kind a curse box, but everything is just a scam. Don't believe you will get anything from any of it. Just play the game, don't spending anything and you will still enjoy it. That's all. Have a good day, everyone.

it's a p2w 😂. it's absurd how there's no discount on the money to be spent.. events are rewarding but prices are not compensating, also the server age concept is well built. but it's crazzy the amt of money to be spent to stay relevant and grow in this game.. 3 heroes for max for 15-20k dollars is crazzy.😂😅

I appreciate the updates but it would be nice if the people didn't complain so much, considering I spend thousands upon thousands of materials to upgrade everything. My cookhouse is past level 5 and upgrading right now and the hunger bar is still extremely low and it doesn't make any sense

The game is really fun, but the PC version is quite laggy and crashes frequently. I know it’s not an issue with my computer because all of my friends experience the same problems. I hope the developers can improve the PC version because this is genuinely a fun game. Sometimes, I don’t want to stay on my phone for hours, especially during long events like Castle Battle. I would much rather play on PC during these events, so I really hope the performance and stability issues can be fixed.

This game is terrible, and the customer support is awful. Messages often fail to send in both public and private chat, yet the game keeps saying I’ve sent too many messages even when I haven’t sent any. I only discovered this by accident. The game is full of bugs, overpriced, extremely slow, and requires months of grinding to make meaningful progress. They have no problem taking your money, but when you report an issue, they don’t refund you or do anything to resolve the problem. they block me

this is a fun game and I have been playing for the past 3 seasons I have encountered all kinds of players and have been to several states I have been with some alliances that were good and some that were not so good but the players are what make it such a great game so I totally recommend this game if you want to play with other's and can get along with other groups from around the world. Just remember that everyone has a different experience with the game so enjoy your game.

It's convoluted and hard to figure out. I played for a few hours, but still couldn't grasp all the different aspects of game play. I'm not going to the tutorial; if I can't figure out the game just by playing it, then it's a big nope for me. All of these menus and tasks; nothing self-explanatory. And, Im not dumb, it doesn't take me long to figure out a game, but this one, pleh. I gave 2☆ for the artwork and lack of adds.

I'm the beginning, it's an interesting city builder / upgrades RPG. But as the tutorial ends and you unlock the rest of the features, it immediately becomes a cash grab game. Sure you can play free if you wish, but you will be severely limited as you progress. There are options to spend real life money on every single screen! Want to do literally more than 1 thing at a time? $$$ Want to survive player attacks? $$$ Want to have any sense of good upgrades without spending weeks grinding? $$$

Whiteout Survival is one of the best strategy games I've played. Great events, active alliances, and plenty to do. I'd highly recommend it and rate it 100%. One improvement would be better Intel Lighthouse rewards, including more Hero Gear materials, Hero Shards, Chief Gear materials, and larger Gem rewards like 1,000 Gems. It would also be great if free-to-play and low-spending players received weekly or monthly freebie packs, skins, or rewards for their loyalty.

edit: I wish so much that I had read other reviews before downloading. I knew better because these games are never as advertised OG review: This game is completely different than advertised. Both in ads and even in the "screenshots" on the app page. Gameplay is nothing like what is shown. I wanted to get it based on ads and the game does not play at all like the ad. The screenshot are from the ad gameplay but not the actual game. I took screenshots but I can't post them with my review

Heavily pay to win. Not like the ads at all. not worth your time. update: The response to this review was that there weren't many ads in the game. while this is technically true you are barraged with all sorts of options to pay for bonuses and gear and characters. if you are free to play, expect to not enjoy this. Requires significant daily purchases to stay relevant. You cannot progress at the level that those dump money into can.

It's not at all what is shown in the advertisement of the app. It is a (addictive) real time strategy game requiring a lot of attention. While there are some side quests, I never stumbled across the advertised mini-game. I don't like to get hooked by a mini-game add, that either doesn't exist at all or only makes up the tiniest possible fraction of the game.

Fun game to play, well designed and has some great features. Only issue is, and it's a HUGE one, unless you want to sink thousands of pounds and I do literally mean thousands you will never be able to compete, simple as that. There should be separate servers for pay to win players and free to pay players so the development is based on grinding and gameplay efforts rather than just spending money. May as well just try to invest in the developer etc rather than waste your money on here.

This game is nothing like the ads about it. And the sheer amount of purchases that they ask you to do! Every couple seconds they ask you to buy some packs, chests, heroes, etc. everything had to be bought. I'm buying nothing and deleting this game for good. upd: i played for half a year and didn't get to see any "parts" of the game that were in the ads. your ads are misleading and irrelevant to the game. Absolute garbage.

I've only been playing a few months, but so far I really enjoy the game. No, the ads aren't exactly like the game play, BUT the playable ads ARE part of the game. I'm mostly F2P and have been able to work through many challenges F2P folks face. With the help of a solid alliance, I've been able to get to almost F30 in two different states. To me, the alliance is the best part if you're in an active, chatty one. One issue. I can't EVER seem to get my avatar to update!

Just another one of those 'misleading advertisements' and impossible to win without paying games. Even the pictures in the app page are completely fake. Not sure why there are so many good reviews, since the game is made for extremely fast progress to get you hooked, but then it's slower and slower to the point where you need to wait for more than a month (unless you're paying of course, then you can do anything instantly) to do anything. I cannot recommend this game at all, just a cash grab.

The game is a money pit, either spend $1000s or lose. The developers push too many events at the same time, causing the game to require hours. They will literally add new events to the old routine, as if you have time for that. Event times are not made for people in the US, battle times at 6-8 am. Rewards never update, meaning you get junk that isn't even relevant to the level you're on. Just don't bother.

Whiteout Survival is a really fun and addictive game to play. The strategy, city building, and alliance battles make the game enjoyable, especially when playing with active teammates. The graphics and events are also well designed which keeps the game interesting every day. However, one thing I noticed is that leveling up and becoming stronger starts to cost a lot over time. Upgrading heroes, buildings, and research takes huge amounts of resources and sometimes spending money.

This was not advertised as a war game, but survival against elements and animals. It is a fun game with a lot of mini games and challenges, except for the war part. If you don't spend real $, you will never advance. 24/7 shields cost way too much. This game would be much more enjoyable if you limited attacks to only during BIA event, or only to castles that are outside of their own alliance territory. I've seen too many quit already, and our state is becoming a dead one fast.

if you plan to play this game, better buy a car, it will take you much further than the progress you'll get in the game for the same amount of money. is just a ripoff, not to mention false advertised... I've spent over 7.000 € in just two months just to get a mediocre progress, it's always a developer account hidden among players just to push you to spend more money to keep up with his "absolute power". money, money, money... no more from me! avoid the game unless you're filthy rich!

Like other reviews, this isn't like what is shown in the ads. I've been playing for months and Furnace level is 22. Tired of the responses stating "keep playing to experience everything". What a load. Seems like false advertising if many people are complaining of the same thing and you DON'T tell them a path to play the game shown in your ad. Goodbye game.

it was fun at first. the game use to calm my anxiety, but the more I played the more anxiety I ended up having. I had never purchased anything within the game, but saw I had two charges. I've played plenty of games where I've made purchases, and it was never accidently or unknown to me. I have never had just a hard experience deleting a game account. The process to do so seemed beyond excessive.

This game is nothing like the ad. It's identical to about 20 other better ones. If you're looking for something like the ad, this isn't it. Edit: I have now put many hours into your game. It conta8ns nothing from any of your ads. People will quickly figure out you're misrepresenting your game once they download it. I'm just letting everyone know in advance so they don't waste their time. Put out the games in the ads for people to play. At least that would be honest and also much more fun.

It's a pay to win game. any player you see in the leaderboard or anything or any events are top spenders free to play players can never be in the leaderboard by skill. and please remove "original" from the description . it's a rip off of Frostpunk game

1st up - it's nothing like the ads. Once you get over that, you'll realise this game is actually great. The first few days are getting to grips with building your city but once you get past that (it's a bit boring) there is so much more to keep you playing. I'm F2P and haven't needed to spend to get far in the game, but being in a strong active alliance helps. So many mini games and events, and reoccurring games helps maintain interest. It's a great long haul game with a fab community.

The game actually started really well. There is a lot to do, and everything feels fresh and new at first. However, after around level 9-10, the progress becomes extremely slow. During upgrades, there isn’t much to do in the game. I understand that games often encourage players to pay to speed up upgrades, but even with that, the gameplay feels quite repetitive and boring at times. the way the game is designed doesn’t really encourage to do much its just game of push button and wait until next da

If only the ads weren't so fake... "the ads show only a tiny portion of the game",get the the hell out of here with this BS lie! I've been playing this game for 3 years and there's absolutely nothing that has any connection to these ads. Every game uses the same ad template and simply changes the theme to somewhat resemble the game. I will report you for fake advertising just because you had the balls to lie so blatantly about it.

Highly social based. Each state (server) will be a different experience. some people just fight. some work together. it's great that it has a ton of translation options but the translator is still not exact. made lots of friends. this is not a solo game. ads are complete lies. still worth it.
This game is Pay-to-win type, if you offline for too long it would hard to catch up. There's a big gap beetween who is paying and not in this game... Overall this game is pretty fun to me..

I, too, like others have said, was hooked on the ad game. That version was addicting, which made me download it. Only to boot it up and realise it's just another management game. No one has the patience to wait for resources to be built. Not only is it false advertising, but it looks like the major consensus here is that people enjoyed the marketed version of the game that provides immediate rewards. Might I suggest you create a proper game that aligns more with the ads instead?

Played for over a year, spent probably $200+ for advancement. Went to spend gems for stamina one day (as I had done many times before), and the gems went away, bit the stamina wasn't received. Contacted game support, and got the run around. Multiple communications and still have not received gems back or stamina. I can see the logs of when and where I spent the gems, but they can't? Huh... Game play okay. Better out there. Kind of cartoony, which is cute. But don't bother.

A typical pay to win game. If you don't want to pay anything, see you sometime next year when you will finally be level 20 or so (the times for uppgrading are ridiculous to make you want to spend money). Do I have fun? Sure, just because I've found a nice Alliance. Otherwise, I would be so gone. I honestly hate SVS stuff. Just want to build and upgrade.

The game is ok at the start. But it quickly becomes a pay to play game. After about level 20 furnace, unless you send serious cash you can't compete in any content. It becomes the playground of the rich at the expense of the regular players. Also, your purchases don't count for the game. Just for one character on one kingdom - yet the ad doesn't say that and customer service refused to fix or refund. In brief, this is a lower quality x4 game that I cannot recommend unless you spend big money.

1 star, the game is not like the ad. the ad was running around collecting resources, standing in a tile, unlocking towers and walls to a fort etc. the actual game is upgrading buildings real-time, troops, joining an alliance, etc. the ad gameplay is nowhere in the actual game? not only do i feel tricked by the false ad, but now 99.9% of my youtube ads are for mobile games! stop letting AI do the work and thinking? uninstalling but the algorithm damage is done of course. THANKS for nothin!

Game itself is just like most other survival games out there tbh with a different gui. way to many options & things to learn from the get go, Not enough explaining on the hero's ( you upgrade the hero's but nothing seems to happen.) The game play itself is okay, but just seems a little over stimulating. lastly theres a bug where you come back to the game, it pops up an option to buy coins for the game and then it freezes. exit the game and restart.

The game has good character and interface design, which attracted me at first. I downloaded it after seeing an ad showing a fun gameplay segment. However, after 8 months, I still haven’t reached that part. The gameplay is just repetitive button tapping with no tactics, strategy, or thinking involved. It feels like a waste of time. I didn’t get what I downloaded the game for, so I’m deleting it. This is honest feedback, not an attempt to offend.

Within an hour reached maximum build ability where you have to start purchasing. Entire game so far is about building. The Explore version is literally going toe to toe with the enemy and you have zero control over your heroes. Boring, and absolutely NOTHING like the Ads. Uninstalling. So sick of the fake Ads showing something completely different to the actual game.

The constant pop ups prompting me to buy in game currency keep freezing my game. Also the ads are not representative of actual gameplay. I've been playing for days and have never seen the play that was in the ad that brought me here. at this point I don't care if it's in here somewhere -- don't advertise it as the game if it's a tiny fraction of play.

Not as Advertised after 8 hours and $20. The replying focuses on how you have to keep playing but its a money grab. Even the pictures and the ad shown about the wood and the parking vs money is fake. its just another knock off "Last War" game. Nothing but building a city just like every other game until you have to wait 10 hours for upgrades or pay even more. I Wish these copies of games would get banned.

Deceptive Ads... again. The only thing that's the same as the ad is... it's winter. Other than that, it's another game that devolves into a PvP game where you "have to" spend money constantly to even compete. Another PvP game where it's a race to dominance and the only way to win is to buy more than your opponents. Sad they can keep getting away with deceptive Ads.

No ads in game is good, but the repeat half the other reviews here - the ads/screenshots for this promote a completely different game. The devs are spamming a default reply saying 'the ads represent a small part of the game' but that's a LIE, they represent no part of the game AT ALL. I can't play this without feeling cheated out of what I actually signed up for. It's another clash of clan style game with initial fast progression that soon becomes a slog of 'press upgrade, wait a day, repeat'

I down loaded the game to play the advertised 'catch fish & expand food' as the ad showed, but spent the majority building a township. That was not what I wanted to play, I'll wait for a response and information of how to get to that fishing section, but so far the game is not something I want. I took advice below and played for 3 more days building and upgrading the township but still haven't encountered the game preview section advertised for the game. it's disappointing 😓 Same as king shot

False advertising. Nothing like the playable ads. I've checked reviews and nearly all of the reviews that mention how the playable ads are misleading have a reply from the developer saying that the ads are only a small portion of the gameplay and and keep playing to experience more...blah, blah, blah. That's a lie. This game has no gameplay like the playable ads. Class action lawsuit worthy if you ask me. Uninstalled!

If you're lucky to land on a good server with a friendly environment and not one with toxic people that don't treat you as a cast system. The game itself is ok. Like all these styles of games, the more money you throw at it, is the name of the game. The constant effort to weed out the game lizards coming after you for frost stars is another downfall and turnoff. Lowering the cost of the packages with a tad more items could bring more incentives.

Whiteout Survival is an excellent game! The graphics are solid, the gameplay is engaging, and the challenges keep you hooked for hours. It’s clear the developers put a lot of effort into making it fun and immersive. My only downsides are that it consumes quite a bit of battery power and there could be more free rewards for players, but honestly, these are minor issues compared to how enjoyable the game is. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a thrilling survival experience!

another game that's nothing like the add for it. very misleading. Apparently the default reply is that the add shows a small part of the game. I'd like to know what part or it, because I played for quite some time and haven't made it to the part in the add yet. again very misleading and would not recommend if you're looking for a game anything like that did for it.

I personally cannot recommend this game to play. When you were attacked by other villages after the attack is done it's supposed to teleport you somewhere else so you won't be attacked again. Instead you get attacked in the middle of the night and you get attacked 20 times over. there is no feature for a shield to automatically go up when you get attacked. I shouldn't have to wait 2 weeks to get all of my troops back this is just ridiculous.

The development has the audacity telling you to keep playing to experience it, you need money to build or play anything. No directions of any gameplay. Very vague and bleak. They definitely need to explain gameplay, most ppl quit & are frustrated. I don't recommend playing this game unless you like to be fooled. They don't care about you, just money you put. Not much opportunity either, I play blind mostly. I am done growing and no have to wait for the game to release the rest in order grow more

The game is heavily pay to win, flooded with micro transaction. The devs just killed the game by flooding with more and more and more pay to win with every update. Highly recommend you staying away from this game.

Been playing for over 4 months now. You get banned for doing refunds. How they do this is by hard locking you out of all primary functions till you buy a pack that gives useless items for the same value as the item you refunded if you don't buy it back within a few days. The live demo game you play is mostly events and most if not all the events need you to pay over 1000$ to get max rewards. Every week has an event. And the ads are all structured in a gambling addiction way to get you to buy

Be careful.... If you struggle with gambling and/or have a very competitive nature i strongly advise against downloading this game. You can easily spend thousands to get ahead, but if you stop everyone else catches up. This game has no finish line & many feel trapped because of the huge amount of money they have invested into. They don't make it easy to delete your account either, there's a 15 day cooling off period.

I enjoy the game and have made a few friends. however the game is very money driven, you can play for free- but the game of course puts you in a spot to need to spend money to get anywhere. customer support is terrible.. watch out and document your purchases.They will go "missing" And they will tell you, you used it. so document your purchases and watch your items. the dont help with in game harassment and bullying.

Another typical whale v whale international game. The mechanics are a lot like other similar games, as the zombie themed SoS one.The ad that got me to download was a self play type of collect/survival game. That lasted maybe a few levels, only 2 unveil as a massive pay2play or be weak and die game. In order to actually have a chance at not being food for other players, one would have to spend Thousands USD /month. The game currently has server mergers & moves going on, so it will die soon.

They are using videos and pictures that have nothing to do with Whiteout Survival to get you to download Whiteout Survival. If someone is lying to you from the very beginning, stay away! Reaponse to tcomment: I do play the game, qmd it's a lie, I never saw some minigame like what they show in the ads, and also if there were some minigame like that, it's still a lie, as the real game is a city and army building MMO, like many other mobile games, and they are pass it off as something else.

hi, me again, nothing like the advert, this gives me trust issues. Ben says it's a rip off of frostpunk, but idk, it wasn't like the advert, I lost loads of meet that I collected, I paused the brain training game to get all that meat cash, and now all I have it this game which doesn't have my meat. please let me know if you update the game to be more like the spinning axe game with the meat. thnks

Wow, after all these years of playing games like Evony, I have finally found a game, which is beautiful. Nothing like the ads for it are. Edit: The add portion does comprise a very small portion of the game. It's there, but not as much as the ads would make you think.

i am updating my review. i am VERY disappointed with the support chat. the response is very slow and take a long of time. keep back and forth and the conclusion still bacm to zero like you cant understand the issue i am saying. you keep making everything difficult for me. i lost the interest to play anymore because of that

good but it's NOTHING like the ads which I ACTUALLY want to play the game in the ad, I tried out the ad but I just downloaded it so it will save instead because I liked it. but it's NOTHING like NOTHING like the game shown in the ads.
easy to play... I meet a lot of new people 😊 now they're like close friends too me 💜💜💜
Don't play this game. They're not allowing change of linked email.

absolutely nothing like the preview, played for about an hour and didn't see or do anything that was actually advertised. if it wasn't for the snow I'd think I'd downloaded the wrong app. I hate games like this they advertise one thing and produce something completely different. if there was an option to give zero or minus stars I would have as I cannot rate the game I thought I was downloading

I enjoy the game more since our alliance changed states...twice. The new state is more about cooperative effort and less about bullying. Although money is still king, I've been able to grow in the new environment, making the game challenging, but not impossible.

Complete pay to play game, which kind of stinks because I liked it at first. But its similar to Evony or Mafia City if you ever played that. Multiple offers everyday to turn your real money into fake money (at a discount!). You get to a point where you have to spend real money or you just don't get anywhere. Also its nothing like the adds at all. All the mini-games are just more money grabs. Everything just gets so repetitive.
Been playing for almost a year, and Its like going to the casino, graphics, and effects are great, but it only continues to be fun if you constantly spend ALOT of money to grow.
Before the update, you can continuously lay road path, walls, etc. Now, it's no longer working. Now, you have to purchase and place each thing one by one. It's a hassle.

The game demo is a lie, but this is still addicting. 😆 It's definitely another pay to play if you want to get serious. Money isn't strictly necessary, but you'll need to spend if you want to keep up with the Joneses.

They need a setting to disable broadcasts notifications!!! They get very annoying when people are spamming them!!! Also, if a image has resolution too high it is blurry. If it's edited it's blurry and pixelled.

Warning: this game will drain your wallet and drive you crazy I'm not kidding it's like the devs have a personal vendetta against your bank account You'll be constantly attacked and no matter how hard you work to build up your troops it's all for nothing Trust me I've been there I reached FC10 and still couldn't catch a break Don't make the same mistake I did save your sanity (and your money) and stay far far away from this game

no ads, so that's always a plus. it passes the time. there's weekly events to score extras, alliances to join to do events to gain more extras. I never spend $ and have been able to do a lot, but upgrading buildings is a bit much. 5 days to upgrade? FORTY days to upgrade at a certain point - which you can't upgrade other resource buildings until that forty day upgrade is done? yes there are free extras such as speeding up the process, but the time for upgrades is a bit much.

I want to play the game in the ads, not whatever this is. Devs please give us the option to play that without all this other stuff. Update: If the ads only show a tiny bit of what is in the game, then you should change your ads and stop misleading people.

an over complicated game that uses bait advertising not reflecting the game itself. my kids had been playing it, but the last straw now is the sudden deletion of all data - even if you do play it, losing however long of progress is BS.

this game is NOTHING like what it was advertised to me as an idle tycoon game. I really don't appreciate the dishonesty with how the game is being advertised vs. the actual gameplay. it's almost like what if infinite lagrange's TERRIBLE balancing meets CoC's toxicity and pay-to-win stuff, but on steroids–yet another time and money wasting game that forces you to socialize with insanely toxic online weirdos. the lying devs don't give a damn about balance cus they suck. stay away from this game
Nothing like the ads, but fun. Get to play with people around the globe and use strategy to win events. Does usually require a decent amount of time, so not a passive 1 player game.

Nothing like what you play in the advertisements. in the ads, you are moving a character around, but when you actually get the game it is a town building game that has way too much going on. The game tries to get you hooked with rapid progress initially, but slows down significantly after a short period of time which leads you to be very tempted to pay to accelerate your progress. I personally hate games like this and deleted the same day I downloaded it. I don't appreciate the bait and switch

I have played this game for a long time, I have spent about a thousand hours here. I have managed multiple characters and multiple alliances.But I got nothing but disappointment. It's a pay to win game.It was a great experience, but it was impossible to survive without spending and getting stronger. I was insulted by the players of this game and later stopped playing it.My community was very strong and later I also encouraged them to quit this game. Many of them did.

misleading ads. its just a boring strategy game that you need to pay to play if you want to get anywhere. if you dont pay youre essentially forced out after the furnace reaches level 20 because you'll be forced into an alliance against your will and the non attack pacts the top alliances form basically force it into a farm simulator. not worth the time or effort.

Literally is not the game from the ads. I don't know if that's some minigame you unlock later, but I am so tired of these silly-goose marketing strategies. What it is isn't awful. You build buildings and expand your base, but if I can't play the thing you advertised after like 40 mins in game - something ain't right.

Another game where the demo is more fun than the actual game. I enjoyed playing the demos anytime they popped up in an ad, but once I downloaded the actual game, I got bored a couple minutes in as it was nothing like the demo and ended up deleting it minutes later. I'll just play the demo if it pops up again lol

Lol it is a good game but the main part of the game is NOT like the adds. It's an online pvp game where you build your town and army to be able to dominate in alliance events and server vs server eventually. The mini games that look similar to the add is minimal and caps out pretty quickly. IF you land in a good active and cooperative server it can be pretty enjoyable, I didn't 😅. That is a community hiccup though, the developers did a great job with the actual game

I wanted the game I played in the ad not the one I was given. the game is nothing like the game you play in the advertisement. its not a terrible game, although after playing a little while upgrades start taking days not secs, mins or hrs so progress is slow and its not a hero style game its a top down township strategy game where you are building a town you cant customize, you are really just upgrading a pre-built town, and crafting troops to sent on missions you dont take part in.

Nothing like the videos or pictures, none of it is actually in the game. This is a base building game and not resource management. There is no zoo, no roads or trucks to transport lumber, no road expansion, no stacking items on your back as you collect them. It's just another base building game and there are much better base building games than this. I'm not impressed by the game or the time I wasted on it by giving it a chance to have something in it later on in the game play.

ehhhhhhh.. played it for a bit.. its another one of those PvP "vikings war of clans" type game where you send out troops on an open map.. and honestly unless u spend actual money, the game becomes unplayable after a week cuz everything takes 2 years to upgrade and half the map can rip you to shreds if u remove your shield. coulda been a nice settlement building game with fun mechanics, but no.. shame..

Be ready with your credit card because this game does not play to win it's pay to win, you pay you get stronger otherwise it will take you forever to upgrade all things also there are two heroes that need to totally pay to get , also upgraded otherwise the gameplay is so good great events

Saw an ad for this and decided to try it out. Loved it...at first. It's cute, neat little story, fun to explore and build and then you get attacked by other players for your resources. Not fun. It's always super high levels attacking the lower levels taking all their resources, some of which are harder to get so you save up just to have it taken. No thanks.

Game froze three separate times before I could finish the tutorial. Had to force close the app and re-open just to progress, after each freeze. Didn't even make it 5 minutes into the game. Absolute trash. Devs should be ashamed. Edit: As someone else mentioned, the demo is COMPLETELY different from the gameplay. Even the characters are different. False advertising is a huge red flag.

A very good game if you're a whale spending money like it's going out of fashion, as a free to play player, it is a very good game. Lot's of stuff to do, decent rewards (if you spend), they need to find a balance, pay, you get everything, play and go the long way, time consuming, a lot of effort, well the rewards need to be better. Stop with the 1 minute speed up's, took me 20 mins and a lot of stamina to get that, pathetic! Anyhow, good game, very addictive 😂😔😈😜🖕

I genuinely did enjoy this game and it's still good. But all the options to purchase something really throw me off. Like there's someone to purchase on everything you open. And yes it's optional like you really don't have to. But it's just a waste of space. And not very pleasing to the eye. There's like five categories for each purchase. Maybe more. And then in each category there's like more than ten types of things for the same thing just different price and you get more. It's too much.

Fun to play, a lot of exploring and great story. Characters are balanced, and the development tree is well thought. However, to finish most events you have to pay (there's always a last thing to do which is buy this and buy that and without it you won't complete it). And there's a ton of players that you can't compete against unless you play from your wallet. Would rate it higher, but these aspects kind of ruin it.

The game is complete garbage compared to what was shown in the ad. In the ad, it looked like a fun bear-hunting adventure, but in reality, it's just a basic strategy game where at first you're allowed to build everything quickly. You can gather resources, you have lots of workers. But as soon as you start to develop and actually play, after like 15 or 30 minutes, they start limiting everything and basically say: PAY, PEASANT!

I'm not generally a fan of tactical base management games, partially because I'm not a fan of management, but they also tend towards the "free-to-wait" model. I'm happy to say that whilst this explores some trappings of waiting for gameplay, there are enough extra minigames, management puzzles and the like to busy oneself, as well as "speed up" tokens. It's good for what it is, but after a few weeks it too became more "waiting" than "playing". Even the best of the leeches is still a parasite...

Game runs in portrait mode and crashes every third cut scene. Even if it were playable in wide screen and didn't freeze up (lol) every few minutes, the gameplay is pretty boring, it's basically just tapping through an upgrade tree. There's virtually no problem solving or even decision making. It's sort of a spiritual successor to Progress Quest. The art and sound are really nice and polished, the look and feel of the game is alright besides the crashing and weird portrait mode issues.

This game is false advertising. I loved the ability to move my character on my own and collect resources, and put them where I wanted. It also freezes heavily, and I couldn't even get past the first scene. It's all online, and it's frustrating. Un-installed, and if I could give this game zero stars, I would! Also, the responses to the reviews are automated, and they don't help with anything at all!

Played it for a while because I was curious after seeing the ads (spoiler alert, not really like the ads at all). It's a generic kingdom Sim with alliances and ranked matches, similar to cookie run, minus the likable characters. I'm giving it 2 starts because I found out when I tried to delete my account, you just can't. They have a "process" to delete it, but it doesn't work. Since others who've played it have long since complained about it, I'm guessing it's intentional to be scummy. 🙃

For what the game is. It was fine, for the hour or so that I played it. UI had no major issues, except it seemed a little cramped and crowded. However, the ads showed a different experience, which I gave some time for it to come up in gameplay. Edit: it's funny they respond this way because it's a cop out. They know what the ads show. Developer response: Dear Chief, if you have any feedback regarding our ads on other platforms, please provide the ad link to our customer support for verification

The ad is a lie, and that right off the bat upsets me. It's a typical cookie cutter, whale catering, package buying, v.i.p upping, multi player conqueror game. The nice thing is the cute art style and semi plot involved. What bothers me is that nothing you see in the ads is anything like the game play. On top of that, it's a "if you spend nothing, you're left behind" game.

Like many games, this one is nothing like the ad. It also heavily favors players who are willing to spend $$ in the game. It is very much like so many other games that are available, with just a few visual changes. I had hoped that, if I spent enough time playing, it would become more interesting. It didn't. Upgrading structures and such takes more and more time as you advance in the game, all the while, you're bombarded by ads suggesting you spend money to speed things along. Thumbs down.

I played this game for nearly a year now, and here is my advice for anyone considering downloading it: don't. First, the ads are misleading. What you see in the ads is not what you get in the game. Second, it is completely pay-to-win. The game forces you to spend money to gain bonuses and heroes. Third, the combat system is boring and lacks variety in heroes unless you pay. For the good side, alliance and events are decent but at the end, i won't recommend game. Hope this will help bye

I liked the playable ad, so downloaded the game. Wow, couldn't be more disappointed! Actual game play is nothing like the ad. It's a lot like a game I wasted years playing, Game of Thrones Conquest. It's all about upgrading buildings which gets harder and harder, eventually impossible. You start with a peace shield but when it runs out you will get attacked and lose your resources. I didn't wait that long before uninstalling. Not a game you can play without spending actual money.

Another bait n switch Pay To Win, like Final Fantasy XV: A New Empire or Ever Legion, with the worst of both games. Except that both of those games were addicting, this one not so much. The game starts out story-driven but the story quickly fades. There are a couple of features that are interesting. Not as pricey (yet) as the others, but the ads represent an entirely different game that doesn't exist.

Nothing like the ads. Some games deliver on what they show in the ads you see, and others are a blatant lie. This is not an isometric survival game, this is primarily a series of timers attatched to upgrading buildings. It gets 2 stars for having an aesthetic, and sticking to it. Otherwise, this is a standard idle game, doing it's best to convince you it isn't an idle game.

Game is fun, enjoy a lot about it. But sadly like other games similar to this its simply impossible to compete with people spending a lot of money on the game. Playing several hours a day and getting to lv18 after a week and then seeing several others on the server are already at max level (30) is just depressing. Upgrade times on buildings take a really long time for the amount of levels there are on them, and training units is no better. Tldr: fun for a bit, more fun if you pay.

The game started out as a lot of fun. I enjoyed the building aspects, exploring, and researching. The hero characters were interesting and had fun animations. As I progressed, the game became much less fun. I was simply farmed over and over be players 40 to 50 levels higher who could bring 10 times the number of troops I could muster. The plundered resources slowed down any advancement I could make. I also never saw the mini games advertised in other games.
Easy-to-use, Fun and Interactive. Solo or Alliance Your own game play. Daily gifts, prizes, events and everyone's favorite wars. No need to pay to play, You can if You want. Come Join the Fun

Nothing like the ads (as usual with mobile games these days.) Also this is a "pay to win" game and is not friendly to players that don't want to spend money. After a certain amount of progression, the game shifts in a way that encourages you to spend. For example; upgrades take longer, resources are harder to get, and exploring gets tougher, players can attack your base. If you don't mind spending, this might be the game for you. If you're a f2p player then this game isn't good.

If you found this game without it being an ad somewhere in another game then you're probably getting exactly what you want. If you played this based off what you saw in an ad where you run around and set up different systems then this game is completely fake. Another classic ad that does literally nothing to showcase the game, just wanting to get a download without caring about retention.

I downloaded the app because of the ads being fun, but there's none of that "run your little guy around and do some chores" energy that the ads have. It's just standard farming and upgrading buildings and waiting in real-time for your wares to restock, just like any Facebook farming game from the early 2010s. If you're into that sort of thing, it's fine, but I'm not, I find that sort of thing boring, so I'd not recommend it personally.

This game absolutely squeaks with how tightly it holds onto rewards. New heroes are not awarded, you have to collect shards then assemble them into a hero unit. I've played for a solid 3 - 4 hours, and I've just gotten my fourth hero to deploy in battles. The theme is novel, but maybe a bit clumsy. It feels like games like this are designed on some sort of kit, with a theme applied over the top, and I'm pretty sure this one is middling at best.

The game play is okay but doesn't match advertisement. It's easier to recreate what's already made, and this is just a knockoff game. And like those other games, you'll run into the same issue where the map is ruled by a single clan with pay to win players. Developers need some originality to solve this issue. I'm deleting immediately, not worth the time to create character.

The game is vastly different from the ads. At its best is an engaging war game with a nice social component. Its easy to play with others. Fun for a few days, but then it becomes abhorrently clear the predatory system they have built. Game is the most blatant definition of pay to win. And the devs favor people who spend insane amounts of money. They can harass you and abuse the game to stalk you, but as long as they are paying, devs won't do anything. Honestly, don't waste your time or money.

Don't fall for ads. Had a interactive ad appear for this game, caught myself playing the ad and somewhat enjoying it so I downloaded it. The game is nowhere near the ad. Tried playing for a few minutes. It's so damn boring, just another afk game wasting space on your phone. Some people may like it. My 1 star is because these companies need to stop the misleading ads. Will not be changing my review.

Boring Not like ads at all. The playable ads are fun and make this game look interesting. When yoy download it, yoy get a sort of world building game that takes forever to get anything done. There are little to no instructions for any of the "events" so I had no idea what I was supposed to do. Maybe it would be better if you paid for the ingame upgrades. After a couple of weeks I deleted it. It's not even a good time waster. The graphics are ok for a game like this.

The game has everything you could want, it's fun, you can put as much time in as you want, good people. Then the fun ends. Initially it's a fair balanced game, a few purchases here and there to get you places quicker, but the more you advance, the more it'll cost, but youve invested so much time that you wont want to quit. Within 3 months, you could very easily go from spending £5 a week to £50 a day on this game in order to keep up with progression and it's never enough. An addictive money pit

Too aggressive in shoving paid options down the throats of all players. Was a lot of fun, with seemingly optional paid content, for the first several months of a new server. Interesting-ish story, good mechanics, and an overall fun up-front experience. But, at the end of day, it's a pay-2-win game. I am ashamed; why couldn't I spend thousands of dollars on a company in my home country rather than for some individuals on the other side of the planet?

Too pay to win. While there are a lot of things to do, you will never win against someone with a large wallet in this game. Granted you can slowly advance for free, to be the best you have to pay, in every event as well. I have played for a while and every new thing, comes with a heavy price tag. It's just not fun anymore. New buildings for your island are all pay items lately. Placing well on holiday events? People can pay to get event items to be on top. There is no skill to the game.

It's a muddy mess of a game that is purposefully built that way... so you feel like a micro transaction will get you over "this" hurdle. The thing to remember is that there's always five more to frustrate you on the other side of that one. They're just trying to cast a big net in order to get as many people as possible. They need better testers that can actually communicate. What feels fulfilling? What feels overly intrusive? They have no actual testers or QC right now.

Another Pay-to-Win War Game. The ads are based on the story, not actual gameplay. The pictures in this Google page are not of anything in-game. It's VERY pay-to-win. Cash spenders rank up super fast, and once you get top on the leaderboards, it keeps rewarding you even more. If you are playing for free, it is impossible to keep up and be able to defend against the PTW people. If you have cash, you can do what you want. I've spent over $100 and am still lacking. Likely un-installing

Despite the misleading ad that makes it look like an "idle" game, this is closer to an RPG. A game that requires you play often and have a team leader who plays even more. It's a game full of griefers and lifers. People target new players and unless you can play for several hours at a time, your camp will fall. The first few levels make it seem like a single player campaign. But after it opens up the map, you get attacked by much higher ranks making it difficult to build.

I have been playing this game for the past 6 months. Yes it is a pay to win game, however it is really enjoyable with constant events and challenges. I am an average spender within in the game. However the reason for the 1 star is the mini games within the game where you can win items to help you progress is absolutely rigged. I spent £30 to try get some items in an event and evey single round the item I 'chose' to win was the item I got last evey single time. Do not be fooled by them!

This "game" is primarily an interface to click on things to make various numbers bigger, which is used to generate a desire to spend money to make those numbers even larger, faster. I played for a week, and you can play the game without paying for boosts, you will be at a severe disadvantage that way, and the game is designed for pay2win players to dominate free users. The player base takes this further with the most powerful payers banding together in alliances to further stack the deck.

It's not at all what the ads showed. It's a PVP battle game, entirely dependent upon the guild that can be found and joined. The learning curve is steep, and again is totally dependent on the teammates found. I imagine if you find a good group willing to take in and teach a newbie, you might enjoy it. That seems to be luck of the draw, though. It also hits a point that if you don't pay real money, you're never going to be able to compete and survive against players who do.

Downloaded this game thinking it was something else due to an ad that showed a completely different game. Progressed pretty far, enough to say there is way too much to this game. It's ridiculous the amount of content they have put into it. The amount of things you have to claim, the progression of heroes, then their items, then they add a fishing hut... the list goes on and I only got to Furnace Level 17. 1 star only because of their scamming ad tactics. 2-3/5 otherwise, just a time waster.

I normally don't leave reviews. However, first this game is nothing like the ads you see, secound it's a war game.... I repete its fun but it's a war game. You will have to keep the "city" safe from other players. It's a hassle and the loading is crazy long. After clicking on one thing I get a 2 min loading screen. Other war game are much better.

It's a good game up until a point. But eventually it becomes so long to build / upgrade things, that it becomes pointless to play unless you're going to pay for speedups etc. And when I say long, I mean 21 actual real world days to upgrade a furnace. So unless you pay, you basically can't do anything else for 21 days. Not sure who's idea that was, but I've pretty much stopped playing all together now.

Nothing like the ads. If you want a game that emphasizes personal connections and politics, this is for you. Very steep learning curve in that regard, a lot of this game is about making deals and arguing about about time zones. It takes a LOT of commitment to go beyond being cannon fodder. The gameplay itself is the typical freemium addictive experience of (basically) clicking things to get more coins.

While I like conplex and in depth games, this game advertises as a much more simpler game, but is way different that their ads. I'm always playing complex games and downloaded this just to have something more relaxing to play, but that wasn't the case. There is way more to do than you think and again, the ads for this game are nothing like the real game play. Uninstalling and looking for something a little more easy going.

This game is not what was advertised at all. It's called Whiteout Survival, but it's a build and battle game with a very minor and easily overcome survival aspect to it. It's basically a variant of Nexus Wars. Definitely more stressful than what I had in mind. I hate it when games have misleading ads. Edit: been a long time since I saw the ad but I believe it was on YouTube so I can't provide a specific link to it, chief. The ad showed the NPC collecting wood to stay alive. No armies or battles

The ad for this game is completely misleading. It's mainly a war game with a little dash of rpg and survival. I gave it 2 stars because of the graphics only. It has way too much going, and you can't progress through the main story without joining an alliance . You have to keep your shield up so you won't get attacked. Also, make sure that your regular people don't die from the cold. You got to battle monsters for materials. The cost for shields is ridiculous as well.

Do not download. This game is a complete money grab. For those that have been playing without spending, that only lasts so long. You will be left in the dust by players who do spend. Almost every event and activity in the game requires a dollar amount to get ahead in the game once you reach high enough levels. I've seen players spend $100 in a week on this game. I see some people purchasing packs daily. It adds up real quick. You can easily spend $1k plus on this game without even realizing.

So, I downloaded this game from seeing it as an ad on another game. The ad for this game was completely different+ not at all like the actual game play. I'm not sure why they would try to lure you in w/ an entirely different game play than what is offered, but for me that is a HUGE turnoff. I've continued to play, just out of curiosity. I've never played a game quite like this. It feels kind of redundant, completing the same tasks over + over again. 👎

It's a good game when start, then alliance kill event and others slowly turn this into a money burning game, and if you're not willing to spend tens of thousands (dollar), then please just enjoy the game while you can, because there are always some cashed up bullies, player with stolen credit card or even team, going to take out your hard trained troops and hard earned money. The best part is the game is called survival, so there's nothing you can do about it, such an imbalanced game!!

Played similar games but this one grabbed me the most. The characters, graphics, story, art were all amazing. At first, the game was incredibly fun, very addictive. It starts out with a lot you can get done quickly without spending money Then it becomes "hurry up and wait" while turning into p2w. Also, if you want any success with a decent clan you'll have to dedicate a LOT of time. It hooks you then asks for your wallet. I was watching people drop $10-50 on this PER DAY! No thanks.

I had downloaded it after seeing so many ads. Turns out the ads have nothing to do with how the game actually is, which is a shame. Still not a bad game, but it's just +1 idle game that you have to be waiting hours and hours for constructions/trainings to be completed or pay for them to complete faster/instantly. Not what i was looking for when i saw the ads.

It's not worth playing. The whole game is stacked insanely towards those willing to pump loads of money into it. A lot of the items are so rare that you won't find them to level up unless you're willing to buy the packs, and the packs give you barely anything, so you need to buy a lot of them. Even on the regular missions or events, you get missions like 'spend £49.99 to get these points'. I get that they need to make money, but they've basically engineered a game for the worst people.

The classic trick in the book. The advertising is nowhere near the real game concept and mechanics. I'm uninstalling it after 2 days. Reaching targets is getting more time consuming over time, the addiction psychology is built into the game... multiple timers, one expiring sooner than the other. Just don't play it, it'll save your time and money.

Definitely a pay to play game. If you don't spend money, it will take a very long time to advance. The one thing that I think the game makers should change is the hunting. Stamina takes forever to replenish. As one of the things that a free to play player can do regularly, stamina should take half the time to replenish and it shouldn't cost so much to hunt. It's one way that free to players can have some sort of fun on this game. Otherwise it's not even worth it. very expensive game to play.

Plain and simple I played this game for a few months and found out the hard way this is a "PAY" to "WIN" game. If you want to be "free" to "play" that's fine to. But after level 20 it takes days to upgrade 1 thing, unless you want to spend money. Things in this game happen better and faster when you spend money, those items in the shop to speed things up you will see them after the first few levels. You will learn you need then to progress faster or you will be stuck playing this for a few years

If you've played state of survival and the like it's the same but with snow. Free to play for the first levels and then you'll need to pay if you ever want to move up. Micro, even macro transaction for almost everything that make the game playable. Design is nice though... I don't recommend unless you have to much money to spend. Buy a AAA game on any device it will be cheaper and much more fun.

I loved this game. The graphics, the story, the prizes for everything could be better...BUT, Im 30 days in, the problem with this style of game is being literally stuck and controlled by the few max spenders in the server, making the game unenjoyable. PTW is part of the gaming world, but when it dominates a server that you are literally stuck in with no way to find a place to be able to just play the game, the only option left is to quit. I spend to support the developers, not the big spenders.

Liked the game at the beginning. Was fun, and I got to build things. Then it changed to fighting. You have the arena, exploration, alliance, and ongoing battles to keep what you have built. But there is no more to actively build. Its just upgrade so you are strong enough to keep what you have. I tried to download the game to my new fire tablet thinking it would be more fun with a bigger screen. I found out that it is not available on the fire. So I will not be able to play any more.

have played for months, like others said the game has nothing to do with the gameplay in the ads, its not "a portion of gameplay" in months I never had the gameplay I did in the ad. secondly, it's a pay to win game. the longer you play the more noticeable it feels. at first you feel like you can do good enough if you work more, but the game has multiple events constantly to keep you busy,keep you online and keep you spending.

The ads you're shown are nothing like the gameplay. You won't play anything like what you see portrayed. I've never seen some of the screenshots shown here. Quite misleading. It's a traditional alliance building pvp game. Leveling up, heros, waiting hours for buildings to get leveled up. Nothing really new. You will eventually find yourself thinking "wait a minute- this is like every other idle or strategy game!"... but with too much else going on- and too many ways to spend $$$. Don't do it!

I've been playing this game for about a week now and it's honestly pretty boring. Whiteout doesn't really bring anything to the table that most other "city builders" haven't done so far. It's your typical build a base, join an alliance, research tech and look for hero shards to upgrade of course with a cash shop and everyone's favorite in game currency purchasable loot boxes. If you're looking for innovation, ground breaking mechanics, or more than your idle enjoyment it's an easy skip.

The game decides every step. You do not get to think, you do not get to play, you only get to tab where the game wants you to, signaling that with chain-popups and quests you have to do in a certain order. This only becomes worse the more time you invest, plus you then have to wait out hours of upgrade times that you could speed up by dropping cash. Awful design overall.

Played about 15 mins, no enjoyment in this supposed game. It's just a case of click the next objective, click the button to upgrade/assign a person, click the next objective, click the button to upgrade etc and repeat. There isn't really any player interaction, and of course it's nothing like the ads. Maybe it'll get more enjoyable later on but I'm not willing to be mindlessly tapping buttons to get that point.

Although the concept is nice, the game is extremely pay2win focused. The rewards you get here and there from events are nowhere near the rewards people get from paying. You'd need hundreds of dollars to keep up with top players, otherwise, you'd just be a farm. I wouldn't have minded if it was a small pack to purchase once a while, but they added constantly, almost daily. Avoid this game if you want to save your pockets.

It's definitely a grind game. Lots of buy this - buy that, and I do sometimes, but you could spend a fortune if you wanted. I don't know how some folks find the time and money to get the high level accounts. I like it ok, but I wish there was more individual options that do not require you to be online at certain times. My clan is overseas and I am usually in bed or working when game -group activities are happening.

I am giving this game a 4 star rating solely based on the fact it does NOT play like the ad. The ad I kept seeing for this game was a playable ad with a guy with an ax killing polar bears for meat and selling it to buy stuff and upgrades. That looked fun, and so wanted to try it out. Come to find out, it's just another city builder game. It's not too bad though. But at least Last War actually has some gameplay in it like the playable ads, this so far does not. I wish it did. Devs add it like ad.

I've played for almost a year now. Overall, it's a waste of time unless you want to spend thousands. You will not be competitive in any aspect of the game without a lot of spending. Heroes phase out too quick, gear costs to upgrade grow at rapid paced where it can take a month of saving materials for a single upgrade. If you don't care to be fodder for whales to kill and express their financial dominance it's an ok game. If you want to be remotely competitive expect to spend many thousands.

very heavily pay to win. it's not unusual for people to dump hundreds or even thousands of dollars on this game. very time consuming to stay somewhat competitive as a free to play player, but even then you are absolutely no match for the whales who dump thousands into it play only if you want to spend thousands of dollars and hours of time to keep competitive. also after more than 5 months of playing, I still haven't seen anything like playable ad where you hunt aggressive bears and sell them.

The game is over designed. It has fun elements but it has too many. And they are so wildly different from each other. They feel like a literal different game. It's trying to do too much and be too much. Also the PvP is not kind to lower level characters as you can be assaulted by anyone at any level and they will do it constantly to the point it feels like griefing. Too many elements. It needs to decide what it wants to be and get really good at that instead of appealing to everyone.

Crashed within 2 minutes of gameplay. I'm gonna continue playing the ad instead. Resp dev: if I use an app that serves your add, I have no clue how to get the link to that ad? It opens play store. The content of the ad is running a butcher kitchen where you kill polar bears for meat, then cook it and then sell it. Which is totally unrelated to this game, It is themed similar but mechanics are different. You know what ads you run so don't ask me to link your ad. It is also a well known trend. BS

Worse clone of other games like Puzzles and Survival. That wouldn't be so bad, but shields are a huge issue. They don't tell you where to use them, so you have to figure that out. The first one drops too early in the game, after only a few days. You might only notice when you are attacked. They are way too expensive to get and maintain. Either you grind all the time for diamonds, pay money, or burn. Bad system which renders the game unplayable long-term for free-to-play people.

Completely different from the ads, and the funny part is that the ad says that it's not different from it. Expect the same F2P grind with 8 different types of currencies so you're always short of the one that's needed for the upgrade, and voila that costs real (world) currency. The few positives (style, animation etc.) are overshadowed by the false advertising bait n switch extravaganza that is this game.

Bait and Switch I was playing block blast and this game showed an ad where you can demo the gameplay. In the demo I was hunting bears and selling meat and having so much fun!!! That is why I downloaded the game. Turns out, the real game is nothing like that and doesn't even have the bear hunting or anything. If I wanted a city building game, I would have downloaded one. Stop tricking people and offering them a fun experience that isn't even part of the game.

Another pay to play game that lures people in wth misleading advertising. If you like to struggle to level up or want to spend money, just to be crushed by, what I would define as a professional gamer group. Then, sure, play this game. There is no storyline, no connection to characters, and no ability for unique creative design. There is little to no strategy in selecting locations or battle patterns. The more money you pay, the faster you level up.

The ads for this game lie. Showed a game where you hunted polar bears and made money then upgraded your weapons to do more and hunt other animals. That is not this game at all. This is your typical mmo pay to win game with a different skin. The game lures you in with lies and hopes you have fun by making it seem like it's a single player game for a bit. Then it opens up and before you know it you're being attacked and losing all your progress. I'd give it negative stars if I could.

Take what you will from this, I only played for 5mins. It might not be this bad. But as soon as it started, the game was nothing like the ad (reason I downloaded). Instead I had to get wood, build something that has a 2sec timer on it. I'm familiar with this. Within a couple of levels the builds will begin to take hours or even days requiring power ups or real money to simply play the game. Unless you enjoy the game of waiting. Damn I miss AOE, Warcraft, etc of what these games are loosely based

Pay to win. Forget every comment out there talking about "affordable packs". There's literally a mission where you have to buy a pack with a price not lower than 119,99€. They will sometimes send you enquiries where some questions are about the price barrier. They don't care. They just want whales. Most players will spend dozens of euros per day just to play a "free to play". Be honest and offer a honest subscription without any price barrier.

I've been playing whiteout survival for a while now and it's OK. It's a very passive game. You send orders for your troops to kill something, you either win or lose based on your power, you upgrade things and troops. It is also a very microtransaction heave game. Every single time you log in you are presented with a "deal" of $5.99. I saw a playable "ad" for the very same game that is drastically different from the actual game. Don't false advertise gameplay ads. Reduced to 500 characters.

First days you have a lot to do, lots of upgrades that will consume hours of your time per day. Then it slows down, and upgrades take days. If you want to progress faster you need to buy accelerators. But you still need to be regularly online, as you can be attacked anytime. Overall the game looks nice, but requires a lot of time invested. And money, if you don't want to wait days for upgrades. Uninstalled after 1 week.

Nothing like the ad that encouraged me to download this. Very time consuming game that can be free to play, but (like most mobile games) pushes in game purchases. There's also a lot going on in the game, and it's hard to keep track of everything. Attempted to delete my account today, which was unnecessarily complex. Overall, probably one of the better mobile games out there, but not my favourite.

this game in the beginning was fun, and for a week, I was actually ahead of everyone in my server and stronger than everyone. sadly, that is not the case anymore. after you reach a certain level without spending progression is very slow, super slow . If you have an alliance, they'll remove you because you can't buy anything. have to sadly remove this game off my phone.

I've installed the game out of curiosity and the first thing I saw was "2 seconds to upgrade something", so I shut the game off and uninstalled it directly. Another game where you have to wait days or months to upgrade something and it will be just draining my time like crazy, no thank you. Keep to what you give in the ad, because the gameplay is far away from it. 1 star for lying in the ad.

downloaded the game through an ad, and the gameplay in the ad is not what the game is. I don't know why you'd advertise a game that isn't the game. this is a city builder where you have to wait for things to be built. that's all it is. just wait for things to be built. pretty boring, however I will say I like the art, calming music, and the relaxed feeling I had while playing. uninstalled after an hour, though. no swinging axes sadly.

fraudulent advertising!
