DO NOT INSTALL!! false advertising in ads that they put up, or that you can play as a "playable game" the sort of game that i wanted to have a bit of a go at, it seems fun. but it seems like this is just another 1 of those build little world using different resources the same as a lot of others that are made a lot better! I played for over 2 hours and have not had one single go at playing like you do in the "playable ads"! so as i said false advertising 100%

Good sound and graphics. However, the game mechanics are just the same as other similar games. 1. Survive some catastrophy-theme. 2. Get resources, build and expand base. 3. Find hero, adventure, upgrade base and hero. 4. Upgrade everything you own and draw hero cards (require more and more time or pay real money at some point). 5. Expand to rest of the world with new types of adventure and start PvP. 6. Upgrade everything... Get beaten by other players, more ways to spend real money.

The ad showed a simple, casual game where you collect items and automatically upgrade them to fight monsters with just a swipe of your thumb, something fun and lightweight. But when I downloaded it, it turned out to be a heavy, strategic game (around 700MB) with totally different gameplay. Nothing like what was advertised. This kind of misleading promotion wastes time and data. Please show the real gameplay in your ads.

I feel I'm echoing the main human reviews: we got ads for an interactive game with lots of character. What we got was a cheap Age of Empires wannabe with lots of polish. The ad for the game isn't even super clean or well made, but it's far more engaging. I've heard the game gets grindy, and I could see that being the case. The fact that there is voice acting is cool, but it isn't all that good. I wouldn't bother with this one.

When I started playing, I hated the game.. then it grew into me after a while.. and then some time passed and I hated it all over again. First of, there are too many speedups tasks within the game but very limited sources of speedups.. especially if you're a free player. Secondly, the shops are useless.. majority of the items are just 1 in the shop and you have to wait for a day or a week for a refresh.. also, once that item is bought, it's sold out. Hahaha.. very useless.

I downloaded this game expecting to hunt polar bears, sell the meat, and make money in a business-focused game. Instead, it’s about building a town and constant upgrades. By the time I reached level 7 with the furnace, it is revealed as a multiplayer game where others are doing the same thing. Reviews reveal that later gameplay shifts to fighting others or getting raided, which isn’t what I wanted. I feel greatly misled by the developers. Please advertise what is in the game, not lures. Uninstal

I don't download playable ads because it makes me feel like "they" won if I find myself enjoying it. Well, slaughtering and grilling up polar bears seemed to be the perfect way to get past my defense, because I gave in, loved it, downloaded the game. Nothing like the ad at all. Boring, trite, cookie cutter click and wait 2 days to upgrade your base or spend 300 dollars and you level up a little bit garbage. It's astounding that you all managed to make a game that sucks so bad compared to the ad.

Poor initial starting experience, doesn't let me play the game, just cutscene, click this, click that, claim. I've learned nothing and the game is holding my hand the entire way. Give full control back to the user, let them figure stuff out in their own pace. Within seconds I've interacted with multiple buildings with lots of options and not had time to ease into it. Dev I suggest you go back and study old games. They don't need this holdy-hand bs because they designed their game well.

The game is nothing like the ads. In the ads, I played as a hero, gathering meat, fighting bears alone outside the camp, making pizza, and selling it. In reality, none of that exists. The game just makes you press buttons, and everything happens automatically. I was expecting to actually play, but instead, I had to tap "build" over and over again. I got all my buildings to level 8, and now progress is painfully slow unless you pay. I uninstalled it because I wanted to play, not just watch things

Pay to win, pay to play, pay to compete. Like most p2w games, this game has potential to be fun if it wasn't ruined by developer teams that focus on in app purchases only. Edit: I've found items in the game that can only be unlocked with an overly expensive purchase. They've restricted access to features in the game if you dont spend thousands of dollars... complete waste of time for long term gamers. Would not recommend.

Nothing like the ads. Waaaaay too many things going on. Is it a survival game like the title and ads suggest? Is it a war game? Heroes have too many different things to upgrade. There are constantly multiple side quests. There are just too many aspects to the game. Players that pay have an advantage over those that don't. Just from my alliance, people give it a few days, then give up, likely because it's far too complex. I think the developers tried to do too much.

This game is Registered as a single player game even though it's a multiplayer base building game. I thought it had different scenarios and stuff where the elements were attacking you. Where players can actually attack you. I wouldn't recommend it because of the false advertisement in the ads.... Edit: I did play enough of the game. The second it went from SP to MP, I stopped. It is listed on Google Play as a single-player game, not multiple players.

The typical heavily monetized "strategy game" experience. My main gripe with this game is that it falsely advertised it's game play as being different than reality. my second big issue is that you can literally just pay to win. Since heroes have such a huge impact and you can buy the super strong ones and stuff to upgrade them, fighting at the top power levels just seems like a contest of wallets. Decent way to make money, but unforgivable design choice to me. Never do that in a PVP game.

Played it. The Ads are false advertising. They're nothing like the game at all. Once you get to furnace lvl 9 or 10, the paywall will hit you like a ton of bricks. I was pretty impressed with it early on, but that paywall is so heavy handed that it was pretty much impossible to do anything unless you start forking over cash. If you don't mind buying your progress, this game is for you.

Pay to win. The way this game works and plays is that the more you pay, the more power you have. Played the game for 7 months. It got worse and worse as I played. You can get anything you need if you buy the packs. If you don't buy the packs to grow, then you grow very slowly and become easy prey for the money paying players. It's not worth the money when you get to a certain point. it's 100$ to just upgrade 1 chief gear charm. This game was a horrible experience and why I gave up mobile games

the devs didnt think out game design. It's all content. It's possible to follow the little finger they have pointing to everything without learning how to play. I got deep enough to start exploring and I have no idea how to play. I think that's bad design. The game should be intuitive, you shouldn't need much direction to understand a game, even a strategy and management game. Not to mention this game eats up battery life like no tomorrow, went from 25% to 3% while playing for like 10 min. F-

I've been playing since day 1 of this game. I'm now Red 4. As of 9/25/23, when I first reviewed the game, the devs have done absolutely nothing about the bullying and dead servers and in turn our server is even worse than it was. Many of us have spent a fortune in this game but no one can out spend the biggest players who in turn go about destroying what little is left of my server. Maybe once all the others are gone & no more money by them is spent you finally wake TF up and do something!!

Fast growth for first few days. After this, you're farming or buying ( which at $5-10/ pack will add up fast) to grow. Stamina runs out too quickly as does hero xp. They tell you that you can earn these things through hunting, which you can; however, they don't tell you it's only minimum amounts and only about 15% of the time. If you can afford to spend at least $100/week on packs to grow and develop heroes, this might be fun for you. If you're f2p or on a budget, there's other games for you.

As many others have stated, while there is lots to do for free players, you can only play to a certain point before being locked behind a paywall. Which sucks because it really is a great game. But if you can't/won't spend money, you end up wasting hours of gameplay all for nothing. And just a little FYI, the video ads showing the game look absolutely nothing like the actual gameplay.

Initially, it's was the commercials which intensely prompted me to download the app. Unfortunately we learned after playing for a month, it wasn't as the commercial portrayed it to be. It's far more labor & time-based intensive. This game wouldn't be recommended for the casual player who can only spare a few minutes a day to play. IF you're interested in a city simulation game & have more than an hour available to play everyday; then this game greatly has the potential for hours of fun you.

Fake ads, the game play is just very boring updating of a town. nothing like the ads or the sample game play. i spent hours upgrading trying to see if it eventually becomes the game they advertise but I never saw it. so don't waste your time if you are hoping for the fun collecting of meat, serving, collecting money, hiring more hunters, it's not that game. that's just false advertising like so many games are doing these days.

Absolutely terrible support. I've spent a fair amount of money in this game because I was originally enjoying the advancement, but now it takes forever to collect items to grow your power. I had saved up for weeks to get one item and, when I finally got enough for it, I accidentally chose the wrong item. First time in months and months of playing. Supports response? "Can't help you. Be more careful next time." Both rude and unhelpful. I'm not spending another dime on this game.

This is probably the most pay to win game I have ever played, and it's only getting worse. It's the same events every week, the only changes come with the devs finding new ways to push things on players to buy. It really is sad, because the game has lots of potential and several fun events. But you simply can't compete with unlimited spending. 2 stars for the few fun events, but seriously, don't download this game. Edit: The devs want to point out the game is f2p, I'll clarify it's free to lose.

It's NOT free to play. I've come across hundreds of players who's only objective is to spend THOUSANDS just to stay at the top, and bully everyone else. If the devs can restrict this, it would be a lot more fun. So if you plan on emptying your savings into this game, go for it. If you just want to be f2p, look somewhere else. I just wish I had. Wasted too much time & money. And yes, after spending MONTHS on this, you'd think I know how to play. Not worth it. Stay away.

Deathly boring, typical build a city and travel around game that I've seen a thousand times before. I wanted to play it for the ads that I saw in another game of a little dude running around collecting meat from the animals head killed, then collecting money and building more of that. That's all I wanted. I did not want the game I got whatsoever. I am going to play it until I have no resources left and then delete it and never touch it ever again.

have gone months back-and-forth with customer support for a basic issue. Every response ranged from "I don't understand the issue" to "do you have a screenshot?" to "please describe the issue in more detail" to "you aren't checking the time zone conversion" (completely unrelated) to "we don't see any issue". Now they suddenly don't have a record of me ever submitting the issue. Between that and the pay-to-play stalemate of a game it's just not worth your time. EDIT: Facebook message was IGNORED!

The game is not as presented in the ads. Not even close. It's a time based farming/war strategy game similar to Evony. Progressing after level 15 becomes a slow grind, slower and slower as you progreas into the game. It's meticulously made to encourage you to spend money on speed ups and hero/troops upgrades. I was part of an alliance where several members where spending >50 usd daily (some of them more) and they were not even that powerful compared to other players in the server.

The game is nothing like what the ads show. Nevertheless, its designs and art are nice. Moreover, the mechanics of the game are interesting and pleasant. However, I can't give more than 3 stars as it's very Pay-to-Win. One could say that the game is engineered to make you buy things. And sooner or later, you will. You can try free-to-play, but you're going to feel like a 2nd class citizen. The strongest in this game is whoever has the strongest wallet. EDIT: Removing 1 star for poor support.

Now don't get me wrong I really enjoyed this game and brought a number of packs in my year plus playing. However my account has since been restricted, as applying for 3 refunds over the space of a year for purchases made in error warrants that. No warning. And to unlock they want me to pay £15. Speaking to customer service got me a copy and paste response and since ignored. Wasted a lot of money on this game and probably would of wasted more. What a shame.

The ad you play is NOTHING like this actual game. This game is fun, but they need to add back in the parts from the ad. Like when you click the hunters hut you can go out and actually play the game to aquire more meat, same with the coal and the wood and iron. Otherwise it should be reported for the false advertising. It's a big money spend game, you really can't advance unless you buy characters or boosts. Even some of the events REQUIRE you to buy something to earn points in an event.

Game was fun for awhile. After you advance so far, it is too expensive to even compete with other players. I invested about 50 dollars USD into the game only for other people to take it. Supposedly you're supposed to be moved if someone attacks you more than 3x. Never happened. And we're not talking about players that are similarly matched; were talking about advanced players being encouraged to attack newbies. Whelps, congratulations, you lost a paying customer due to you're unfair game play.

The game is not bad, it's good. The game style is easy to understand, and you quickly get the hang of it. However, remember that this is unrelated to the playable ads we keep seeing everywhere. It's an immersive attack-and-defend game with guilds and all. Multiplayer. I prefer single-player games, as I'm not always playing, and I don't want to be stressed by people attacking my land.

I installed this after seeing many ads for, it looked fun to end animals, collect meat, sell meat, get money, and expand the operation. Turns out that's not the game at all. this is a world building game where you raise a settlement. this is not the type of game I enjoy and I did NOT appreciate getting suckered into playing another world building game. If your here for the same reason I came, maybe those fun mini games exist but I'm sure you need to play to a high level to get to them.

Meh. I played for a few days and it was interesting at first, but it soon became clear that it is like a lot of other knockoff "game of war" type of games with a rare few interesting dynamics. It was also clear that this game was going to be another cash grab, filled with cheating bots and money whales, dominating the playing field early on that will make it harder for the majority to progress. If you enjoy these type of money pit games, go for it. I won't be playing it anymore.

The game is a cash grab. It simply copies events from other games by this developer and adds other events from some other games. They just keep adding levels to the furnace, equipment, pets, and hero gear, as well as adding new heroes. You can see that Super Super Rare (SSR) heroes are better than Common or Rare heroes. Download if you intend to spend millions; otherwise, stay away.

So disappointing. This is the first time I've actually downloaded a game after a fun interactive ad, but like many reviews have stated, the actual game is NOTHING like the ad. I just wanted to chop down some trees, kill some polar bears, and sell their meat for money. But the game I downloaded was some weird storytelling game where you just keep tapping where it points. I honestly have no idea what the game was, it wasn't entertaining at all. And again, not at all what was advertised.

Bait and switch - nothing like the advertisements, at all. This is a basic "wait for resources" style idle game where all you really do is wait for the clock to run out so you can gather resources or build something or train your troops. You can always, of course, click on any of the hundreds of advertisements that pop up in game trying to get you to spend real world money to speed these timers up. Eventually, you may get into some group-based PvP - but it's pay to win.

Game has a huge amount of false ads, but unfortunately one of them drew me in and so I tried it for a few weeks. Despite content creators saying it was fun, the gameplay got boring after a bit, especially with the sheer amount of players on their server having what seemed like an unlimited budget. So many of these players are also incredibly toxic. After almost 1 month of giving most of my free time to it, I cannot recommend it to anyone who doesn't have unlimited disposable income.

This is nothing like the ads, but it's a fun time. It's sort of two games in one - you spend a few days building a survival settlement in a frozen wasteland, but then suddenly you're recruiting heroes and building armies and joining alliances in what is apparently a PVP war game, and the survival stuff stops mattering. Lost 1 star because it's extremely pay to win. Some things you can't get without paying, and even if you pay a decent amount, you'll never keep up with whales who spend thousands.

nothing like the adverts which was a bit disappointing. The game is a bit repetitive. upgrade building, spam all unlocked minor building upgrades. rinse and repeat. By the time you do the exact same upgrade in 6 houses you will lose the will to live. you will quickly reach a point where you have all the resources you need. I played up to chapter 9 but now it wants me to join an alliance. Personally I prefer solo games so this is as far as I go.

I'll admit, I didn't fully read the information about the game to start with. I was enjoying just the survival aspect of it, building a little village, hunting and tending to the sick. Now it's all about an alliance and fighting and heroes and resource collection, and I wish it wasn't like that. I've played Rise of Kingdoms and for the kind of gameplay I'm now facing on here, RoK definitely does it way better. Sadly, I'll end up uninstalling cause it's not the game I thought it was going to be.

Don't spend money on this game. Often in-game credits like gems etc (which are used to purchase buildings and do upgrades, amongst other things), will be deducted and you can often not recieve the item. You earn gems for doing tasks and also often when you try to redeem these things. They are not credited. And if you contact support and tell them. They just tell you thanks for letting us know. They won't give you back what was took.

This is a 'pay-to-win' game and top players spend thousands of dollars of real money for different perks in the game. If you don't invest, you would be among the weakest on the server. The developers know how to manipulate people and even those players who did not want to spend real money, end up spending. You may think that's it's ok to spend 1-2-8 dollars, but you end up with multiple mini transactions which sum up to hundreds or thousands of dollars. Support is aweful, they never help.

I have been playing for a little while now, and my biggest complaint is that most competitive aspects of the game are behind a paywall. It takes a large sum of money to play this game effectively. Regular packs are 5-10 dollars, which is about a days worth of play or less in most cases, and anything substantial is 20 dollars, upwards of 100 dollars for a pack. This is a mobile game, not GTA online. Suggestion: Either make the game purchasable for a price or reduce the cost of packs significantly

This game is garbage! I got an ad on Block Blast where you move your character around, kill polar bears for meat, cook the meat, and sell it and collect pounds of money! Kinda of that cooking one, or money mart. False advertising is a crime and I'm not sure if you get that but it's whatever. If you want more people to stay on this app, change how you play it, and correctly advertise your game. Please, This is so annoying when I see the game isn't like the ad. Trash game anyways, deleted.

Downloaded this game just so I could give it 1*. Never played it, but I get ads for it all the time that freeze and don't work, not even the "install" button. Of course these companies pay for ads, so it's no surprise that other reviews talk about how the game is a p2w money grab. Maybe they wouldn't have to spend so much on marketing if they were smart enough to design ads that work. But if they can't even design a working 30-second ad, the game is probably just as poorly-designed.

This game wasn't anything like the ad that I came across on another game. The ad was playable where you operate a restaurant or something along those lines. You have to keep up with getting meat, cooking it, selling it and upgrading different aspects...where is THAT game? Because this seems like a pay to win type of game to get certain upgrades and whatnot. LAME 👎🏼

After playing for almost 1 1/2 years, I can not recommend this game. As f2p player, you have absolutely no chance. Best rewards always go to the people who already have everything (because of big wallet). If you want to play WOS, be aware that you either need an extremely high frustration tolerance, or at least 3k dollars to spend every month. Since I don't have the latter (after spending much money, sadly), I also don't have the first anymore. Additionally, ads are lying! Finally uninstalled

To put it simply the enjoyment of the game soon expires. It is a 'pay to win' game, with players out ranking you due to their investments in the game, promising features in the game are also unavailable if you do not pay. The gameplay becomes repetitive and tedious overtime and unfortunately there are elements of racism and prejudice amongst the online community between every servers in the game. Such a shame. Enjoyable for 2/3 weeks only.

This game should be illegal in the EU. It’s not a game—it’s a rigged casino disguised as one. Every mini-game with “random” drops is actually predetermined to trick you into buying packs. Once you buy one, your in-game luck drops, making you dependent on spending more to stay competitive. The gameplay is pointless, with no real goals beyond spending money.

False advertising. Ads show moving your character to remove snow, find resources. That's not in the game. You don't have a char to move around. Even the first three images in the game description (defending small camp against animal, collecting a stack of wood, choosing where to put buildings) aren't in the game. This is an online-only player-vs-player conquest game, not really about surviving weather or rescuing people. (There's a little of that, just the first hour of play, but that's it.)

The process of account deletion is exasperating, to say the least. After you hit a certain level, the game prohibits deletion of characters. You're then forced to go through a form that asks you things that are difficult to answer (e.g. I had to manually calculate when I started the game because it was one of the questions asked). It then forces you to wait 15 days before you can delete it, which is preposterous. The developers should consider better ways to retain players.

As usual for such games, no relation with ads. And the game itself is boring. No challenge, whether you good or bad, game will continue without any changes. It's marked as idle game, so you don't need to do anything, game will continue anyway. Usual for such games tons of extra mechanics, so you would have some place to spend your money, instead of improving main mechanic quality. The only good points are style and setting, but they don't worth it.

Deceptive ads. The game is nothing like the playable ads. It's another multi-player alliance war game... the game play itself is fun, but because of the deception and the fact that it's multi-player when it was advertised as a single player, it gets a single star. Otherwise, it could have gotten 4 or 5 stars for the well-made art style and the game is actually pretty good; it just isn't what it was advertised to be and I don't have time to maintain a shield and keep up with alliances...

Played a cool demo in an ad, read good reviews, downloaded the game, and spent 3 solid minutes pushing the buttons it told me to press. Nothing like the ad. Who actually enjoys playing these "click this button when I tell you to?" Why spend all that money advertising the fun part of the game and keep all of the boring stuff in the way? The goal is they're setting you up for microtransactions. The result is, I leave a 1 star review and remain wary of future game ads.

Worst game ever, I downloaded this game after seeing an ad that showed exciting gameplay about killing bears, gathering and selling meat, making money, and expanding. However, the actual game was completely different,it felt more like a city-building or management game with no survival or hunting elements at all. The ad was misleading, portraying intense survival and hunting mechanics that barely exist in the real game, which focuses instead on building and strategy.

Nothing like what ads I saw during other games. But gave it a try. It was fun till about level 12, after that you will find yourself just gathering resources or waiting hours then days to finish leveling up a building. The fighting was interesting, but if strategy games are not for you I would say skip this one. Also deleting your account is a pain. Want to know how many gems you have first log in as well as last login etc.

Firstly, let me state that this is a review of over 100 days consistent game play. 1 out of 5. Over priced! Most progress is encouraged through daily spending, the small progress you make per day not spending money is minimal. Also, it's well known that it's cheaper for certain countries, but we are talking a digital sale here, nothing physical that can be touched. For a play to gain decent power you will need to spend a minimum of $15,000 USD.

This has got to be one of the worst games to play. Game dynamics based purely around money. It was fun at first but after the first few months you have nothing to do besides be a meat shield/collect rss hoping you can do a few upgrades. Over a year later I'm top 20 in every server because most have quit. Worst game I've ever spent money on. It's boring. Customer service is a joke when you have real problems. Like not being able to play events due to game bugs.

Great game!! It is very busy to build your power even if you dont spend your money in this game. Easy to stock up your resources, when you attack monster you will also gain lots of thing! However, it would be nice if we can assist/transfer some of the resources to alliance members in order to help them :) and to add on, the translation is accurate enough on the chat

I'm rating the ad actually. I have been playing the game for over 2 years. It's NOT AT ALL like these new ads or "screenshots". I have no clue where they are getting these screenshots. This is NOT the gameplay. This game is a alliance based war game with some little mini games that come and go based on the calendar. There is one mini game that does have some of these elements in it, but that's all. The main game is NOTHING like the new ads. Why they decided to be so misleading, I have no clue.

Not the fun little game they show you in the ads. It's a time-consuming world-builder, just like all the other Farmville-like games. That's fine if it's what you want to do, but I get annoyed when the playable ads don't match the real gameplay. I know the mini-game from the ad is in there somewhere, but I don't want to spend hours/days to get there. (And don't call me "Chief" or I'll change it to one star) So you replied, "Dear Chief." Okay a**hole. One star now.

If you've ever played Lords mobile then you have played this game, they just added snow. This is neither single player, nor idle game. At first it seems interesting with a lot of things to do until you realize it is actually an online multiplayer game and you are at the mercy of other players the moment the shield protecting your city falls (unless you buy more shield). Rebuilding troops will eat your resources (unless you buy more resources). I would have much prefered a single player game.

my previous review was deleted by the developer. this is like every other multi player mobile game. they throw rewards at you as a new player. you progress super fast. you join a guild, and then you realize if you want to see any success you have to spend money to keep up. it will also start to feel like a job checking in over and over. you can play this game free to play, but we all know the developers designed the game specifically to constantly give you fomo when you don't.

why are all these games nothing like the advertisement? I was playing another game and the ad for this came up. I got to play a preview of the game where I woukd walk through a gate, kill some polar bears, collect the meat, sell it to a line of people and then use the money to upgrade my weapon in a very fast satisfying way. So I download the game and this gameplay doesn't exist at all. it's a completely different game. I'm just managing a camp-site. it just clicking on buildings and upgrading

Game ruined by one player with insane wallet. This should be a fun game, starting together and building cities and joining alliances to complete events and tasks. Yes, if you buy resources it gives you a big leg up, but because it is still hugely cooperative, free to play players are still needed. That is until one person that doesn't like losing spends $10,000s to crush others, because there is no limit on the benefit of spend. It makes me not want to play any app game.

Believe it or not, I downloaded this app because the ad for this game was actually super fun. It was only after downloading that I sadly realized this game was completely different from the ad. The ad was where you have a battle axe and fight a massive group of respawning polar bears. Fighting the bears gave you meat which you sold, letting you upgrade stuff. But the game is nothing like the ad. It made me mad. What a waste of time! It's literally just boring overhead building and upgrading.

Ok so the most important thing... the first 3 images in the PLAY STORE itself are fake... the 4th and 5th MIGHT have been from a much older version, idk, I came across this game via an ad. and that ad was a game for those basic attack, collect, upgrade mechanic games that go on forever with no end goal, I thought it would be a casual game ill play for a week and uninstall. but what i got was something completely different. final verdict: good game, messed up advertising. watch out for P2P

I've played this game for over a year. It's a love hate relationship. It will take all your time away so be warned. this game is massively pay to win. If you're spending money just know if you're not dropping more than 1000 a month or more, you won't be anything in comparison to the bigger whales. my low review is because of the games adds. They are quickly approaching false advertisement because their adds for the game are nothing like the game.. stop making it look like an RPG or SIMS game..

Fake advertisements, decent game, tons of micro transactions; but it does have lots of bonus stuff that the game throws at you to level you up faster... but I feel like it does this to entice you to spend money. There are lots of "whales" in this game who seem to have either too much time or too much money... or both. Getting steel is a real pain; you'll get roughly 50.000 Gems thrown at you over the first three days, but then you'll run out of gems, and the game keeps baiting you.

I gave the game an honest try. It has been awhile since I attempted this type of game. It's kind of fun, but according to the ToS the developers won't get involved with conflicts between players. This gives way for a lot abuse. Not so much with words, but the battle system allows you to be completely dominated with no way to stop, or fight it. Basically you could spend 100 hours making troops and some player that spent 250 hours or some money, can come in and destroy all your units forever.

Did you come to this game playing one of their ads? Did you then come to the comment section to see if this game was just as advertised? Well let me inform you, this game is not like it was advertised. It's not you moving around a character from one location to the next loading meat on your back. It's another click around the town and click activities just to sit there and wait for the time to pass. Why do games got to advertise falsehoods? Is it bc that's the only way to attract customers?

it is nothing like the ads but I was being paid to play. fairly typical farm game. all fun for a bit. but then there are the constant mandatory violent clashes multiple times a month whether you want that aspect or not. it forces everyone into huge groups of 100 just to not get wiped out by other huge groups. if you're not in the top 8, you're cannon fodder. the English instructions are TERRIBLE. I've stopped being paid, I'm quitting.

The overall game play is ok and there are plenty of activities to do. It does require regular play and a lot of time to advance in a meaningful way, which can be shortcut by purchasing add-ons. However, I believe this game currently promotes bullying and toxicity as its play style, as it is possible that an opponent could wipe out your progress simply because they have paid or played more. Therefore, if you want a game that will also protect your mental and emotional well-being, this is not it.

Gameplay nothing like its advertising. Just another bait and switch. UPDATE: There are no "ad links" to provide. The ads run in other games (such as Harry Potter Puzzles and Spells) with a bit of "gameplay" (the bait) of a type completely different from the actual game (the switch). It is the same terrible tactic as numerous other game ads. It is reprehensible and shows a lack of faith in the real game and a "milk the player for all we can" approach to game design. Y'all should be banned.

I played this for a good two weeks. Never spent a penny, and got my furnace up to level 19 (that's the only actual goal of the game). Logged in the last time and found my city had been completely destroyed by someone who had paid a lot of dollars, just to get those feels. You go dude, but jokes on you. I just deleted the app and won't think about it ever again. It has no ads. That's about the extent of what a team of developers did right.

There's always some dang popup ad for some pack they want you to purchase. You could close your screen for a few seconds, come back, and the ad is there. Or switch to a different app for a sec and leave it running, and the second you come back, there's the dang ad. It's so persistent it counts uploading an avatar as closing the screen so you can't upload the picture at all. It's ruining the game, to be completely honest.

This game isn't anything like the ads. They suggest an idle game where you fight polar bears, build settlements, and sell items to a line of customers. Instead, this is a deeply involved strategy game with no control of your fighters during combat. It is a good game that I don't have the wherewithal to get involved with for a mobile game. It deserves more than the 2 stars I'm giving but it's not the game I was expecting.

Do not download if you are thinking of getting this based on the ad, as the gameplay is not even remotely similar. It's false advertisement at its finest, and I've noticed many others have said the same and the developer just gives some generic feedback about reporting it, even though they are the ones who put it out. It seems lots of mobile games do this, so I shouldn't be surprised by the disingenuous tactics here, but still, it's disappointing.

Just uninstalled this game that has no sense whatsoever. Someone double your level can attack your city and plunder your resources, put your armies into the infirmary or kill them. You have no way to protect yourself besides buying shields (you get some for free). There is little strategy, just clicking frantically on everything that moves. I spent 1 month on this game and I can officially say, it was time wasted. I was on Furnace level 20 and heroes were all around level 50. Pay2win 100%.

Game is cancer. This game is one that regularly uses false advertisement of gameplay. That alone would usually be uninstall moment but I gave it a good try, Played until 80mil power and decided I don't need this in my life. It's more of a chore than it is fun. By the time you get far enough to see what the game has to offer (not much occasionally there were good mini games) the only motivation remaining is that your trapped in your own investment of time. Find your own link

I recently encountered an advertisement for a game that appeared to be quite enjoyable. However, upon downloading and playing the game, I found that it differed significantly from what was presented in the advertisement. The ad depicted a scenario where players crafted weapons and other items to combat a large polar bear, and defeating the bear would grant access to various rewards. Unfortunately, the actual game primarily involves building and upgrading.

The game plays itself, which isn't fun at all. You'll be tricked into thinking you're playing a management sim as the game vomits resources at you and tells you exactly what to spend them on, until suddenly you have none and the shop advertisements start popping. If you want an open-ended management game, this isn't it; this is an hour long brain-dead tutorial slide that funnels you into the cash shop.

It's a great game, but nothing like what the ads show, and that's a real shame. Technically, the ads are false advertisements because the game itself is a base builder. You don't control one single person like the ads show, at least, not the android version, so because of the false advertising, what would be a 5-star game drops to a 1-star game. Fix the ads to show the real game, and then I'll add the other four stars. It's a 5-star game but you lose 4 stars for lying.

Changed my rating as I've played longer. Events are fully pay to win. Skins in themselves have no way of being obtainable unless you throw out a ton of cash into it. It isn't simple like a standard cosmetic in other games either, it is something where you have to either still pay and compete against others to obtain, or pay a high amount to get an unreasonable amount of points to obtain which getting the points falls on chance. They added one skin that is "free to obtain" no where as nice.

Game is nothing like the ads describe. Hate this manipulative advertising. Why not just make the game that you advertise. This is just another city builder game like Clash of Clans, where you are stuck waiting on timers to build/upgrade buildings. The ads showed a survival game that had you collecting meat, wood, and other items to build up a fort by offering the collected items to specific locations. This game is not that at all!

Looks nothing like the advertisement. The gameplay is a complete fabricated advertisement at best. I installed this game based on the advertisement (it showed up on another game I was playing) and the gameplay on that advertisement. To say that the advertised gameplay is misleading, is an understatement. After a while of playing this game, I started to like it... BUT everything got so repetitive as well as "pay to win" and "pay to gain" being and recurring theme. Not worth installing.

Like many other games, the "screenshots" have nothing to do with the actual game. It's absolutely NOTHING like the pictures shown, and I've reached level 10. I haven't seen a single screen like what's shown. UNINSTALLED🚫 (with a vengeance for false advertisement) update: Century Games PTE. LTD.10/31/25Dear Chief, the ads only show a tiny portion of the game, please play the game to experience more! Get bent

after playing the ad game for this, I installed it and played for a while. it is never like the ad game. it's the same as kingshot. you upgrade a town, play mini games in order to gain resources to upgrade the town. eventually you interact with other players and their towns. maybe if the ad was for the actual game id have enjoyed it, but it wasn't.

So here's the deal, the game actually isn't too bad. The problem is that it has way too many options and a huge learning curve. They seriously need to post videos on the entire game explaining everything. They do have some type of guide but it's 2025.. make a video...I also hate when you get a notification it flashes for 1 sec before disappearing.. no time to read it at all.. The game is obviously p2w You just have to deal with it at this point in life.

Super bummed. Downloaded because I enjoyed the ad during another game. Kept playing it until the ad forced me to the play store. Sadly, this game is NOTHING like it's ad. 🙃 And don't bother leaving the standard response I read on other similar reviews. I will not be sending the ad link to customer support. If you don't know the ads for your own game, I don't think it's likely you care to fix the problem. Just wish now I could find a game like your ad.

Nothing to this really. How to get heros is very vague. Nothing here I would spend money on. Rinse and repeat. If you don't want to think and just click buttons then this is the game for you. No discovering anything, no walking around, stuck in one place, heck you aren't even really a character. It's similar to having a live ant farm, minus the chores.

over been playing for a week just to be fair, but the gameplay has no relation to the adds. you tap a piece of land with a box around it, tap build, wait. rinse and repeat with increasing wait times. to pass the time waiting you can explore. use heros to explore and gather resources by placing them on a grid and tap flight. you can even tell it to auto fight. if your numbers are bigger you win.

The ads are a lie. The game has you building up a town/encampment as the main part of the game and also send hero units into small group combat missions, which is fine if that's the kind of game you're looking for. However, after a couple hours of play, I never came across any part that even vaguely resembles what I saw and played in the ads. there's nothing necessarily wrong with the game, but advertise what the game actually is, not something completely different.

Their auto response to critiques about the game being nothing like the ads is annoyingly wrong. Saying the ads are "only a tiny part of the game" is actually false, it's not part of the game at all. The wait times for things to level up has gotten beyond ridiculous. I thought I'd give it a try even though it was nothing like I hoped/expected but I've been playing a while now and fully tried my best. This is going to be a no from me. Don't waste your time, skip this game

No gameplay like you see in the advert. I played for nearly an hour. It's just another hero city builder. Uninstalled. EDIT: Thanks for your response, dev. If it's just a tiny part of the game, then it should be a tiny part of the ad...instead the advert falsely leads you to believe you're going to be playing a completely different type of game. I played for an hour after installing and never did anything even remotely similar to the ad gameplay.

This game is quite boring. Not like the ads of course. it's a stripped down city builder. It's slow as molasses as far as gameplay and there isn't a lot to the game. build( all buildings are predetermined with zero flex or customization), research, train, and kill stuff until you run out of stamina. It's factory work except you pay them... if you want to get anywhere.

This game is a total scam, it is literally nothing, NOTHING, like the ads at all, what-so-ever, not even slightly. It's actually a PvP MMO, except the people who pour tons and tons of money into the game just dominate and bully everyone, attacking their bases non-stop just because they can, because they paid for better armies. The game is unbearable.

Ads are basically click bait. I downloaded this game knowing it wasn't going to live up to the ad expectations from the reviews, and I wasn't wrong. The game in general isn't bad, until you get to a certain point and progress practically screeches to a halt. I'm still playing it in hopes that it gets better, but for now it doesn't look good. Edit: Furnace lvl 13, you get to blast the snow away like the ads. I'll add a star for that.

Blatant False Advertising Deeply disappointed. I downloaded this after seeing ads for a survival mini-game where you gather wood and meat to build a camp. I played for several days straight hoping to find it, but it doesn't exist. Instead, this is just a menu-heavy, pay-to-win strategy game filled with long timers and gacha mechanics. Don't be fooled by the fun-looking demos—they are a complete "bait and switch" to hide a generic city-builder.

False advertisement of gameplay to lure you in. Edit: To respond to the developer's comment, that's false advertisement. You only advertise a tiny portion of the game, in your words, yet present that to be the core mechanic of the game while never showing the majority of the gameplay in any ad. So again, false advertisement. There's so many games like this it's crazy, there has to be some sort of regulation with checks and balances put in place, it's wild.

nothing like the ad. the dev keeps replying to this that say that the ad only show a tiny portion of the game, but its extremely deceptive. even the store page shows what the ad was, but none of the "idle builder" that was done to death by now. even the art style of the game itself does not match the ad. do not play. Edit: See that reply? that's also a lie. See what I mean? Its gross misadvertisement. They just copy-paste that reply to anyone mentioning that the game doesn't look like the ad.

First of all, this game is nothing like the screenshots from the Store, and also nothing like the playable ads you are spammed with. It's not a "survival" game, it's some sort of city builder combined with idle mechanics. It's not even challenging, it's fairly easy to manage your resources until a clear pay wall starts to creep up on you. All in all, it deserves one star just for the fact that they're not selling what they are advertising.

This game used to be fun until they became a P2W game. They have done all they can to milk money out of us, and after spending over 3k it's still not enough to get strong. And to answer your question, I was not aware on how much I spent since it's hard to track. I only was able to find out until I added everything up. So stay away unless you plan to spend a SIGNIFICANT amount or if you are in Korean, Japan, and/or China. So sad to have a game I once enjoyed become cash sucker. So heartbreaking.

Disappointed. It is nothing like the one in the ads. In the ads you fight bears, collect meat, rocks, and hire NPCs to do jobs for you. It looks very fun in the ads. In the real game you just press Buil, Upgrade to the infinity. and is booooring af. Just make it like the one in the ads and tell me when you did it. I will come back and change my review.

This is a cool game with a lot of fun things to do. BUT.. you need stamina to play, and it runs out quickly with no way to recharge quickly other than to buy packs. Also, to keep upgrading buildings, troops, etc. You need to buy packs to get anywhere. The dev are making a ton of money on this game, that's why I can only give a 3 star rating. There needs to be less time waiting for upgrades and training. And stamina should be offered as gifts in rally, lighthouse, and other daily play.

The pay to win mechanics are too obvious and pronounced. Waiting times are long and arbitrary and get exponentially longer as you progress in the game. The process for account deletion is long and tedious. Do yourself a favor and note down when you registered your account with the game, as you will need that information (along with a lot of other nonsense) once you wish to delete it again.

The gameplay is extremely fun, balanced and enjoyable.. well until you've played for about an hour. Soon you will realise that this is just another pay to win game where you need to spend money if you want to progress at a reasonable rate. Obviously you aren't forced to spent money, but if you want even one chance at keeping up with other players and advancing quicker than a snail then you are basically forced to spend money. If you don't have deep pockets then don't even bother installing.

Man another day another ad that I wish implemented the controls from the ad :' ) I really like the 'drag finger around to incrementally collect stuff and deliver items to upgrade them' style, add in the little 'test' bit at the end of ads like those. This and Townville both have the same problem of appealing ads that get me interested, but it's not at all what the gameplay is like.

False advertisement, in my opinion. I installed this game because of the ads, and i thought it was a simple and relaxing one player game. Once i played it, it had too many buttons, too many options, too much for my brain to comprehend at one time. it was so confusing and people would message me contact me and ask me about things, I would always get confused, and i uninstalled in about a week to less than a month. Not good if you want the ad. Good if you want a complicated butt load of options.

Unreal. Been playing this game well over a year. The blatant lie this game runs. It angers me. Seeing the current ads, it's not even close to actual gameplay. It made me stop spending. I was gullible for spending in the first place. My advice to new players? Don't spend unless you wanna spend your entire life savings. Cause that's the only way you'll reach the top. My advice to the developers? Hide your ads from current players to avoid bad (re)ratings and reviews.

DONT INSTALL. NOT AS ADVERTISED. The game isn't like the ad. I've been playing for 2 day without seeing what was advertised. Show people what the game is actually like. Or even add the ability to play it like shown in the ads. I'll play it for a bit more and if it takes forever or that functionality isn't there then I'll keep the low rating. Bating users isn't good. Response to developers: Make the game have a mode where you can play like it is advertised. I will update the review if you do.

Most frustrating game I've ever played and I finally uninstalled it. I've played for about a year and made good progress, but new events give major rewards to "pay to win" players to just come in and destroy the free to play accounts. I logged in this morning to 2/3rds of my progress wiped out, and I can only imagine they allow this unbalanced level of gameplay to encourage people to spend money. Don't waste your time.

Well, I'm certain, that this company must be a subdivision of a bigger one, as the gameplay concept is the same with many other games. In the beginning, you can start off quickly but later, techs, buildings and other things takes days (33 days). You can speed them up but that's not going to be by much later on. The military units are the same as basically in every franchise of this game: infantry, marksman, lancer. They don't even hide that they're related. For me, I don't like this kind of game

I played trial on duolingo went out to killing the bear, grilling meat, made hamburger, selling it, made money, hiring staff. It's seems like easy and fun. So, I downloaded it. Nothing like any ads you might have seen. It's fun at the beginning but there's really no strategy involved, just click buttons endlessly, you can't lose unless you really aren't paying attention and even then. The game heavily tries to make you pay for things, which is fine but it gets a bit annoying. Pay for something and then immediately see another more expensive package for useless stuff.

First thing first - it's nothing like the ads. Sure, I gave it a try anyway. And I know what this game is like - it's a pay to win. You can be dumb and never read the texts, or never knew what the heroes do (whether they're good for defense or bear or opening rallies), but as long as you're willing to spend thousands, you're "strong". The packs: terrible value. You could pay for a battle passes in other game to enjoy the benefit for a month with the same price of one time benefit in this game.

The Ads are Lies. I downloaded this app based on the ads but like so many ads these days, the game is completely different. It quickly became apparent that it was mainly a multiplayer game with alliances and you raid or get raided by other players and you train troops. This is not my kind of game, and had the ads shown these elements, I would not have installed it. On top of that, I'm trying to delete my account but even with everything filled out for the request, it wants more and won't submit.

This game was funny, interesting, awesome, etc. However much higher level players are entitled to attack your city whenever they feel like it, as many times as they want. The only option to avoid those abusive and destructive attacks is by buying, with real money, some "shields". THAT IS UNBEARABLE. I already sent my request to delete my account, and they answered that they will analyze in 15 days if they accept it!! Nevertheless, I am uninstalling the game right now. I am deeply disappointed.

Warning! High spending needed in this game. Confirmed by support team. This game is set up that High spending is needed for success. The highest spender will have the most control. With this control they can limit your game play 50-75% making it pointless to play. Do not download unless you have a gaming budget. I really wish I could add screenshot to show you.

Absolutely NOTHING like the ad was!! But, it seems like it can still be a fun game, except the constant loading after every little thing you do is ridiculous! It would be one thing if it was 5 or 10 secs, but it's literally 2-3 minutes every time! I would consider rating higher if not for that - I'm getting frustrated enough to delete it at this point.

This is not like the advertisement AT ALL! I would give zero stars if I could due to the lying through false advertisement. The ad (both versions with the polar bears) portrayed this as a single-player game with tasks; the game itself requires more to do. If you like that, then that's fine; I enjoyed the calm, peaceful, and simple advertisement, which would have been nice to play after a stressful day

Great game until you hit furnace level 10. At that point your troops are greatly outgunned and you can be attacked as many times someone wants. One right after another. By someone levels above you. I can see getting attacked once and then you get a shield so all of your supplies don't get reduced to nothing, but that is not the case. This makes it nigh impossible to continue upgrading. That is absolutely trash.

the playable ad that led me to the game is nothing like the actual game. the story is a waste of time. voice acting is kinda weird. it's not much more than push and hold, numbers go up, like all other idle Mobile games. would be nice to see some innovation someday. this isn't innovative so far but I may find something if I keep playing... but that's not very enticing at this time

Honestly the core gameplay is pretty fun. Slowly and steadily building out your base is pretty rewarding. But because it takes time to build everything up it makes it very easy for someone with more time or money than you to come in and wipe out everything. In my case the day after the "rookie protection" ended someone no less than 4 times my base strength came and wiped out about 50 hours of progress. Not going to lie, the second you get out of the tutorial you get your teeth caved in sucks.

Unfortunately one of those extreme next level false advertising scams, you made a decent strategy game, which is why i still give it 2 stars, but you should advertise as such. You advertise with puzzles(which degrades your game and hopefully is not in it) and a server style game(which was an extremely fun game, I stayed on the interactive ad till it forced me to the play store) but unfortunately 30min into the game which is more than enough time imo I did not receive any of this ad's gameplay.

Not badly designed, but also not much to do. Basically a mobile take on Frostpunk (I mean, it's in the name). It feels like it's trying to be a sandbox - very little plot or quests & tutorial ends very fast. But you can only place buildings in designated locations. Each building upgrade has pretty strict requirements. So you're supposed to sandbox, but also theres only really one way to do things? The game also does not resemble its ads at all, which to me looked pretty interesting.

Taking your money. Don't other playing. Firstly, the quality of the game is not as good as supercell. It is still in 2000s graphic. Yes, its free to play. By f2p, you will just lose out to all those that spend. So that's the imbalance. This way it just make you want to spend. Now that I want to delete my account, it take 15 days to review. Why? because they just want to keep my account for their marketing how many players are playing or hope I return back to play. worst game ever.

The game locks progress behind paywalls with no option to earn progress through gameplay. Here's an example: If you want to power up one hero in particular, you have to spend nearly $300, and there's no other way to power up that hero. You can't even use the real money currency (gems) to power them up. You have to buy two $100 packs, multiple smaller packs, and you have to pay to become a VIP just to have the option to buy those packs. I've never seen a more disgusting money grab in my life.

BADvertising. Fake gameplay (puzzle/efficiency game) which was actually hiding a P2W base building war game. Had they not tricked me into playing a completely different game, I would never have installed it. Now that I've made it through the tutorial, I can see what it is... and it's not worth my game. Nor can I get back the time I lost. 0/10

not the game displayed in ads. if it was, it would have gotten a better rating for uniqueness. it is the same exact game as all the other collect resources, fight other players, beat stages. the only thing this does that is different is the cold weather. that's what gets it 2 stars. It would be 1 because it's not even the advertised game. edit: After playing the game longer, i decided to up the rating. It's fun. but still not the advertised game.

Not the game that is advertised. I wanted to play the game I kept seeing ads for where you control a man with swinging axes chopping trees and killing polar bears and collecting wood and meat, then building a fort and cooking the meat to sell. downloaded the game, and it wasn't remotely close to what I seen in the ad. very disappointed in the false advertisement.

It is kind of fun, sure, but it is quite clearly just designed to suck the most money out of its players, rather than actually being a better game. It starts off being a survival game where you expand your base so that your people survive. And then you quickly level up to a point where that is all meaningless - it just becomes slow upgrades that you can pay to speed up, and gambling events that you have to pay to complete fully... I have played for months, but it just stopped being fun

I got banned for getting a refund I got by mistake. Was told to play I had to repurchase it. I'd already spent over £200 on the game so it's quite pathetic and petty to do that over a purchase in error. The game itself is ok. Nothing special but it kills time for a disabled person. Don't believe the ads you see, the gameplay is nothing like them. It's also a bit confusing at times as well.

Not like anything on the ads, which is a bummer for me since it was exactly the kind of game i was looking for... But its not. Tho, i did find myself enjoying the game for a few minutes, it was not the type of game i signed up for so i ended up uninstalling after. Dont get me wrong. Its good, it think. Just not what i was expecting. Rookie mistake really. Shouldnt have trusted the adds 😂.

This started out fun. But then as in any game you encounter the bullies who spend tons of money to become super strong and constantly attack you. it became less fun really quick. my city constantly on fire. Troops dead. It takes long enough to build up and gather resources just to have people attacking you constantly. Don't waste your time with this game.

I am uninstalling this until the game improves it's economy. If the devs want to monetize the game they should do it with in-game decorative items or event items that don't affect their levels and gameplay. I played this game with friends and we are not that rich to buy the levels and even if we start from the beginning in a new world there will always be people who are 5 or 6 levels ahead just by buying their levels and ruining other people's progress by raiding with high lvl troops. I hate it.

I saw an ad for this game and it looked awesome—making swords, fighting a giant polar bear, and using the meat to upgrade stuff. But when I downloaded the game, it was totally different from what was shown in the ad. It’s mostly just building and upgrading, and there’s barely any action like the ad promised. I was pretty frustrated, honestly. It’s just not what I expected, and felt like a waste of time.

This fun, but nothing new. Just the same build your city and harvest your resources in order to do so game like all the others. About level 7-8 is when it becomes more of a pay to play game as you have to start waiting longer for builds and the store gets unlocked etc. I have yet to come across anything like I've seen in the ads that got me to download this in the first place as well.

Completely unbalanced game. No limitation on who (which level) you can attack, which makes weaker players can't progress on this game as you lose everything quite fast, which is quite frustrating. Takes weeks to build up an army and then can loose it all in a matter of hours if higher player decide to take you out. Only for serious players. Not at all for casual players. Also, not at all as advertised in the adds.

The game is not as advertised. This is designed in way that makes you purchase more and more overtime making you think you are falling behind. Except the social element of the game nothing in it is actually as advertised and the gameplay is slow. In the game are players referred to as whales and people spend serious amounts of money to stay in the top. Free to play people do not have chance to enjoy it as some items and rewards are available only after purchases.

Last time I played it was just a simple civilisation game. At first due to ads, I was expecting something interesting. However, of course like all phone games with their deceptive ads we got something that is less than profound and uninteresting. Yes of course it's a build up to survive in the freezing cold (kind of) but it is nothing like the many games that tries to pretend to be, in all of the ads that I have seen.

Had to do some digging into the reviews to find out exactly what i thought. This game kept popping up as an ad on drag racing but the gameplay and everything is totally different from the ad/demo i tried. The pictures on the game store page show the game i was playing, but when i downloaded the game, its absolutely nothing like it. I kept playing for a few days to see if there was a way to change worlds or something but theres no way its the same game.

Bad support, payments often fail. It's too bad, this game was pretty fun otherwise, nice fun with alliance. But, it's a full on p2p (a very expensive one at that), where they gamified buying pretty well. However, transactions often fail, you then don't get the bonus you paid for in time, and support is completely clueless about how the game works, and refuses to refund anything, total waste of money. I'd recommend to stay away from this game, don't get sucked in, the devs behind are pretty bad.

While this game definetly deserves more than 3 stars I believe it can be improved further, It would be nice if resources could run out faster, that way you would have to think about the best course of action on how to survive. This is a survival game after all, I suppose it wouldn't hurt if snow storms lasted longer than 12 minutes and were to be a bit stronger than they are currently, otherwise I love this game and would mostlikely recommend it to some friends.

terrible! The ads show you the game as a casual walk around pick up and offload materials. But when you actually get the game its one of those typical wait around for buildings to build and income to come it etc. The ads are lies. The first image is a lie. Its Deceptive just for downloads but its nothing like the ads. Terrible game, its all a lie.

The game is rather nice, but you must play it if you have plenty of free time because the game can become quite a handful. You're away from the game too long and things start to crumble. One huge dislike is there are other people online who can attack your camp, higher level and all. Another dislike is the building queue. You need actual money for everything or your constantly spending gems.

It's a really good game no doubt about it, you'll become preoccupied with a lot of things and so the game keeps flowing. But once you get to a certain point it just stops. You'll have to wait hours, even days for any upgrades to be made the more you progress. And I can't imagine just how repetitive some of these players are, you should make it so if anyone gets attacked the opposite side or anyone in general have to wait 24 hours to attack them again. It's frustrating building back up. I quit.

To start with, THE GAME IN THE ADVERT DOES NOT EXIST. Instant 1/5 stars. That being said it's an okay game, would've rated a few stars higher otherwise. It does seem to be one of those games where eventually it's going to make you spend money to continue playing with it's exponential times to build. The advert and buying system is like something from temu, just trying to bait and tempt you into paying up for "4000% off!" offers.

The game has some merits when it drops the facade and shows its true nature as another f2p mobile base-building game that is actually not all that free (unless you're okay with having a miserable time), but I cannot give it anything other than the lowest score because of false advertising. That fun minigame in the ads? That is not this game. The team behind this game, whatever effort they put for their game, should not get away with intentional deception.

Same as every other "attack other players bases to farm resources" type of game. Does have a unique theme with frozen wastes, so I'll give 2* for that. Otherwise it's the same, the spenders on the server will ban together in their alliance and farm the non spenders relentlessly. If you aren't a big spender, there is little reason to play this type of game, because the big money boys will farm you all day, and you won't be able to save resources to build anything. Same old game as all the others

What attracted me to the game was an ad for building a village in the tundra. I started playing and while the game is fun, I have only done maybe one small mini game like that. Like so many games these days, there are paid options but it can still be fun without dropping any money. Not a main game for me because too many turn out to be something very different from the ads and this is just one more of those.

Absolute waste of time. It's not the game that's shown in the advertisements. I played it for a while but at no point you can guide the characters yourself as shown in the advertisements. You can just say "Go Explore" for example and then you can WATCH them fight some people and you can't intervene and then they win or lose. It's crab. You can't tell me that it will change at some point. It's a total different way of playing.

demands too much attention, to progress requires a lot of tasks that add up to an afternoon I'd rather be fishing. The graphics were good and the characters looked interesting. the story was unnecessary for all the flash. I'm glad there weren't outside ads, but honestly pay for kitsch games are not my thing. I spent the obligatory $3, and now I'm walking away.

Misleading ads. Ignore the ads, they are nothing like the actual game. It is a pay to win game. Build a few predefined buildings in predetermined spots, upgrade heros, grow an army, complete missions, fight against other players. Rinse and repeat. If you want to achieve anything meaningful, you need to put a lot of money into the game.

I have spent over £3,600 on in-app purchases in this game, and I noticed a couple of my transactions had been charged twice, so I had the duplicates refunded with a total value of £54.98. Because I claimed back the overcharged transactions, the developers have banned me and will not unban me unless I re-pay the refunded money, which would then mean I've been charged twice again! Even with the £55 refunded, they still have over £3,600 of my money in the game, which they are preventing access to.

ADS are MISLEADING! Sometimes I need a stupid game that runs well and triggers dopamine like "farmland" This is NOT that game. This has commitments like "Summoner's War"; 800 small tasks to keep you locked in "screen-time-wise" I enjoyed the game when I did try it (before misleading ads); now it's like "Township" They use that satisfying ad to get you to download but the game is NOTHING like that. Maybe one mini-game or intro segment to make sure they don't get sued for misinformation 1⭐

I like this game and what it has to offer, I've been playing for a year already but the contact team is just unbelievably worst, I've been waiting for my issue to get resolved for more than 3 days already and in this 3 days i have been contacted only once(yesterday) after waiting for 2 days already and now I'm waiting again for the next message, the application with so many users paying to play, it shouldn't take so much time just for a contact team to respond. Very disappointing!

Game is really fun! Great graphics and gameplay. My only issues are the building times take way too long! I would rather watch ads and make you guys money that way just to be able to skip time. There are alot of pay walls, but again for those who can't afford it, just add ads and I'll happily watch them to help you guys out, and in the end it helps the players out too! Wish there was more of a story and goal, but overall a really great game! Good job guys! 🖤

The game was fun. After a while gathering resources becomes a chore, a boring one at that, upgrading takes increasingly longer, and high level player will always get the best rewards in events, there's no tier system or ranking (like bronze, silver, etc) and those same people can just waltz into your territory and attack everyone indiscriminately as many times as they want, there's no penalty, no debuff, no nothing, destroying hours if not days of hard work and you can't do nothing. Truly sad.

Let's talk about how broken this game is, I've been playing for two years and things need to change. Farming for materials have different levels and low level towns can't make high level farms, but they can take them from your base. Okay? Getting new items to level your heroes should level with your progress, but I still make the same first level gear and weapons from the beginning? You have to spend money if you want better items from events, over all it's a waste of time. Would give zero stars

I actually preferred the ad version than the actual game. I found myself playing the little demo version during ad breaks on other games and ended up playing way longer than I needed to. Finally decided to just download the real game and the gameplay is completely different. I'm sure it's a fine game and all, but if the only reason you want to play it is because of the demo ad version, don't bother.

Honestly? This game is good. A nice little thing to play during the day. Good time-waster. Why did I give it a 5 star rating? There are NO ADS. NONE. I am as shocked as you. There are ads to promote the in game purchases. But no random, 30 second, pop up ads. Or ads for other things. It is also easy to make gems without buying anything! Not super easy, but definitely doable without you having to buy something. It's Honestly really nice. Refreshing. So... 5 stars. Would recommend. :)

Well, first Of All no Ads in the game that's Really good. But I must say something at least, if you want to be Powerful you have to buy a lot for that and no matter how hard you try as a non buyer of the staff for characters or For some Speed-up for the city. You will lose against all the People how bought the staff and some of them can be really hard to you when you don't buy something. I wish the players wouldn't care about that. Have fun with the game and it's good if you are bored.

NOTHING LIKE PLAYABLE ADS! WASTE OF TIME! It has WAY too much going on in it. I've played for about a day and I'm beyond over it. There are tons of different things you have to upgrade to get to the main upgrade. there are items within buildings and some upgrades depends on other upgrades and you HAVE to be in an alliance and contribute to advance past chapter 10. There are rewards you have to collect from about 10 different places, sometimes even for the SAME thing.

It's absolutely nothing like the playable ad or the screenshots. This is the game Evony with snow. You'll progress rather fast doing base building until you hit around level 10. Then it will grind slower and slower, encouraging you to make micro-transactions to speed up your progress. You can make it easier by joining a strong alliance for support. But if you are considering downloading this based on the ads and screenshots then you're in for a surprise because none of that is in this game.

So far the game is fun if you can stay connected to the server. It locks when you try to enter the game and sticks at the 80% when loading. It took me a half hour to get in the last time (2 hrs ago); and ai had to leave the game and now I can't get back in. This is a week later and I have tried force stopping it and reloading it and even reinstalling it and I am still locked out on the resources loading screen. I have had no word or any help on this matter. It is not my network as it is a 5G.

This game has become just like all the others hurry up and build. Then you must pay to keep up after a certain point to keep up with the players from Asian countries, that either made the game or are just dumping boat loads of money into it. It's also become very stale and stagnant, as there has been no server merges or I'm my servers case no one wants to fight. Oh we have NAP with top 5 so you can't farm anyone or attack anything. It's become quite boring. No new real additions to the game.

Completely false advertising. Ads don't match the game AT ALL. Ads portray a single player collection game, but the reality is a large scale multi player strategy game that consists mostly of people enjoying tearing other of lower game ranks down to shreds before they have a chance to grow unless they are willing to pay way too much for in-game purchases.

False advertising. Pay to win. If you've seen an ad for this in other games or on social media, is not what you think at all. Played anyway. No way to quit. The screen freezes. Audio cuts out. I get spammed with alliance requests literally every ten seconds nott even by the minute. Just read the developers response below. The only thing they can address is the ads but there are a lot I was getting them after every expedition battle. they don't even deny the rest.

I am truly disappointed. I used to play this game and it was actually about survival, managing your townsfolk, taking care of them. Visuals have improved, but for whatever bizarre reason, you've turned it into another one of the unoriginal and boring multiplayer "4x strategy" games. You could have created a new game in that genre. Why swap genres? The game was already great. I'm shocked and disappointed. Now your ads look even more misleading. Shame... One of my favourite games is gone to trash.

Its a good game overall, however, one of the biggest issue with the game in my opinion is the pay to win to grow. The more money you put into this game, the faster you grow. If you try and grow at a non pay to win rate, you'll be attacked by clans which are the ones that mainly ruin the experience for others. You'd have to keep using shields just to stay safe and ward off attacks..

As many other people have said, it's totally not what's shown in the ads. The game uses AI for voiceovers and graphics which make it feel very unnatural. It feels like too much AI and there is not much effort put into it. I just played a similar game (Dark War Survival) and the style, design and gameplay seem to be so similar that it feels like the same game. Both have totally off-topic ads and feel so fake and low quality because of the AI.

There's so much pressure to buy in app packs, and so many predatory tricks to trick you into buying things you didn't even want. I felt physically sick when I realised how much I had spent on this, money I don't have. Even after spending money, you can still be easily crushed by anyone who spends more than you. Their game is free to play if you enjoy being crushed constantly by people who spend all their money. Don't even download it, it's not worth the risk.

They keep updating the server and taking up space on my phone. So much so that I can't download the new version without deleting other important stuff on my phone. Then there is a ton of downtime with construction and upgrading, and a lot of upgrading takes money. need to Make the length of wait time for upgrading buildings shorter. I know you can buy speed up packs, but not everyone can afford that stuff. And make an extra slot for tech learning. a lot of lull that makes this game boring.

If you've played a mobile game where you can't upgrade X because you've not upgraded Y, upgrading Y takes 4 hours, and you can't upgrade Z whilst upgrading Y, you know what kind of game this is.
