Nothing in this game is unique, let alone uncommon. Tastes differ, of course, but if you feel like playing this kind of game, find one with better voice acting and art. I specifically stopped playing because they force you to play with people.

I see how the game can be fun for some if you're into this specific type of game. But if you saw it through an ad, its nothing like the ad at all. The ad is a lie, lol just a heads up. Also keep in mind before you download the game, they make it hard for you to delete your account. You can uninstall it but that doesn't mean your info is gone 🤷🏽‍♀️

the game is nothing like advertised. however I was willing to look past that. until they introduced steel as a mandatory resource to upgrade items in all the buildings you build, and the amount of steel needed is an outrageous amount. the only way to get the resource is to use the exploration feature which requires a certain level of combat power which increased in amount needed quickly. the amount of steel given is miniscule at best. of course you can always purchase steel with your own money.

This is very much a pay to win, and in some instances pay to play game though if you can join a decent enough alliance and then somewhat coast off their trails and successes then you can go quite far in the game. It can be fun to pick up and put down, number go higher make brain go brrr kind of game. It's absolutely nothing like the ads.

too pay to win, can't keep up so no point playing more. Game was fun for a while but now because I don't pay enough to keep up I get kicked out of clans for events, can't play a lot of them or I get immediately attacked by people putting in a lot of $$$ into the game. Even small amounts of cash won't help, people are putting in crazy amounts. not fun anymore.

All this game had to do to win was be like the ads - that was all. The little games you played in the ads were silly and fun. The actual game is totally unrelated. This should be illegal. Also, it burned NINE PERCENT of the battery for less than 5 minutes of play Last time I got suckered into this game, I wrote a review that said you basically had no agency and the game wanted $$$ to speed things along. That's probably still true, but it's the poo frosting on a cake of lies

Nothing exceptional. Game is identical to others, just with a snow theme. Spent a little money to buy the basic pack, but soon discovered that although it took my money, I didn't receive any of the items. Contacted support and given the runaround instead of just giving me the items I paid for. Had to refund through the play store. Best to avoid this one.

It's interesting, competitive and even addictive. I gave it only 4 stars because I feel that they don't give enough rewards for the amount you choose to spend... As in every other game... Also, the app has a minor bug that annoys me...🤷🏻‍♀️ Update: I felt the need to stress the fact that it's waaay too expensive to buy everything that you need in order to enjoy the game at it's full capacity... I mean, 10 euro for each pack? 10 euro is 5 times more expensive in my country's currency... 😒

False advertising: ads are of a single-player, idle clicker game - absolutely NOTHING to do with the game play. It's NOT F2P. It's free to download, yes, but if you actually want to play, you have to spend $$$. Y'all, & every other game like this (Evony, Ant Legion, The Ants) have taken Kingdoms of Camelot & bastardized it with your greed. Hard to get "help" when majority of the alliance is asleep on the other side of the world. Very glitchy & will overheat your device. -10,000 review!! >:(

Nothing at ALL like the ads... Liars get bad reviews... Well... Its relatively okay despite the lies, but its just a stereotypical game. Its the type of game where you have a little base you build buildings on, and tnen you click "world" once you get to a certain level, and now you can send forces to other players, or external resource gathering points. Like games like Kingdom of Heckfire...

DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME!! If you liked the adds for this game then you'll be HIGHLY disappointed! This game is NOTHING like the adds and has NONE of the in add gameplay AT ALL. It's a weird game where you only upgrade buildings and a "furnace" in the middle of the city to manage warmth. There are "heros" you use to go "exploring" which is only a level based fight with random enemies for resources. This game SUCKS and would get boring QUICKLY! MAKE THE GAME LIKE THE ADDS!!

Don't download this if you're here for fun instead of being a strategic madman spending 24/7 on the app. Well made app, but wouldn't call it a game. "Players" treat this like it's world war 3 or something. I downloaded it for fun and to try it out but there's so much pressure and berating if you are not a top notch player who is pay to play and knows how to do everything perfectly. Great game but the play experience sucks. Oh and also, wanna delete your account? 15 day review of your request!

Even though it's so much fun playing this game, after reaching a certain amount of leveling and powering up, it asks for money when you are trying to build something. Nice graphics but a complete waste of time in my opinion. Edit: replying to the creator, i tried leveling the iron mine and the cabins and it kept giving me a "Either pay for this pack or employ for (2) days with 1020 gems" and i couldn't skip ir anything. So lets just say that is not free.

The overall game is fun,& addicting. Quite the amazing world building game, but I'm giving one star because it ultimately becomes a play to win game. If you start an alliance within the game, and try for the main goal of that state, someone else is going to come in and pay a couple hundred dollars and basically overpower you and destroy everything you've built. Ive played this game for going on 3 weeks now, and I have two characters, one I spent money on, and one free, guess which is better?

Downloaded because I liked the ad. The game play is far more extensive and detailed than the simple ad was, which I found annoying, as that was the whole reason I wanted it. You can't enter the game without the same advertisement every single time. Some of the purchase packages have deceiving names, such as "construction cue pack", which I purchased for an additinal line to build 3 buildings instead of the default number of 2. It only gave you power ups. Waste of time and money, they got me.

Just a typical pay to play game. If they used their talent to make something playable then I am sure it could be great. They draw you in with little games on the advert and these have nothing to do with the actual gameplay you will experience when you download it. I imagine these games either go one of two ways, you either get hooked and spend a fortune, or you just get bored fairly quickly and lose interest. I was the latter!

EDIT: The process to delete your account is a tedious and unnecessary form, that then is given a 15 day review period before needing to log in to finish deletion. This is very suspicious, and I would advise never downloading. *** The Advertisements are nothing like the game, and the game it actually is, is just a super strict railroad city builder. You have no choices or customization, and the gameplay is absurdly repetitive. Just a time waster till it's a mental chore one week later

actually i was interested in the little isometric cooking game that i played in the ad. really aimple gameplay loop, kill bears, get money, give to customers. opening the game, it was nothing like the ad and seemed to be like some kind of town building game? i got tired and watching the intro cutscenes (i do not care about whatever story at all) and the art was ugly so i uninstalled.

Decently engaging, but I'm not a fan of how it completely shifts genre around level 10. Both before and after are well done in their own ways, but it's always advertised as building and surviving, and then it turns out to be mostly about alliances and PvP in the long run. Plus, you can really never catch up to the leaders. Fun for a while, but limited.

Absolutely nothing like the demo advertisement suggests. This is a town building game. It's not a bad game, it's just misrepresented. To clarify, the "playable advertisement" let's you harvest meat from polar bears, cook up steaks, sell them, hire workers to help harvest more meat and sell those cooked steaks. This absolutely doesn't happen in the game.

Played this a little over a year and I'm finally uninstalling it. Started off as a game that has a schedule for events I can be online for and ended as a game that controls my entire schedule: when I wake and sleep, if I should have dinner earlier, if I can binge other games with my friends, etc. The game also forces me to compete with my teammates in rankings to get the better rewards, even when we're supposed to be playing cooperatively. Leaving was a hard decision but one that had to be made.

If you have 5Gb of space, and money to spare for upgrades/characters, you can play this Farmville-ish, slow-paced, bait-and-switch game. It is NOT as advertised, nor like the pictures on the info page. What is shown in the ads/pictures is NOT a "small part of the game", and is NOT a "mini game" either. I played for HOURS and never got anything like in the ads. The creators need to stop lying, or the game needs to be taken down. Too bad, the game itself seems to be well built.

Nothing like the ads. Just another base building game Update: It would be weird that the dev team doesn't know the type of ads are run for the game. This game is like evony, tower war, etc where the ads are either one or 2 minor aspects of the game but the vast majority of it is something else that screams microtransactions galore. There are hundreds of games like this. Don't waste your time on this game

It's not a horrible game , but if you are F2P it will be a very slow paced game for you with no way to compete with P2W, they give some good speedups and gifts as a new player but as soon as you reach mid or high game , all of these gifts will practically be pointless, no matter how hard you try , there is no way for you to compete with others, especially if you have Free heroes , the best heroes are impossible to get as a free player .

Played for a year, now deleted! - you can play without paying, but you basically have to be on it everyday & are constantly at a disadvantage (you can be wiped out in seconds if you miss something). The longer you play, the longer it takes to progress. New 'mini games' are constantly being added taking more & more of your time & you have to engage & 'get along' with 100s of other players worldwide to survive. Fun for a while but becomes increasingly demanding & ultimately goes nowhere.

It's not the game they advertise and show in every of those thousands ads they have online. That's a really disgraceful practice. The game is actually a cheap knockoff of Frostpunk but the whole game is on rails and fully guided. So much so that it ends in a ''click here, now click here'' game. Like a monkey working in a factory. The game mechanic, as well as many assets, are literally the same of Lord of Seas from Atlas Studio. I don't know who copied who. Definitely not worth it.

no thank you. just not interested in these types of games. this is a base building type game where you wait for building updates to complete on an increasing timeline. you have to join an alliance with other people/players and you have boring wars against other players. whichever player spends the most real money on their fortress wins. it's BORING!!! the developer knows that too, otherwise they wouldn't make fake ads pretending the game is about hunting bears. it's a trick to get downloads.

This app feels like it was created by a team of psychologists tasked with designing the most efficient way to extract money from consumers. The core game loop puts immense pressure on players to spend to get ahead of other players. Guilds are essential to gameplay and reinforce spending habits by adding a social element to the pressure. There's nothing novel about the gameplay, it's literally just made to be addicting. Rewards for staying constantly engaged. It will leave you feeling hollow.

Seen this advertised a lot in other places. Was excited to play this finally and downloaded it. It kept crashing in the first 5 seconds of the game, like during the first cutscene. Will give this a few months, and will try again. Seems like it'll be fun, but couldn't play it so I had to give a one star rating. I got a response from the developer but it only told me about advertising issues and not the actual issue I was having.

Very average. Avoid. Visually & audibly very appealing, BUT, deceptive advertising (game is very different from the promos), & the game mechanics are frustrating & utterly ridiculous. You literally waste hours waiting for things to regenerate, & it takes HUGE amounts of time just to make simple game buildings, eg a level 16 furnace takes more than 28 hrs of real time. I'm not joking. Also, key elements of the game are not available unless you pay for them first. All of this ruined it 4 me.

Another game that is NOTHING like the adverts 😓. You are sucked into one of those games that require you to have fights that can be automated, build your facilities for research, combat and exploration outside your city where you're frequently asked to join an alliance (yeah one of those games) which means your city will eventually get attacked and you do it over and over again🙄. 😤😫The advert games you get playing other games is better, well its the reason why I downloaded it.😒

First, not as advertised. There's ads in other games and the actual gameplay is nothing like this. Which isn't surprising. The first part of the game is a simulation which I love. I uninstalled immediately when I got to troop training and saw that its also a war game. I have no desire to build and be attacked. If I wouldn't have downloaded if I knew thats where the game was going.

Massively pay to win and overpriced. If you're not in the top alliance, eventually you'll get attacked and you can loose close to nearly everything, making all the money you've spent and all the time you've put in thrown in the bin. On top of that, UK players are being ripped off. From talking to other players, £5 = $5 in the game, but we all know that £5 doesn't equal $5, that's not how currency works, so essentially UK players are being ripped off. How is that even legal?

Pay-to-win and nothing like the ads. Save your time and money and don't play. The developers don't care about balancing the game mechanics as long as they can find a few whales to take advantage of their spending problems. I played for 4 months, and there are 2 pay-to-win players who are invincible and destroying the entire state of 100s of players, and there is nothing anyone can do about it. Developers won't help or balance the fighting mechanics.

Game with good idea, like development and team work. Disappointing is that, if You spend more money, then You are getting stronger than others. Basically who spends more is stronger. It's not about Your skills and ability, it's all about money in this game. Some players are purchasing insane amounts, and You can't even touch them. You don't have a chance against them at all. Like in my state, one guy has 411 m power, where the average is around 55-60 m.

The gameplay is unoriginal. It's a copy of Evony, Clash of Clans, etc. The ads for this game are extremely misleading. The game is nothing like what is shown in the ads. After a day, the time to complete a building becomes extremely long unless you start spending money to speed things up. This games also runs heavily in the background and drains your battery quickly. Shortly after installing it, Android gave a warning about it running in the background and suggested putting the app to sleep.

How do you offer a demo of the game, a lot of fun. Then after download its a completely different game. been playing for some time, haven't seen the gameplay from the demo at all. Would have been a cool game if that was what I was looking to play. 🤔 *The game is cool and offers enough rewards to play without paying. But the monetizations can be somewhat oppressive.

It runs pretty smoothly and is a decent time killer up until you find out there is no "free will" essentially, the game is nothing like the advertisements, is the most generic empire game ever, is entirely designed to get you to spend money and has about 20 levels before it's just the same pointless 3 tasks over and over again. There is no risk, no challenge and barely any gameplay if you want to call it that even. It's just a time waster in the end.

Full of the usual paypig bullies. the usual type where all the high-level players agree not to attack each other for an event but farm all the lower level newer players. if you have played any game like this, you know what I mean. It was good for a couple of weeks but that is about it. Don't waste any money on it, though the monetisation is disgusting, and your money has far too little value for this greedy little pile of disappointment.

I want to like this game but it disguises itself to be something it's really not. I was on board at first because I thought it was actually going to be a survival simulation. Then it draws the curtains back and surprise it turns out to be another "strategy" games! Giving 1 star because it can't even advertise what kind of game it actually is. considering it's also modeled after other p2w "strategy" games I wouldn't be surprised if this is also p2w. I'm not sticking around to find out.

This game totally sucks. You're constantly being asked to build things but not sure where the supplies come from. Story started ok but was quickly thrown away. You're a female in charge of running a whole camp out of no where. You can have some battle or something but can't control most of it. People will complain in camp but you can't find a way to fix it. It is so dumb. If you wanna just click click click w/o this works for you.

Gameplay nothing like ads. The available battle parts are completely disappointing. While the rest of game plays like a strategy RPG. Worrying about first being able to upgrade one building or buildings before being able to upgrade a different building. Played for an hour and soon realised that these were the focus areas, making a lot of time wasted on trying merely upgrade or being able upgrade before being able to progress or have anything resembling fun game play.

It's a good game! Only and major drawback is that this a strategy game but doesn't require skill, you can't play competitively with other's if you don't spend money.Being honest lots of game is out there who have in-game purchases but in this game strong heros are not available if you don't spend money, a new player will come and easily overtake your power as you don't want to spend money. Anthor thing is false advertisement, whatever the add this game provides it's a false.

Game itself is good at first, but it's really just another carbon copy of games like War and Order, Last Survivor, Age of Origins, Dominations, Envoy and countless others. It's a pay to win conquest style game and nothing like the survival style game it started off as or that was shown in the ads. It's just another boring "build and upgrade a city with increasingly stupid build times as you go and build a big army that you need to invest money in" type of game. I'm just sick and tired of them.

Game is nothing like the advertisement. Edit after their reply- The gameplay is 100% different. As soon as I downloaded it, I realized that I've already played the game and gotten pretty far, but the ad was SO different from the real game that I couldn't tell. There's no misunderstanding on my part, just false advertisement on yours. Next time the ad pops up, I'll just screencap it.

It's a cute game, and pretty fun without money. It's very thirsty for your funds though, and there's lots of "Buy Me!" type of ads woven into the gameplay. It's nothing like the demo, but it's better than the demo so there's that? It's totally pay to win, but do you expect any different from mobile games?

It's a demanding game full of sweaty tryhards. If you're looking for an AFK game you can actually enjoy, try elsewhere. Back to back events means you spend more time trying to keep up with the whales than you do improving your own situation. And you will always have one group that's allowed to run around beating people up, but you're not allowed to fight back or else you get kicked from your group. Such a horrible setup. The game has potential, if it stopped pitting people against each other.

I enjoyed the fun of working with my friends. I played for over a year. I have level up play all the ingames plays. Worked with friends in svs. In the end, a mistaken purchase was made. I told them immediately I purchased something for .99 cents it went through for $99 did not want the product. They said I had illegally refunded. I did not use the item and told them they could have it back. Refund my money. They want me to buy $99 worth of useless items to play now.

Don't play it you aren't willing to spend a lot to accomplish mediocre things. This company does not value you for what you are asked to spend. I have hit a huge paywall block at the level 30 hump. Everyone in my alliance seems to be willing to spend hundreds on this, I get so little progress and am walled off by specific items that are rarely dropped without purchasing packs. I was in the top 5 having spent on a few packs. at level 27 I was passed into fire gem level 3 before I could reach 30.

Fun game if you're with a good alliance, decent PVP and mini games up to a certain point. Then it becomes repetitive, consumes a lot of time and an absolute money pit to stay competitive. If you're not spending €100s/month and in the top active alliances you will not have good time. The game is designed to destroy weak and non paying players. Experience as someone who was pay to play.

Constant disconnects, regardless of reinstalling and restoring the game 3 times now. I have a brand new Pixel phone and high speed wifi, customer service hasn't been helpful at all. Hard to run events and fight, when I can disconnected every 5 minutes for 20 seconds. Also, this game just needs a lot of refining. Similar games are far more personalizable and hashed out. No thought put into the alliance system, there needs to be separate leadership roles, not just R4.

The ads are definitely deceiving. However I will say most of the ads are actually mini games within the actual game. Which is fine I guess. But I did not expect to find a fun strategy game and if you get involved in an active alliance it is even more fun. I have been playing every single day for over a month. It feels a little pay to win but it is definitely managable without spending a ton. It is generous during events even when Free to Play. I appreciate that.

Absolutely does NOT play like the demo in adds. Great for the game that it actually is. You build up very quickly and can start raiding other cities very quickly. If you like the "build a town while gathering resources and people and raiding others" type games; you will love it. Update: The game play of this game was absolutely not the same as the ad I PLAYED for 30 min. And I played your game over the course of a few days to find the game play that had addicted me in the first place.

The game was draining my time and energy. It s all about the money. Devs are too greedy. All the events, everything in the game is made to make the player pay real money. Click click click and no fun. The purpose of a game is to have fun. That ship has sailed! Now is about how much money Devs can drain from players. Yes, it's addictive on purpose!

This game makes EA look like a not-for-profit. The gameplay and premise are fun (and very addictive), but unless you want to be irrelevant in events, you have to spend so much money to keep up to even have a shot at getting loot. There are also quality of life issues that need to be addressed such as auto-hunting needing to always have the app open (it's an idle game, so isn't this hypocritical?). Big events also need proper guides for new players - the current descriptions are woeful.

Nothing at all like the adverts. It's like the generic upgrade-your-town-and-then-access-a-big-map-of-other-people-and-alliances. If you like them it's probably quite a good one, but the play store was full of them a while back so they have become boring. It also rushes you through upgrading your town and gets you quickly to the part where you have to pay or progress at snails pace. That's where I always stop these "games" - (money traps aiming to get you hooked and enticing you to pay)

Gets repetitive. I played intensely for 2 days, joined an alliance, leveled my village, opened a whole bunch of new buildings... But it was all the same. Clicking something, waiting for the upgrade to finish, getting materials in ways that became boring. I didn't feel intrigued or attached to characters. Not much strategy or action. No customization. Story-telling could be better. I felt like I was just reading alot of filler. Just a time-waster once you get past the beginning.

The demo in the ads is extremely different than the actual game in terms of gameplay. It also feels like just a watered down Clash of Clans, there's not even much in the way of strategy. Since it feels like deceptive advertising, it loses 3 Stars. The art style is nice, though, and can be used to kill time, so I won't give it just 1 Star.

As others have said this game is nothing like the ads for it. I also agree with other players saying this game is definitely skewed towards pay to play players. My city and alliance constantly get attacked and raided by others that are much higher levels, and it is hard to level up to defend yourself without paying a ton $$ for bonus packs. I hate that you cannot invite others from another state, that is the worst part, I can't play with my daughter, we are in different states! Will uninstall.

Not as Advertised. I've played for a long time and am level 18. I've never seen anything like the ads. They're a lie & the responses to comments similar to this are also (obviously) untrue. No amount of time will bring you the game you played in the ads *edit/additional* As previously stated, the replies from the developer are untrue. I haven't ever seen an event or side quest that's similar to the ads.

The ads you see for this game that are shown while playing other games, depicts slaughtering polar bears and catching clown fish to feed an endless supply of bots. The game you download is not that and it's not even close. You will be base building, buying and leveling heroes, and waiting for players with more better gear to visit your base and undo that effort. Highly recommend this for someone with limited to no aptitude.

Ads are totally fake, not even related to gameplay you don't drive a truck, build roads for cars, or anything like it. The game is a massive pay to win, high package prices. If you don't spend at least 1,000 $ a month you will always be behind. Events are rigged, matchup always against players you have no chance of winning, even if on par, they will outspend you. So what's the point of even downloading this deceptive game? Nothing, a waste a time.

It's another build your town and train troops to send out but winter theme. There is nothing that sets this game apart from the other thousands that are like it. It gets repetitive very quick and it's honestly dull waiting hours on end for simple things to upgrade. The combat system is just a basic click a button and wait till its over. I would give it an even lower rating just because it simply is that unoriginal.

Played a short demo through the ads, was interesting, came to Play Store, looked at thumbnails, seemed alright, then downloaded the game. When I tell you it's two different games I just experienced, I mean it. Look at the second thumbnail of this game. That is what I played in the ad. That was fun. The actual game? Something like a pay to progress slow grinder. What a hoax...

I am giving this game one star based on the fact I wanted to play what was advertised in the ad, which was a man killing polar bears for meat that you had to give/feed to a line of people. The game is NOTHING like the ad, and very misleading. It's just another city builder game. People would actually want to play your game if it was what was advertised. So sick of false advertising.

GET OUT! While this game does well to attempt to make you part of a "team", it'll cost you. The game offers to be "Free 2 Play" but to actually make a decent dent in your progress in the game you will be "encouraged" to spend money on a ridiculous amount of packs that expire in 7 day to 30 day time limits. So you'll be continuously encouraged to buy time after time after time.

Nothing like the Ad. The top alliances and players are the ones who constantly drop big bucks in the shop, and it's like this in every server / state. The game has no long term playability for free players. Participating in a majority of events only leads to days of recouping troops, and no actual winning. Game devs are greedy and only implement minor changes or ones that increase their revenue. This game could have been great, but for now I'd avoid wasting your time and money.

You can get gems more easily here than you can with other games. The winter wilderness setting is different and interesting. This game is great and those points make it better, or more addicting than other similar games. I would like to, however, humbly request the developers to do something about nap10 and witch hunts. I know whales are where they get their money, but top 10 protected while it's ok to go after underdogs? It's endless and not for any event. They will destroy you for fun!

This game is nothing like what's being advertised. Completey different. It's false advertising. The real game, while fun at first, is hugely a PVP game where if you're not spending massive amounts of money, you will never be on top. Which is understandable. But the game can get very toxic, especially a few months in when you start playing against other states. Edit: And the developers generic "innocent" response of show me the link for the false ad is bull. You guys know what you made.

Nothing like the ads. I was excited to download cuz I liked the addicting 'brain-numbing' gameplay in the ad where you don't do much... just collect meat/wood, get coins, expand city, and repeat. Nope. It's immediately much more complicated once you join the game and honestly just rlly annoying, like the ad version would be cheaper and easier to run, but for some reason it's actually a tedious game that requires effort and time?? wth! 1 star bc misleading + apparently the game still sucks... 😅

For as much as the ads for this game absolutely do not represent the gameplay at all, I really enjoyed my time. I had to uninstall/quit though because after a certain point, you have to rely on being social with other members, and it's a TOXIC community. New players get put together in new servers, but that doesn't stop old players from infiltrating and bullying everyone. I would have kept playing if I didn't have to rely on other rude/bossy players to keep progressing.

I got interested because of a playable ad that kept popping up for me on another app. After awhile of trying the demo then I decided to download the game. This game is nothing like the demo I played. Bait and switch. Could be a decent game but after playing it a bit and not even resembling the game I had tried and was expecting, then I deleted it because it seems like a pay 2 win game.

Linear game designed for wealthy people who don't like critical thinking. The base game loop is not fun, it it just an endless management grind with pretty colors and animations. The game is constantly asking for your money to progress faster, but there is no strategy to it. Your choices don't really matter that much in terms of base gameplay. For example, there is no technique to growing your economy efficiently other than paying money or grinding. Also, there is no killing bears for meat.

Nothing like the ad. Just your normal base building game where you join an alliance and get to level 15 only to have some level 80 come and attack you 8 times killing all your troops and taking your resources. I'm just glad I didn't spend any real money on the game yet. Not once did I kill some creature to get meat to sale to others, which was the ad I saw. Games need to stop lying in their ads!

DON'T GET IT!!!!, the ad is completely misleading. The game you're downloading is not the game you play in the ad. if the devs or ad team don't believe in their game enough to be honest about the actual game you get then neither should you. The amount of downloads for the game are built on a facade and the high ratings for the most part are probably fake too. It's a shame because the game itself isn't bad but this trend of promoting games that don't exist or aren't real HAS TO STOP!!

terrible game. every event is geared to be borderline unwinnable unless you buy something. what you buy is either temporary or gets undercut as you go, requiring more money. if you try to keep the game flowing and progressing, get ready to spend $5 a day on average. I can't recommend this game less. the company pretends they have free content but it's a swindle. you can't reasonably have success and when you do build some capability you find the status temporary unless you pay to keep it.

Love this game and have made a whole community of friends. However, it's absolutely nothing like the ads. Also, Insane pay to play. Its absolutely enjoyable as free to play, but there are players who dump litterally thousands of dollars in and make it nearly unplayable for the vast majority of other players. These whales destroy the competition and drive, so most people stop playing. If there were limitations to P2P, or skins instead of level ups, a lot more players would stay and enjoy more.

Sick of seeing an ad for this game every 30 seconds. And the actual gameplay has never been quite the same twice, which leads me to believe this is your classic "Mobile Game Falsely Advertises One Minigame and Pretends it's the Whole Game" scam. 99% of my ads for the past year or so have been for this game so now I know to never actually play it. That's what such an aggressive advertising campaign can do to your product. I now associate your game with being really frustrated and annoyed

Totally PTW and designed to be addictive and empty your wallet, one micro transaction at a time. I'll give the devs some credit for keeping it interesting after a couple of weeks solid play, with surprises and new gameplay. However, progress does slow down to a snail's pace, and by then you're conditioned to the dopamine hits of constant progress and will increasingly start to think about paying... just as planned. As far as these type of PTW games go.. well, it could be a lot worse.

Very cool concept. I really enjoyed the game at first, but then it becomes just like any other rts. Clans using people, your city can always be attacked. Unless you pay(I'm not sure that is in this game it was in the last one I played). Either way very cool concept wasted on something like this. I had a fun few days, but I am uninstalling it now.

It's a nice game with active players. The downfall of the game is that it's hard to upgrade your top heros without using your cash. The only top hero they do for free is Molly. If you already have those heroes and you draw it again, you gain nothing. Would be nice if they turn it into a puzzle piece. Would be nice if you can draw the other top heros. It's also almost impossible to get their gears, you can buy it in the shop.. but you can only buy it one time a month I believe. The weapons, cash.

This game is far better than most games in its genre, everyone complains about it being a pay to win game, but it's not. They just don't understand the mechanics or how to do a little research before wasting out gems,speedups,resources....ect. This is a strategy game, but yes there are players who spend a lot of money to get further, every game has a few, but doesn't mean you can't play smart. Don't blame the game Devs, because you didnt do your research, i took a star for the lack of good deals

Completely dishonest ads. Even this listing in the app store, not one single "screenshot" looks anything like the actual game or gameplay. It's a good game, incredibly pay to win but free to play. If you actually made honest advertisements and listings, I'd change it to a 5 star rating, but there's no excuse for that scammy behavior.

Terrible game. Rng is just algorithms designed to squeeze money out of you. Horrible support. They won't allow me to bind the account to another email even after i gave them all the info needed,including recent receipts and from the creation of the account. Do yourselves a favor and uninstall. It's a money grab. You will never be able to compete with whales that are putting thousands into gear and heroes that never stop coming.

The game is alright. None of the ads for it in other games are accurate to what the gameplay is like. Everyone seemingly ends up with the same 5 champs in the arena, so the variety there gets old. The art style is okay. Ultimately, I became exceedingly bored of the game after doing dailies for a few months (sometimes not at all). Use your phone storage and time on something else.. It's funny hearing sound effects eerily similar to World of Warcraft in this game. Mostly gems and menu effects.

Nice little game but it's not as advertised. it's also takes days to complete things and you just wait. you need to be in an active alliance to actually enjoy most events otherwise you can't get items or participate. some lovely little side games pop up though. Biggest annoyance is there seems to be an update every month and half and you need almost 2GB free to install them, otherwise you can't get into the game. It's been fun but I'll be uninstalling.

Absolutely nothing like the ads. I expected to have the ad experience, but it's just a typical city builder. You can't choose where to build things like in Age of Empires, everything costs time or diamonds, and the chat is ridiculous. I would give negative stars if I could, just due to the completely false advertising. I repeat, it is NOTHING like the ads.

The game is nothing like the advertising or the photos for this give. There is no placement control or moving of the npc like the adds show. It's a pure builder with pvp. For the record, I played the game for a month, and the developer told me in a response "Dear Chief, the ads only show a tiny portion of the game, please play the game to experience more!" The advertising for the game is nothing like the game is. Don't fall for the false advertising videos.

I was hoping it was more of a survival games but there is too much battling that has to take place. It is not an option whether you have to battle with others, to advance you must battle. I like when I can see visible upgrades and the graphics are great but I wasn't able to zoom in enough to really see the details. I think that it's a great game for those who like more strategy than survival.

When you advertise mini games that exist inside of the game, you should be clear on your ad that the gameplay you see is not representative of 80-90% of gameplay overall. Clear data uninstall. What's funny is I often play games like this and if it'd been advertised to me as a city/town builder styled after command and conquer type games I would've been willing to give it a try. But because you guys choose to falsely advertise what the game is actually about I don't want anything to do with it.

Graphically speaking the game looked great and all but it never played like the promo in the ad. In the couple months I played this never ever...ever was there any cartoonish comical scenes that you could watch. No armed guards pouring stuff down the straw that the fugitive underwater is breathing through. You never get this scene with the two guards laughing then flash freezing. And no, high-fiving a refugee I just saved. The ad is not accurate. Invited to join others constantly.. constantly.

Do not play this game if you don't have money to spend. The developers are very greedy, upgrades cost too much money which only the big spenders can get quickly. You can get some upgrades in games but it will take you months to save. For example, you can't upgrade legendary gear without money as the time needed is only available via money. The new event frost tyrant dragon was just a real mess. It's the worst event ever in mobile gaming history. Please do not install if you won't spend.

Don't play if you can't pay. You'll never keep up with the big spenders if you don't spend. You want the skin from the fishing tournament? Don't bother, the rankings to acquire it have already been bought by big spenders. Very little content for free to play folks and if you're content with that you'll probably get destroyed by a big spender for "playing farmville". There's a reason there's over 1000 states after a little over a year since launch, no-one can play nice and states just die.

This game was NOT EVEN CLOSE to its ad. I played to see what it was about anyways, thinking maybe the ad was of side games. It was not. Quickly found out that it is heavily a pay to win. That would be fine, I'm used to that nowadays. BUT your packages are often not properly delivered and even if you do get the promised items, they aren't as helpful as you think they will be. And don't think Customer Service will assist in ANY WAY. They will send a generic message saying all sales are final.

So I changed my rating from 5 to a 3. From some1 who has spent a lot of money on this game already, I've had to quit and start all over twice. I refuse to do it again. We have whales and common alliances in almost every server who try to over run the game. It takes the fun away bc when trying to communicate, it just ends with smaller alliances being burned over & over.Basically it's do as I say not say as I do. Also, be nice to have the same price in packages as other countries.

Gameplay was NOTHING like what was advertised. Tried it anyways but it's just a boring generic base building "game." There's nothing to it but clicking on buildings to upgrade them - with the option of paying real money to click through faster. Devs, these things hardly qualify as games. Is the golden age of video games far behind us now?

Spent enough time playing to understand you will never stand a real chance in the game without spending any money, constantly asks you to buy "deals" and punishment for not purchasing is restricted gameplay, lower scoreboard rankings meaning smaller rewards meaning longer to progress. "Free" lootboxes and treasure are poor quality items, the game itself has been made to heavily favour pay to win. Great concept ruined by greed.

The game is average, at best. The game just involves tedious activities that are pay to win. If someone isn't paying to win, then they're spending way too much time on this game. There was a good fishing minigame for a couple days. That was the closest thing to fun I had in this game. The main reason I'm giving this a one-star rating is because it is so tedious and time-consuming to remove my account. The community and alliance features were just exhausting. And I never cleared snow like the ad

Pretty fun early on, but late game you don't really stand much of a chance unless you or a teammate is spending tons of money. Parts of the game are pretty bad without spending money (i.e. extra march queues and build slot). Event prizes are unattainable without spending money. Easy to sink hundreds of dollars and still not be better than other players. Also server participation tends to die off late game so it's less fun (probably because people don't want to pay so much money!)

I deleted after 2 months. Wasnt worth it. Its imposible to move from 1 sector to another. You need to be max level and have 30 move passes. No one in the history of this game has been able to move. Just get rid of the option instead of being greedy. They really try hard to micro transaction everything. Cost more than a ps5 game if you add them all. The devolpers have a lot of work to do. Ill just stop playing. Kinda pointless really.

Ads are nothing like the game. I still decided to give it a shot, but there's nothing really original about this game. The mechanics are same as any game in this genre, and it tries to milk you for paid upgrades (extra building queue, extra battle slots, etc.) Uninstalled it after a couple of days after the novelty wore off

Nothing like the ads. I keep getting the one where you start off with an axe, kill the polar bears, cook the meat, and sell it. Seemed fun enough so I downloaded it. It is a civilization building game where you assign NPCs do do stuff for you. No gathering resources like the ads. A game should advertise what it actually is, because some people like this kind of game.

It's a time killer until you get your furnace to about level 14. The games story progression basically stops and the only things to do are research and waiting while you upgrade. The map beasts are broken. Some have low levels but somehow keep beating you regardless of your strength. Alliances are only good for upgrade time reduction. Outside of that, completely useless.

Fake ads. Garbage game. Have to submit an APPLICATION to delete account and you have to fill in the account info yourself as if it's not tracking the game and device state. Just like that other survival game that constantly spams ads, the game does not actually exist. Or if it does, it is some tiny corner of the game. 15mins in and it's just another boring base builder/upgrade game. Waste of time. Zero stars. Delete my account.

The ads make it seem like something greater, if you know rise of kingdoms/any game similar to it. You immediately know how to play it. Plus some ads make it look like the PC Steam game, Frostpunk (come to think of it, that's called lying). It's far away from being the excellent game that is Frostpunk. So, how is it? Think of any modern mobile game after 2016 and you'll understand where the game is at. Go play clash of clans, at least they respect your time and has meaningful progression. :/

I HATE games like this one. I tried it out because their playable ads were kind of fun. This game is NOT the same as its ads in the slightest. It plays just like State of Survival. You have a protected tutorial phase where you level up settlement buildings with a shoddy storyline to accompany it. Eventually, you enter the wider world where you need an alliance and fight other players for dominance. Utter garbage! Why can't I just have what was promised in the advertisements? Just once? Please?

Get to around level 10 furnace and the game is basically over. Nothing left to do but wait 8 hours for a building to complete. Can't attack anyone because everyone has weeks of shields built up. Can't watch ads to speed things up....which just seems absurd to me. No reason to spend money at all on this game. Serious redesign and the devs could be making millions and the players would be alot happier.

Gets very boring after about level 16, Upgrading building or doing tech tree research can take literal days unless you pay for "speedups". Fun for a bit then gets to the point you really can't do much without spending lots of real world cash, and there's not much you can do without upgrading buildings and doing "research". Not recommended. Also, the game is nothing like the add I saw

This game..... Needless to say, it's not like any of the ads for it, but I think that's a qualification for mobile games. The first time I played this, it was the Game of Thrones version, and that was fun but way too crowded. Played that one for a week. This one ramped up really fast. The premise of a family being lost and alone was very appealing, then after about 10 minutes of play, the game said "JK lol, there are thousands of survivors and you know what, forget the story, it's multiplayer

Yet another game that is like every other game where they PRETEND it is about shooting hordes of zombies, or collecting coins, or mining gems, or whatever, and then you collect those things and use them to get a bigger whatever so you can do more of the first thing. except the gameplay is actually just trying to build a village, and you will soon get tired of waiting on the upgrades to your buildings and uninstall the game. Don't bother.

Hopefully, someone will create a survival style game like this that 1. plays like the actual ads for it. 2. is set up a designed just as a builder base, no while away attacks from random ppl. I'd love just grinding and growing no interactions with other players unless I choose to no forced or needed alliances. the rating is for that. bc until the time when you have to join up with in-game players, the game is actually great.

Just another alliance based game where spending money gets the resources to get big enough to pick on smaller, time poor players. I've spent a lot of time in one before. This has many lovely features, but it's not like the playable ad where you're solo gathering resources and upgrading to go out and fight more polar bears. Very loose resemblance to game play.

Fun game to get your boredom pass by, it's a PAY TO WIN game. purchasing expensive packs for few items is not ideal for a gamer, but then again it's your choice to made. You will be playing with some Developer Staff who controls the alliance or the state, they are the strongest and you'll noticed it. So just be cautious on buying packs you might get addicted due to completions. That is based on my personal experience playing the game for 3 months.

Misleading ads. Also wait times prohibitively long to enjoy f2p gameplay. Devs, I know you need to make a profit but if you're going to add a f2p option at least make it useable. Otherwise just make it a paid game with a "box price". I don't like these predatory tactics. You take advantage of the hope that people will lose track of what they've spent with these ongoing micro transactions and it doesn't give me faith in you. I will not use your products.

This is a good lil game to play! A good time waster, no ads, fun game style etc etc The only thing that really bothered me is the socializing. Im a big introvert and my problem is you can't turn off world chat and the constant alliance invites. I thought this was more of a solo game but once I had gotten my 6th invite I was over it. If you can turn those off I'd still be playing but I hadnt seen that in the options.

It's a fun game and the free experience is good for the first couple weeks as everyone on the server builds up and there aren't many wars but as the server matures it will become clear that this game is pay to win, you have no chance to compete against players using real life money to purchase in game boosts and I have been kicked out of clans because I wasn't using RL money to play. I'm sure it's a great game if you pay for items but I'm not wasting money on a mobile game.

There's too much going on with the game. Lots of random terminology, hard to follow things. The gear to upgrade seems unnecessary. There's just too much going on with the game. Plus, like it's been said before, it's nothing like the ads. I'm uninstall ING it now because I just realised that this is not the game I wanted nin the first place! 😅

Nothing really special. Just a depressing frozen tundra theme. The gameplay, itself, is pretty decent. But the only reason I downloaded it is because I saw a bunch of advertisements with samurai, ninja, and other Japanese themed characters. However, after going pretty far into the game, I still haven't seen any of it. Probably not going to keep this one.

Nothing like the ads which is sad cus that is what I thought was fun. if your going to have an ad why trick ppl with different gameplay. the art style is nothing like the as too. terrible! I downloaded the game and played it. I'm disappointed. if you can program it for an ad why you can't have the same gameplay when downloaded. Do not Recommend!

You can acquire every resource in some sort of way through different avenues, except steel. Only through hero battles and exploration can you get it and it throttles the gameplay tremendously. 1. You come to a point in leveling up your heros that you can't battle in exploring anymore and 2. That's pretty much the only way you can get steel. It pretty much halts you to a crawl because of the highly limited way you can acquire it, but it is required in leveling up most everything.

Played the game for like 3 weeks. Downloaded it cause of the adverts, clearly i was clickbaited yet i enjoyed it, Initially. After some playing it felt repetitive, no new thing (like core element that differentiated from other world buildings). Says idle game but come on if you're grinding yourself through leaderboards just some part are idle. Of course, MicroTransactions cause why not. Additionally, forces you to join an alliance clearly when I didn't wanted too.

I tested this game in an ad where the polar bears were attacking but the game isnt at all like that. I do love city building type games which this is similar but its not why I was interested in playing it at all. The mini game ad is deceiving. I'm uninstalling the game. Unless the game changes to include the gameplay advertised and expected, I'm not recommending and will take my time and money elsewhere.

Con job I found this app as an add playing another game. The ad was this, collect resources and fight polar bears, type of thing. Really fun. Then when I actually downloaded it, it's the stupid macro game where you just click boxes to constantly upgrade properties and hero states, but you don't actually fight or play anything... Very annoyed and irritated. Wasted 3 hours hoping the part shown in the add would be playable. Then I looked up the game online and everyone else is mad about the same

The playable ad that I got for this game was really fun and I wanted to play that game... Definitely extremely misleading. Meanwhile, this game is just another game that tries to force you into being endlessly online, playing in alliances and spending real money in microtransactions. I've played a version of it being and it's nothing new. Uninstalling.

Basically, it's a trap. It's something designed to be addictive using a rewards system. As soon as you get to a certain level and you're just invested enough, the building time gets way longer, and you need to pay to finish and as soon as you pay you become financially invested too so it becomes harder to leave. I would not recommend any game that implements this sort of method. Honestly, never pay for a game it only starts a never-ending cycle. Also, all ads are like %70 fake.

It was a really cool and unique game untill I unlocked the "Alliances" part. Having the people survive in the cold was a great game all on its own, now it's all about what group your in and who's working with who. I feel like it really ruined the immersion of fighting and surviving the cold and upgrading the town. It didn't need to be another pvp war game🙄

Boring, isn't there another new character? In addition, the skin of the base, the one bought at the store or events. Also, when there is an allied alliance, their color should be blue so we know if they are allies or enemies. Because when it's red, they know it's the enemy. Also, I hope you add new characters as well as gear with mythic gear.

misleading. the ads shows you playing interesting games, different ones actually making you think oh looks interesting. The actual actual game play is iceman town/city building. starting from scratch with heroes, upgrading waiting to collect materials n such. those mini game on the ad I havent seen one of them after playing like 5 hours plus. this game takes yla lot of your time. if you enjoy that kind then go. I tried this because of those short mini games. i dont have tons of time for this.

Not like the ads!! This game's advertising is 100 times more fun than the game itself, misleading players into thinking it's a more actively involved gathering game they can upgrade while still participating in a hands-on-screen way. instead you get an idle top-down game that requires no real interaction as it gathers everything itself. Either give me the game you showed in the ad, or don't bother to advertise your game as what it's not.

I really don't understand this game it's absolutely terrible! Nothing like how was advertised what so ever! I've been playing a while now waiting for it to pick up and it just hasn't... False game with fake advertising. It's just building stuff nothing to do with harvesting what so ever. Don't bother wasting time like I did the adverts are more fun to play than the actual game!!!

Zero stars honestly. Total joke. uninstalled due to false advertising. This game is NOTHING like the ads, and also NOTHING like the sample pictures at the top supporting this game. The gameplay is also more "pay to play", with timers and countdowns in real time, which takes the fun out of it. Would've kept it if it were as advertised, would've had more potential that way. Nobody likes and wants to support a company that lies to get money from their consumers. There's better games out there yall!

The ads make it look way more exciting than it actually is. I assumed the game would match the fast-paced fun shown in the demo, but once downloaded, it’s a totally different experience. Upgrading your compound takes a serious time investment, and while that might appeal to some, it’s definitely not built for quick, casual play. I can see the potential if you're ready to commit hours and money, but for me, I'll pass.

I enjoyed this game in solo. There are plenty of solo contents to be explored. Yes, the longer you play the game, the longer it takes for upgrades. They give out free packages to skip time quite generously. The reason I'm giving this game 3 star is because just like every other game in this category, overtime p2w players will have their ways and you have to follow them. My 6-month city got annihilated in one single night, down to the very last troops. Overall, it's still a good game to kill time

It's advertising shows world building and survival but it's just another war game. There's no option to opt out of world wide combat. Even if you don't participate in the multitude of battle games, resource grabs, or basically going around picking a fight with every other player, you're still going to get obliterated by the super toxic online community for this game. I wouldn't even include world building in the description since it lasts for the first couple levels then it's just being attacked

I have been playing for 6 months now, and tbh there are a lot of things that need to be improved. Like out of curiosity, I went to the setting, pressed on account, then google, and the game immediately crashed, it kept saying error code. I uninstalled and re-download, and now it's impossible to get in the game. Very unstable game.

Nothing like the ad game play &/or what the ads showed. It was a lot like the old FarmVille, or farming games combined with battle games but none of the controlled movement & lots of building structures & upgrading them slowly bit by bit. It also had story lines & extra characters. I gave it a chance based off the ads but it was less roaming/exploring & more "busy work".

This game isn't what was presented at all in any of the ads that I saw while playing other games. From the ads and videos I saw, it looked like a laid-back resource sim, but it's just another game that wants you to join a group, not play by yourself, play all the time, and spend a bunch ofoney. It isn't fun at all, and isn't friendly to casual players in the least. Please for the sake of people like me, at least make your ads an accurate representation of your game so we don't waste our time.

Clicker game designed to gamble your money. You build your city only to later find out that you need to spend lots of money to even try to catch up to the big whales and make this game competitive. The rewards are trash in comparison to what you invest, to event be part of events. If you have a high power, you have to spend about thousand of dollars to just even maintain that power level. Wish the game would allow free players to save their gems. There is constant bullying in world chats.

Very addicting. I could spend all day just hunting, gathering, and building. Fun interaction with people around the world. Some events are cooperative so the alliances are great. Definitely needs shorter build times since those can be a week or more as you level up. Can feel like it's pay-to-play but I do just fine without paying. Fix those two things and I'd give it a solid 5 stars.

FALSE ADVERTISEMENT 😂 Nothing like the advertisement I had for this game while on Duolingo...so after playing for a little bit in the hopes it'll get to the part from the advertisement (ps it never did ) my review is - They really want you to pay for things. Very quickly things need 2 days waiting time for updates in the game so you're left either waiting or paying to finish them quicker. It is fun in the first three days when things don't get so long to upgrade.

I'm working so hard on this game, and a lot of your progress goes down the gutter. I wake up after sleeping, and I log in and see I've lost over 50k troops. Disgusting. That's overkill. Should be a limit to how much people can destroy you. Takes forever to finally get good and strong at the game. I regret making any purchases on this game. Not worth it.

It's an unexpectedly well made game. No ads, idle gameplay with plenty of active gameplay combined. I'm just very disappointed with the community that ruins the gameplay for a lot of people, depending on the server you're in. If the strongest alliance in the server is toxic and sees some challenge, they'll make sure to cut your alliance in half and wreck the hours and maybe money you spend into this game. Lastly, if they played more hours, that means they're stronger and you don't stand a chance

Not the worst game I've played, but being new to the game - I had a slowdown because I let my heroes reach max level before I raised up my whole town, so there was a huge gap of time where I had to level up my town before I could level up my furnace. I guess I was focused on the heroes but it's overall a time sink for me, so I had to quit playing it. I also wasn't expecting my town to be invaded? The only reason i vaguely knew was because you got barriers. The demo ad was also misleading...

Starts off interesting, but then you're on the busy work treadmill and the only way to get off is to not play. I got sucked into playing with one of their Interactive advert mini games. It looked like it was going to be a a sort of city builder. I hope it was going to be something I could dip in and out of. Have a villager running in the background that I would not have to micromanage. But soon you're in micromanagement competitive hell. Not chill at all. A lot of other games are like this.

Game is good but you have to do something with reward system, events system, stamina etc..Rally taking forever to finish, beast further and further every time, not enough gathering spots. Prices are too high! Low diamond and stamina rewards. Edit: IF YOU NEED HELP BECAUSE YOU HAVE A PROBLEM WITH A GAME, CONTACT SUPPORT WILL ANSWER YOU IN 72H,AND THAN THEY WILL NOT ANSWER YOUR QUESTION, THEY WILL SEND YOU GENERIC MESSAGE, BASICALLY CALLING YOU STUPID! I AM STILL PLAYING JUST BECAUSE OF MY FRIENDS

Sadly, as with all these types of games, the developers allow much more powerful players to ruin the game for new starters by letting them attack you. I've only been playing a few days, really enjoying the theme and building away only to log on today and find that not one but two players have attacked me. Both were much more advanced than me, and I stood no chance. The developers will of course say buy a peace shield etc, but why should we? There needs to be fair play. Game uninstalled

Hear me out devs. Please add "DRAGGING" into this game, it's really time consuming and frustrating waiting for your troops to return and having them send out again. Kindly make this possible, having your troops dragged from one spot to another, in tiles to another makes it more easier. Consider my request and I'll change my rating when this happens.

In theory, this game is good. It has a very casual feel, it has its own appealing aesthetic, there's no rush, it's fully voice acted, and it dips its fingers into a lot of familiar game styles. Unfortunately it has two aspects that are a deal breaker for me: forced pvp (including an arena you're immediately forced to join and cannot opt out of), and the community seems nice on the surface but are massive bullies if you display any degree of ignorance as a new user. 3/5 stars.

Trigger Warning: This is a Free to play but a PAY TO WIN game! It will make you believe it is but as you progress to higher level and wanting to get stronger you need to buy their stuffs. And city skins are pretty darn costly. Imagine you will compete for 10 city skins. And there are 1000 or more players. What do you think they want us to do? Yep you need to spend! And even if you do, there is no assurance you will be on the top 10. You can spend $1000 but still can't reach the top 10.

This is not the game advertised to me. I came to move a guy around and collect wood, money, and meat to build things to defeat a stage. That's what interested me. I don't care about your story or city building or anything else this game has to offer. Maybe I could have been if I got my fill of what I came to enjoy but instead am put through a boring tutorial and city building elements I never signed up to try. Maybe the game I wanted is somewhere inside but I couldn't care to stay and find out.

This game is a scam. Terrible customer support, they refuse to delete your account. Deletion goes "under review" and then gets rejected. Not really a war game either. Just a bunch of red dots (task) to click with little purpose. More of a power competition game that comes down to who spends the most. You don't do anything with the power, It's just a number. There really is no point in this game at all.

The story is great, game play is smooth. The art is very nice. But the length of time to complete a build, research, or troop training is ridiculously long. The packs to purchase are not really worth the price fir the items you get when completion times are so long. Easy to understand why so many are loosing interest in the game. If completion times were decreased to a logical amount of time, I think they would make more money and retain loyal players.

Disappointed as gameplay nothing like adverts. I enjoyed the simple fast moving direct strategy of the try-out adverts and was expecting more of the same. I checked to see whether I'd installed a different game: it starts with a tutorial saying press this, level up that, with events pushing you to do everything faster and faster. Wasn't much fun due to lack of explanation, loss of story line and my original expectation for something far more direct.

It's one of the few games that I have played for an extended period of time. The initial stages are good, reasonably paced and enjoyable. You can absolutely play without spending any money. One big advantage is no ads. After level 25 it simply gets boring as you wait weeks or even months to upgrade. While they do have interesting mini missions in game these become repetitive very quickly to the point of annoying. As a free to play gamer, I have reached the point of boredom and will be quitting.

Has potential to be great. However, it gets to the point where you can't do much because everything takes forever to upgrade, you can't improve heroes because everything else needs to be upgraded first, etc. Plus, the constant attacks by long-time players, daily bullying of new players, is ridiculous! There should be limitations on how often one can be attacked, power levels of opponents you can attack, etc, to keep it fair.

it's time to update the skin shop guys! just the mushroom stuff is not enough, I really hoped they would add more stuff perhaps every 6months, but alas no. it's a reasonable game, there's now loads of games with very similar game play. build your city join an alliance blah blah

Fun game, genuinely fun game, but it's not at all like the AD's... I don't understand why companies do this. Edit: the company responded to me, while it's true the ads only show a portion of that game it doesn't take away from the fact that the ads show gameplay and mechanics that do NOT exist in the actual game AT ALL. Your not going to be controlling a guy, running through snow collecting and bringing back supplies, it's a town sim, you'll spend 90% of your time tapping at menus to upgrade.

Overall not a bad game. The ads are not accurate at all to real gameplay, obviously (most of these games have false advertising). It's like many other games, pay to win, wait 15 minutes or more to finish upgrades, make sure things are prepared for a large danger event. I kinda like it, and it has the fallout shelter "mood" system to keep your citizens happy. Overall, it's worth it if you don't mind waiting.

The concept art, storyline, strategy, and the whole genre of this game is what drew me into playing. I loved it and didn't mind paying a few bucks to keep up and upgrade the city to my satisfaction. But now you've lost me where leveling up or gaining hero pieces is through money. You don't offer other heroes through gatcha. At. All. After level 20 or so, the only way to keep up is through money. That's it. It turned into a pay to win game. I'm disappointed in you devs.

I wouldn't even bother installing until this is fixed. The attacks by other players are very frustrating. I'd rather that not be an element of gameplay at all, but if it must be, have a level restriction on how you can attack- for example, only people within a couple of levels of your range, above or below. You get people targeting you that are level 30 and you're only level 10 and can't even travel and retaliate. It makes it frustrating and is the only reason that I would delete the game.

haven't been playing long.. okay. standard city-builder. What's annoying is that I saw this in an ad, that let me play it. The game I played in the ad, is not what the game is. So, they made a playable game for the ad, to get me into their other game. Why not just make the game in the ad an actual game? The amount of false advertising is getting out of hand.

A fun game to begin with, but it will become evident that you need to spend lots of money on in app purchases to progress in the game.However once you get to a certain level and status, you become bird feed for the higher players that gang up on you to get you out of the area and even to a different state, this ruins the game, not enjoyable at all, despite spending a lot of money myself and playing for a few years, ive requested account deletion and won't be playing again.

I recently had the pleasure of playing Whiteout, and I must say that it is an excellent survival strategy game that kept me engaged for hours. The gameplay mechanics are challenging yet rewarding, and the graphics are impressive and immersive. Despite thoroughly enjoying my time playing the game, I did face a slight issue while attempting to purchase packs from the in-game store. Unfortunately, I couldn't reach customer support to help me with the problem, which was a bit disappointing.

It's an ok game. You can make it to level 9 with nonstop play. After that, upgrades take some time and more and more upgrades require steel which is a rare resource and takes forever to get enough as you go through it pretty quickly. I'll agree with others that it's pretty much a P2W game, so those of us relying strictly on free play may end up getting slaughtered by other players.

The game is "meh" decent. The team-play/communal aspect of it makes it a little fun, but the core game play mechanic is basically trash. In a nutshell, the longer you play, the stronger you are, and people who have played longer than you easily bully you and there's nothing you can do about it. The whole game is essentially geared towards "pay to win" type play. It'd be acceptable if the core game was good, but it's not.

I can't figure out how to not be forced into tutorials. When that stupid finger is on screen, no function of the game is usable. Not settings, not chat, nothing. I would keep playing if i didn't get railroaded into progressing towards being vulnerable to other players. It's so very frustrating when a game is designed to be desperate to get you into PvP. I suppose I'll uninstall, as i have no interest in another clash of clans style rat race. The game was damn fun, while it was solo.

nothing like the ads that I downloaded it from. same old tired town builder that was boring 8 years ago, just re-skinned. so sick of deceptive ads, thst are nothing like the actual gameplay. if you want a game that very shortly looses all fun, and leads to upgrade this building and wait 5 hours, and thats basically all the game is, than enjoy. I'd honestly rather go out and freeze to death than play this long term

Is this actually a game? The little demo game that convinced me to download this is not in the game. While this "game" looks pretty it is just a load of timers. Start building this, it will take 10mins, wait or use crystals? Once out of crystals it's just waiting for timers (some take hours). The expeditions part is fun for about five mins. It is sort of city building by numbers. Build this here! Upgrade this! I can't believe people pay money for the things which are continually advertised. 👎

This reply is exactly why players are leaving. Hiding behind “free to play” after turning the game into a whale-only cash machine is dishonest. Whiteout Survival stopped respecting regular players a long time ago. Endless monetization, constant pressure to spend, and zero balance killed the spirit of the game. You did not protect it, you exploited it. That is why people are quitting, including me...

The game keeps clearing my progress. I had to restart the game recently after spending over a year building up my camp. I had all the buildings at their highest levels and quite a few heroes unlocked. All that was lost. So I started to rebuild. I opened the game today, and my new progress was wiped out again. This game is frustrating.

Skip this on. Fun at first then some jerk comes and steals/destroys everything. Getting started, the ads and first 3 'screenshots' are interesting but misleading and do not represent the game. It's a strategy game, ok, I played along. I got to a decent level, plenty of resources, joined an alliance. Then the jerks come, attack non-stop for hours, steal all of the harder to obtain resources...the game jokingly tells you that you can use a shield on your city..just not while you are in battle..

Claims to be a survival game, but the first day or two is a city building sim. Then tries to turn into a typical war game offering troop camps, research, and hero gear that is impossible to get to a relevant level for free. Latest update is an island straight out of an idle RPG. No point in rallying players as attackers lose troops when defenders dont. The entire game is just copying aspects of other games. Might as well consider your purchases cosmetic as nobody actually fights outside events.

The game itself is entertaining. Unfortunately, the developers are criminal. Double and even triple charges are often applied to purchases, when you try to contact the developers about the billing errors, they are completely unresponsive. Additionally, there is no way to play the game without participating in the server community, which was one of the most toxic environments I have ever witnessed. Absolute trash. I'd give it 0 stars if I could.

Never a saw a game where number of mythic heroes are more than rare heroes, which half of them need money to either obtain or upgrade. The lv up for chief gear at later stages is impossible without money. The reward from events are so trivial, they barely help on anything, and even that, those events are designed encourage players to pay. Pay for advantage is fine, but online purchase shouldn't affect too much on gameplay experience, and this game has failed to do so. NOT RECOMMEND THIS GAME

The game itself is wonderful. The thing that is absolutely sickening is how pay to play this game is. They are extremely predatory with how they shove these packs at you. There are some heros you legitimately need to spend $8,000+ just to be able to max him out. And there's no way to level him up for free. Thats just one example though. There's tons of things where if you want to be competitive, prepare to spend $100s of dollars

Game pressures you into making in-app purchases without giving you time to make a decision on poorly worded deals or missing out completely on items that are crucial for a season. Half the purchases aren't worth even paying for and misleading. I feel obligated to keep playing, too, because of alliance team building and having already spent money on stuff that won't matter in another generation release. It's impossible to play free and compete.
I've been playing this game for more then 3yrs it's is a game that if you want to be all powerful you need to spent $$$$$,to feel that you can power control,,,,piece out

Very fun, but very pay to win like any other "survival" game with a multiplayer pvp aspect. This game does well and gives you free rechargable shields and teleports, but everything else is very expensive in terms of gems (premium currency). In addition, some purchases won't give you any VIP points or topup value, and there is only one topup event so you aren't very rewarded after that. In addition, the stamina regeneration is extremely slow, so fighting mobs for resources or events takes time.

A fun game to begin with, but it'll quickly become evident that in order to progress, you'll need to spend a lot of money on in-app purchase, and I mean a LOT. However, once you get to a certain status and power in the game, it becomes increasingly "tribal" with other players ganging up to force you to comply with their wishes, and threaten with consequences if you fail to comply. On the other hand, if I minimize the game and relaunch it after 5 minutes, it takes forever to connect to the internet while the ad banner just freezes on the screen. Please make the connection attempt run in the background and allow players to disable these banners.

Another P2W game with false advertising. - Major artificial scarcity in terms of different kinds of resources for progression. - FOMO events (including scarcity again) for OP heroes and progression, which is essentially an auction for power. - Every little upgrade is really impactful in PVP, making you irrelevant if you don't spend a lot of money (and this game has a ridiculous amount of whales).
