Game play is nothing like the ads. The minigame at the end of the ads is more fun than the actual game. In the ad, you actually control a toon and you run around and collect stuff and use it. In the actual game you basically just tap on your screen, wait 5 seconds, tap on your screen, watch a stupid cut scene for 5 seconds, repeat.

Misleading advertising. I downloaded this app because of the ad, only to discover the gameplay is nothing like what was advertised. After reading other reviews, it’s clear this is a pattern. Players complain, and the developers respond urging folks to "keep playing" as if wasting more time will magically unlock the game we were promised. That’s not how honest marketing works. Don’t advertise a game you don’t actually offer to the player. This feels deceptive and intentional and in bad taste.

Don't play this game if you are not willing to spend $100 daily. Why? The servers in game are too small. Older servers are almost dead with spender growing terribly strong they zero you at any chance before you have a chance to grow. You will have NO opportunity to grow if you don't spend. As a moderate spender or free-to-play player don't download. The game does not protect you. It apparently is a short-live game with people dropping out so frequently.

It's a great game, but it has some issues that really drag it down: * Rampant bullying and death threats on multiple servers that are ignored by the Devs. * Pay-to-Win destroys any type of fair competition * Lots of activities over the week, but all encourage you to pay hard cash to win the best prizes and boosts. * Very little chance of getting high level gear unless you pay. * Construction/Research times become ridiculously long the Higher you go, pushing you to pay money to quicken them.

1: the ads are misleading to the point of fraud. If you were interested by an ad, I'm afraid you were duped. -- This is even seen in the store listing "screenshots". This does not appear at all in the game. I have raised this as a policy violation. I urge others to do the same. 2: the game is essentially in 2 parts; a short city building phase, and then just grinding endlessly to get upgrade tokens to help grind. It's a low grade, uninspired and cynical cash generator by the devs.

Even if you pay to win, you lose. Two stars bc the game is well made and would make a good PC game if not for dark tactics to constantly encourage micro transactions. Played for 3 months, spent in excess of $600 and wasn't even in the top 100 of my server. Others spent over 10k in 2 months and weren't even in the top 20 in server. Game caters to middle aged narcissist introverts with gambling problems and addiction issues-- and you have to work with them. Game turns into stressful 2nd job.

just a completely different game than the one shown in the ad. only the setting is the same. The actual app has a lot of different gameplay sections, like it's got everything except what they actually advertised. it's actually a pretty good game, kind of throws a lot of stuff u have to manage at you, but there's always something to do and it doesn't feel repetitive.

Do not download this game unless you plan on spending massive amounts of money! I've been playing this game for over 2 years now. I got hooked after a deceiving add and stayed for the friends I made. If you want to be any good at this game, you have to pay. I think it's more expensive for different countries too because all of the whales tend to be from the same countries. I've spent well over $1k on this game and I'm still weak af compared to the majority of players. Avoid this!

Soon as the world map showed up, I knew where this was going and wanted nothing to do with it. I have dealt with this in other games, and I have no interest in worldwide competition. If i had known this was MMO open war, I would not have wasted my time. Based on the advertisements, I thought it was relaxing story building game. That was obviously a lie. The label of Single Player is definitely a boldface lie and false advertising. My city was scouted and destroyed by some unknown player.

I downloaded the game and within 30 seconds I found myself uninstalling it. this is just a repeat of all the games where you got to click and upgrade click and upgrade click and upgrade and nothing and I mean absolutely nothing like the ads show.We download your game for exactly what the ad showed which is kill a bunch of bears. developers pull us in with these ads just so you can get it downloaded and it's not right and you know it's not right. that's okay ,what goes around comes around.

redownloaded, but the alliance mobilization challenges are a joke. I'm thankful for this as it gave me a reason to delete this nothing like the ad that was presented in another game ok to kill time, but if you make it a few levels up after a few days, you'll easily get frustrated with some glitches that do not properly count points for challenges also, constantly popping up an ad to buy something every time you log in or change characters gives the game a scam feel

The game says it's a strategy game but whomever wrote that needs to look up the word strategy as there is nothing strategy about this game. It's another copy-paste farm and build for resources, pay to win game. The explore function are fights that are auto played for you, and again, no strategy involved. The only part worth the time to play was building the city, after which the only way to really do anything is to join an alliance of which you get bot invites constantly for. Sad.

The game is entertaining, and while it constantly encourages you to pay to progress. It is possible to play for free and extract some enjoyment (but you need to join an alliance which has a lot of paying players in order to get that enjoyment). Be warned, if you're unfortunate enough to need the help of Customer Support, you're likely to be disappointed. They're very polite but totally useless when it comes to getting anything fixed. There are definitely better ways to spend your time and money.

It's a okay game if you get in a good alliance but it's notting like the ads so don't let them full you plus they will try every which way to get money from you plus its the same thing over and over there is really no way to be a top tier player without paying money. also I think there is a lawsuit coming up on them for false advertisements and misleading conducts.

It's decently fun at first, probably until level 12. Your upgrades take around 20 min each, so everything moves pretty quickly. At level 18, most of your upgrades are 6 hours each, so unless you happen to get a lot of speed ups in the probably only need to log in every 2 days. The alliances can be fun, but a lot of people seem to drop the game by level 12. They have different ranks in the alliances for some reason. You don't get any kind of reward for being a higher rank, kinda dumb

Really sneaky - nothing like the advert I followed from another app. Literally different games. They make it incredibly hard to delete your account (they have to approve your 'request') . The game seems designed to be addictive with constant incentivisation. Contains gambling - spin a wheel for prizes, buy more tickets for cash. I worry about children downloading this. It should be banned.

Do you like ads that advertise 1 game then give you another with SUPPRIZE MACHANICS, if you like getting stuff and getting what you didn't even order this game is for you. A timer based use gold with real money to speed up. First half of the game is just to get you to play it other half is to try a socially manipulate you into playing more by you have gone this far Might as well play a game I don't enjoy to lie to my self I just wasted 30 mins letting game play for me.

I should've dock a star for false advertisement lol at least that was my plan at first, the game is so different from the ads it's like a whole new game, but it is fun! There's an alliance with live chatting and the players came from all kinds of life, so things are very interesting in that sense. The game are also very generous with the rewards and so far as an f2p I can keep up just fine with people who spend money in the game, of course there's still a difference but it's still playable

This game is nothing in it like the advertisement they show. Several gameplay screenshots are just made up marketing to make you think gameplay will be something more interactive. Instead it's static graphics of everyone's city in the same pattern. Why can't you choose to build 2 coal mines? Deceptive marketing. I've played this game before.. This just has a winter skin thrown on it.

The game is not what was advertised. There weren't even mini games inside of the main game that would resemble ads. This is a basic "strategy" game with base building/ upgrade, send troops to war, collect resources, research minor stat increases. Every day, repeat. Boring fast.

It's a good game but after a point,it becomes monotonous. Upgrades can take days to weeks Buildings are preset so you can't choose location. Resources are only limited by how much you can collect within 7-12 hours depending on the resource. Anyone looking for a frostpunk type of game, this isn't it

yet another example of blatantly false advertising. the add showed an entirely different type of game. once i started playing the REAL game it took seconds to see that this is just another P2W war game. The more i played the more dissapointed i got. Not interested in getting into another P2W game where only big money players have any chance of winning. Victory is determined not by how well you play, but how much money you spend. no amount of effort or strategy can save from the players who P2W.

The ads for the game are misleading. I wish companies would stop doing that. I enjoyed the start of the game but then the whole multiplayer aspect came into it and it was too complicated and there was no tutorial for alliances and how to use the worldmap and what it all meant. My alliance spammed cryptic messages every few seconds and I had no idea what everyone was talking about in chat. I also don't enjoy games were people can loot your base. I wish the focus was on helping instead destroying.

Due to some personal reasons. My friend wants to change the email on her account. Customer service has been notified for help. But they unbind her account without notice. She have already reported it, but after so many days, the account has not yet been settled. We are the HIGHEST SPENDING UNION. We are very disappointed with your service.

The game itself was OK but it didn't keep me coming back to it. Ended up uninstalling the game after not playing for a week. Side note though. I have yet to see an advert for this game that shows the actual game instead of something you can't do within the game. The Devs must have hired the same advertising team team that likes to use sound bite and screen shots from the command and conquer franchise.

This game is NOT the same thing what gets advertised and the playable demo. Rubbish! dear editor, I've played this game every day for 3 or 4 months and I've never ever chopped trees with axes or killed bears with spinning axes and collecting meat and building forts like you do in the mini demo! NEVER ONCE!

There are so many different ads for this game and not a single one shows anything like what the actual gameplay is. The game itself is a fairly standard for mobile strategy city builder. Build up city to make troops fight things for resources to build better things to make better troops. Plenty of events but if you want the unique rewards for them you'll need extreme luck or cash. They do add new things somewhat frequently but there's nothing unique or really exciting here.

Why is there always like thousands of ads and pop up to pay for stuff. Its annoying, I wish there was an option to ignore it or hide it. Also the sidebar needs an option to hide it during events, its very annoying. This game is addictive and very pay to win based. If you want to win against other players who pay you have to pay a fortune also or play everyday for a year to catch up to their power and level. Imo this would be a good game if it wasnt revolved around paying to rack your way up.

Great game. PROS: Packed with tons of events, server vs server battles, new servers released all the time, gift codes for resources. CONS: All of the above, plus fact that everything in game is geared for a huge money grab. Accounts never get a chance to breathe & stock items because there are at times, no joke, 2-3-4+ events going on at the same time all needing same objectives met to earn points eligible for top scores and prizes. Entirely too much content all at once and very confusing.

The game is just okay, since the new features been added now it's now laggy and unstable. I'm not getting some of my rewards and resources and when trees are being chopped down on the island their choping the same trees for hours and or just run around to various trees to the point I can't move on and advance and now it kicks me out of the game multiple times. It's rather frustrating.

Not at all like all the ads you see for this game. You don't actually go around killing bears and chopping trees to gain resources. You're just leveling up buildings to rescue more survivors to employ in your town to gain more resources.... Played for about 30 minutes hoping I'd unlock a minigame or something like the ads but nope. So I uninstalled the game shortly after that.

Game is nothing like the ads. its one of those horribly overdone games that requires you to join an alliance. games like that stopped being fun back in 2014. game lacks any type of fun or imagination. Its a carbon copy of every other game like it. if you came from an ad, be aware you aren't getting through game you thought. Not worth downloading or playing.

The game is capturing, although the PC version is far from taking advantage of the target environment. Screen size is fixed to Androind portrait, not allowing full window scaling, while U/I is also replicating Android, not allowing interactivity that users are used to on a PC. Still a good try for a Beta version.

Not what I expected from the ad. Looks cool but all you do is just spam click upgrades all the time, not much creativity or thinking required. 1h of playing and you keep unlocking new features and there is just no time think what you're doing, constantly getting notifications and tips and whatnot. Too much stuff for what seemed like a simple time killer.

Great game. Although it can feel a bit P2W at times you can actually get quite far without paying. However if you do pay you'll be way ahead. Will have to see in late game if it's completely owned by P2W players. Overall game is addicting and fun, you can also spend very little and enjoy for hours and hours.

I learned about this game through an ad and thought it looked fun. downloaded it and it was a completely different game...why am I surprised -_-. This bull 🤬 is an epidemic. I always love the ad game play and hate the actual game. why invest in making a game then create a fake ad thats more fun for it. if youre not confident enough in your product to market it properly, try again. 0/5 stars, that should be an option for liars like this.

The upgrade building UI feels clunky and unresponsive. After you reach a certain level the game becomes basically all PvP with little to no PvE options. Not a survival game, contradictory to the title. You can definitely sink hours into the game with just two characters on the same server/state, in the same alliance, lowering cooldowns and helping beat beasts, but the game offers no new real content once you get to say level 16. You're also spammed with offers to spend real money on everything.

played for three months, spent about 300e, waaaay more than you'll ever spent on any game, yet it counts to so little.. perhaps 10 times that might get you somewhere. it's ridiculous how they broke this down in soo many 5.99 micro transactions that don't really count to much. listen, if you have money to burn, or just wanna support the rich, both in-game and real life, enjoy! or just buy aoe IV (40e) and enjoy online strategy with your friends. full version

This game wrecked two phones...what the hell? Besides that the game is ok for a while then it gets boring with the long waits for upgrade. It's mostly for people loaded with cash too, not saying u can't play if you're broke but u will be missing out on a lot of good stuff if u don't have cash...so apart from being a money hungry game and a phone wrecker the game could pass. PS the game is nothing like the ad so if you are thinking of downloading this game because of it then forget it.

This game is really fun and addictive. You spend endless hours building up your forces, buying upgrade packs, upgrading your building and forces just to be destroyed by someone much higher than you. Only a certain number of your forces can go into your infirmary, the rest will die unless, of course, you buy a pack to revive them. No matter how much you buildup or how many hours you invest in the game, you will not keep up without dropping cash. State vs State was invented for them to make money.

It keeps getting better with each update. I wish it was a little easier to advance quickly without buying "packs," but you can still absolutely play w/out them. Just don't expect to be able to rank and get rewards from any of the events. I don't mind spending some to support the developers, because they are constantly rolling out new events and heroes to keep the game fun. Edit: I will admit it's nothing like the gameplay shown in the ad and is more war strategy than city builder past a point

This game? Not like the ads whatsoever. And for the first time ever, I am *glad* it's not like the ads. This game is so unbelievably fun. It's a quick build, I got my town to level ten within a week. I haven't spent a single penny. There isn't any annoying ads, the currency system isn't punishing, the leveling up is perfectly done. It's amazing. I made an alliance and within days it was filled up with people helping each other. LOVE THIS GAME.

The game is fun. The ads for this game are dishonest and many show false gameplay. I wish I could rate this game higher since it is fun, but I don't want to give a good rating to a game that has ads that lie to people. Please just be honest and show the actual game in all your ads. I will also say some of the false gameplay in ads look like a game that would be more fun to play. They also look like games that would be less play to win.

Disappointed, but not surprised. It was a very lovely game up until the most recent update. Now the game won't even open, and whenever it does, it immediately crashes my entire device. I have plenty of space, and I have no issue running much clunkier apps on my device. I should have listened to the complaints about this game developer, I'm so disappointed but not surprised. Don't waste your time with this one.

Firstly, ad is nothing like game. So was disappointed straight away. Secondly the actual game... You can't do much in this game as stamina is always empty. I've come to the point where the game is useless to me most times I log on. So I've decided to move on to a game that's playable when I log on.

The game is good, has no ads, and is pretty similar to a lot of the strategy games like Rise of Kingdoms. but there are a couple of things that I want to warn newer players. 1. If you want to make it to the top, you are going to need to put a lot of time. There are many different things that you need to keep track of, and everything you do has an actual time limit. 2. If you do get into playing the game, don't spend all your steel right away. You need steel later to research important upgrades.

Similar to other progressive games. The downside is that eventually you get to the level where updating the furnace takes a day and a half. The furnace controls everything. Still don't understand the hero updates. Nothing explains that. Recruiting heroes implies you are going to get a new one. Instead you just open a chest. This is very similar to township. Just set in snow. Fun for a while, then it gets tedious.

If I give minus 5 stars for what I thought was advertised and what I installed I would! Definitely NOT a beginner entry level game, and definitely NOT as the ad advertises as an arbitrary collect/play/level up game... so unless you have a basic understanding of games like DND your chances of "survival " against the other more advanced players are ZERO ... totally agree with other reviews that domination is impossible without loads of $ and experience

Looks awesome, but it is a total scam. I've watched over 20 different ads from this game and not in single ad they show you that it is a FARMiNG game. Upgrade this,that and this and why not this and more pointless stuff,and best part is that WILL HAVE to wait for forever without wanting to spend some money. Which it will be a waste, not recommending it. Thanks and Bye.

Enjoy it but... I wish they'd run with the concept on the ads rather than just another base builder with scouting and marching and blah blah blah. The format has been done to death at this point. Having said that there's enough variety and nuances that I haven't stopped playing yet. The graphics / aesthetic are nice and the story has some nice mechanics in it.

NO ADS?! Honestly, I was super sick and tired of seeing all the ads for this game (in other mobile games, funny enough). However, I decided to give it a try! It's super hard to find a worthwhile mobile game nowadays, let alone one that doesn't have ads! I've already formed my own alliance that continues to grow in size while meeting new people. Definitely recommend!

There's nothing wrong with the game except I don't like playing cooperatively but apparently people need to be in an alliance with others. Whiteout Survival is not how I would define "casual" as there is too much to do to progress. The game is simply too time consuming and since the story is quite interesting can only succeeded in wasting the player's life until he or she isekai into it a la 'Overlord'.

This app throws it's a pay to play app in your face. There is almost always a pop up as soon as you log in for buying a pack. In order to place well in any event you have to buy things. And the people who are "whales" dominate the state you're in making it impossible for free to play players to do much. The developers don't take accounts of bullying or harassment seriously. Their ads also aren't accurate in regards to game play. I never saw one that lined up with the real gaming experience

This game is too alliance/open world heavy to be fun. Alliances are full of people who quit after 2 days. Being attacked and losing progress is a common thing even once you're in an alliance, so it's not worth the trouble trying to play. Even with a furnace level 15, it doesn't help increase the temp or ability to survive storms without sick villagers. There aren't enough speed ups or rewards given for tasks. It's just a waste of time and effort.

The ads and promo images are incredibly misleading. After a few hours of constant play, I didn't get to any other mode other than the farmville-like sim and the auto battler. I was hoping to see the snow-exploration but either it's buried too far into the story or not there at all. Its an ok game, but not what I was looking for.

Its great in the beginning, the team building aspect.. but that very quickly dies and you're left with boring repetitive events that require a lot of items and give such little reward. The game however does have a lot of potential, alot of Intrinsic features but it's massively wasted...and I wouldn't even say in favour of whale spenders, tbh I don't even know why they bother, the game is ruined by people able to spend $4-500 a day because there is no challenge, there is no worthy battle anymore

It's a good game. But if your not in the same state as the person who showed you the game then you cannot be friends at all. Also if you decide to go to the same state as your friends you have to START OVER FROM SCRATCH!!!!! I'm beyond pissed right now. And they don't make it easy or known that there are different "states" and that you have to start all over again!!! It would be an amazing game if none of that happened, or if you could send out friend codes/requests so that this doesn't happen.

Downloaded this to check if my assumptions that it is a halfway copy of Frostpunk (or at least heavily inspired) were true, which they were (at least seemingly so based on the little progress I've made). In core this game is essentialy identical to Frostpunk, but with standard mobile game mechanics on the outside. Cannot rate this lower than a 3/5 as Frostpunk is an amazing game and carries its amazingness over to this game, but cannot rate it higher either.

In most p2w games, it's harder to advance if you're f2p, however in this game it's impossible. If you're not a spender, your heroes will always be super weak with no chance to compete in P2P fights. But perhaps the worst part of this game is that it gets super boring super quick, as in the first 20 days or so. It just becomes Farmville. I played it for about 55 days until after the castle fight and called it quits. TLDR: Way too boring and impossible to advance for free to play gamers.

I don't care about the ads but it's so damn annoying the fact that you can only get one SSR character and level her up without spending money. it feels like a ha ha but it's not, if you want to be powerful you have to spend money. the game should allow every character and every shard to be pulled in the gacha game because this is so toxic

It's a good game. Whether you have fun or not depends on the guild you join or if the server is kill hungry. Some positives are the no ads, the different event cycles (sometime overlapping which got annoying with deciding what to spend resources on). Negatives.. yeah the game is p2w no matter what, you can f2p but you will always be behind. Game gets repetitive an starts losing its luster around 3 month mark an the new heros weren't enough excitement. Give it a try though wont regret It

For now, bearable and not yet so badly unbalanced between free to play and pay to play as other, but ... it totally lacks any form of creativity as everything is "predefined" more or less, drops from monsters are the same, battles are the same, pretty much everything is the same. Also some things are buggy and/or totally counterintuitive (while some are nicely done). Kinda boring overall with high prices for some 2000 animations and a totally blunt story and gameplay. Later edit: this P2P 100%

Really good game, one feature I would like games like this to add is free to play servers, where you can't spend real money to gain an advantage over players, all your big spenders all group in big alliance and tend to ruin the server for those who can't spend. And end up quiting the game because its just impossible to keep up. I feel like this would give the game more structure and keep customers engaged with the game for longer.

Lies. Played the advert. Loved it. The actual game is nothing like the advert game which was much better and much more fun. The actual game isn't fun or interesting. Why make the advert actually good if you can't play that? Release that as a game and I'd download it in a heartbeat. This app is absolute trash and definitely falsely advertised.

I found the game fun however higher up players troll intensely and attack much lower level players. I can see why many stop playing. From a business perspective they really are killing new players from sticking and making it to a point where they may actually spend money on it. Perhaps the game could be modified so people can only attack players in a closer level range?

it's not a strategy game. This isn't even a game. Strategy is much different than endless micro management. Strategy usually means having to use tactics. This app does not need tactical thinking or strategic planning. The only thing you accomplish in this app is turning your back on time itself for the purpose of managing how much time to waste with each upgrade or "battle" you encounter. "stylized" what does that even mean? style is not something that is massively replicated. Why use such tags?

really boring game. I also played a teaser preview of this game and then downloaded it only to find that it does not even remotely resemble the advertisement. you spend all your time building a city, waiting for the timer to finish to upgrade again. there's not even any skill required. super easy and super boring. do not recommend.

It may not be a new type of game but it is very well executed. I like that you can toggle between 30 and 60 fps, very high quality graphics imo. I guess what really sets wos apart from the rest is the community, being able to chat comfortably with other players and such Admittedly a pay to win game but I get along without having to, just plain consistency.

This game is almost exactly like Frozen City. I'm not sure which one came first, but they're almost identical as far as the gameplay goes. I've only just started playing, but am enjoying it a little more than Frozen City, as it seems to move a little faster without having to pay to play. We shall see if my rating changes as I continue on. Literally on my first camp 😂

Well, the truth is, this game is not a peaceful survival city development game, despite what every advertisement would have you think. Top dogs can't attack each other, so they attack small alliances. Is that a good gameplay experience? No, not really. There isn't much of an alternative unless you want your state in constant infighting and weakening itself. The developers just want you to spend spend spend your way to the top!

Poor customer service! I've spent money on this game the 1 time I've had an issue I reached out to customer support telling them I was missing 7hrs of speed ups. They asked me to send ss which I did. Then they wanted ss before and after or a video of the issues. Who takes ss before an issue happens and plans it? They still haven't given me my 7hrs... not helpful at all.

The graphics and some of the ideas in the game are pretty good but the fact that there's no penalty for higher level players attacking lower level ones totally kills it. I was in a new alliance with 50+ members and a level 23 just moved his city in the middle of our hive and burned all of us about 10 times each with no way for us to stop him or fight back. Every game like this should penalize higher levels for doing that. Like a 24 hour debuff like they do in Kingdom Maker

The phasing out of free to play in this game is a real drab. sucks so much to find a good game just to have the developers take all the fun out of it by making you pay for simple rewards. Take the raid button away in the labyrinth and give away more coupons than just one when you start the game because purchases aren't worth it.

A pay-to-win game and the developers only protect the ones who paid a lot. If you come here because of the ad, the game is nothing at all about the ad. You pay to win, im a free to pay player and i got bullied by those whales. Reported to the company and they said this is a war game.. Hard to find justice in reality, even harder to get it in virtual world.. I dont recommend at all.

Played it for nearly one year as almost entirely free to play. I'm glad I didn't spend much otherwise the regret would've been bigger. I'm glad I'm done with it because it was addicting and there was a constant fear of missing out and buy some pack. I spent a lot of hours in it which is my biggest regret

Not what I expected. The ad presented an entirely different game that I'd much rather play. Why advertise a different game to get people in when you can't keep them. Bizarre. It's a bit fun for the first day when every moves so quickly. It's satisfying until it slows down and you remember the game you actually wanted to play.

Fun but hard to stay with it long term. Starts of with a simple click and collect intro to the game but then as like all games it becomes harder and longer to get things done. This is fine as still new stuff opens up. The hardest issue now especially for new players is there are alliances in the states that are far too powerful. Alliances need cutting down rather than 1 or 2 ruling parties dominating the game and it becoming boring.

Fun at first, but ends up a huge money grab and requires lots of time. You will be tempted to spend money, trust me, as others level up. People spending $5k+ to power up... I spent $70. Packs are like $5 each. The support staff doesn't handle requests well and they don't give refunds even after requesting it. Lots of hidden menus, when topping up gems event to unlock new avatar frame, it is hidden that you cannot use $20 growth fund to trigger the gems to unlock. Purchases are deceptive.

The game's current monetization strategy lacks balance, as it allows paying players to easily dominate the leaderboards, leaving free-to-play players at a significant disadvantage. It would be beneficial to introduce more exclusive rewards and achievements for free-to-play players that cannot be simply obtained through financial means, thereby creating a more equitable and engaging gaming experience for all users.

Nothing at all like the ads. Very misleading advertising. It's a troop building war game that is played with hundreds of other people. It has the potential to be fun, except that it's totally dependent on the other people you find to form an "alliance" with. The game itself is needlessly complicated. The rules to the events go on and on and on and it becomes like a child's fever dream that is impossible to figure out without asking seasoned players, who may or may not care enough to explain it.

Super pay-to-win. After you hit a certain peak you can't do much or can even compare to the other players sinking hundreds of dollars on this game. Good as a time waster for maybe the first few hours. Engaging content and events but it only re-inforces the pay-to-win model. Events change daily but they really only change to entice players to waste money

This game has great potential but it became too much p2w. Full of ingame purchases, makes you progress super fast until you hit a wall where gameplay gets super slow and are """"""""""encouraged"""""""""" to pay Wouldn't recommend, its a slightly higher quality game for mobile and, like all the rest, is designed ro wring you like a dishcloth for your money.

What is the point of this game? The first few levels when you're building the huts have a sense of slight urgency to them, but once you get that and your furnace up to level 10, what's the point? There is no clear goal. And what is the point of the Alliances? I installed this game because the game you play in the ad intrigued me. But that game and this game are not the same. In gave, it's a blatant misrepresentation.

It's just another point and click game, where they hold your hand and you have a timer that waits for buildings to be built. No doubt as you progress, it'll be in the hours to upgrade buildings. There's no soul to this game, it's a useless money grab at free to play.

Game looks absolutely nothing like the ads. Super misleading. Just another micro-transaction heavy copy of other games with a differently storyline. ie., State of Survival, The Walking Dead, Vikings Rise, and several others. And like most, the gameplay does not match the video ads.

A big problem if you don't spend a fortune buying diamonds. The gameplay is good but the cost of buying a shield with diamonds is crazy. Players who have been playing for a long time spending lots attack you and wipe out everything you have built up. This happens on a daily basis and it is 4800 diamonds for a 24 hour shield that costs £5 a day. Reported to customer services who do nothing. Into would be better if attacking was only allowed on 2 days. A good programmer could easily alter this.

A bit lacking in some areas. There is no way to move freely within alliance territory, huge drag, tp's are costly. No officer chat room or alliance mail, the bulletin is the mail, which sucks, needs to be separate. P2W with 2 out of the 3 total mythic heroes being purchase only. Cartoony dumb hero design. But gameplay isn't bad, just don't expect to be top without spending thousands of dollars.

This game has been quite an interesting adventure. Once you get past the initial growth missions this becomes all about battle. Joining an alliance is a big piece of the experience. You can play the game F2P but it becomes quite hard to keep up unless you put some money into the game. Just be warned. You can still enjoy the experience but it a grind to get the needed materials for the chief/heroes/furnace

Cash grab game at its finest. The rewards you get are just crumbs. You don't get much for what you pay for folks. Expect to pay hundreds if not a couple thousand dollars of your hard earned money to get anywhere in this game. Otherwise, it'll take you months or years to progress without spending money. Don't bother with this game. The developers are greedy. I'll definitely be deleting this game.

NO ADS. You can buy stuff for the game but no commercials. My only complaint so far is learning the mechanics of the game. I do Google searches to try and figure out how chief stamina works but I still don't really get it. (Among other things). Is also like to be able to chose targets in the explore or arena fights. I've always enjoyed this sort of game where you upgrade aspects as events get harder but for now it's fun and is more of a 5 minutes here and there game.

Game requires teamwork for events and level gaps against other players being 10 plus levels causes disinterest. If you don't want to funnel money into packs, you can't accomplish anything. Events aren't clear or only help players who put money into packs. Finally I downloaded this based on continuous ads from another game where you collect wood in the ad demo however the play style is a war style game to attack other players and take over points on the map

Playing for about a week. Great game! No ads, if u want to spend money there are very cheap options, but spending is not necessary at all. There is Always something to do- no waiting for energy. Lots of free draws for heros. Gems and supplies reasonable to come by. My Alliance is friendly and helpful. Just feels like they've listened to all the complaints about other games and fixed those issues. 10/10!

Well after a while playing now all good until I had a problem when the game decided to buy a holiday pack for £4.99 without me knowing anything about it until I got a message saying thank you for purchasing...... contacted the customer support help via message and all I got back was a load computer generated BS nothing to do with my issue, so replied and got the same again seriously thinking about uninstaling the game now!!!!!!

It would be wonderful if the game could also be accessed through a laptop, such as Windows, as it would enable me to charge my phone while playing. I would prefer not to be required to purchase diamonds to advance in the queue or upgrade armies for construction and sending troops. If there is a long wait time, it would be more beneficial to improve the queue system rather than simply offering the option to purchase a queue for diamonds.

After levelling up your furnace the first couple of times this game really depends on your alliance, since multiplayer is so important. I enjoy lots of the events and have a fantastic alliance, and I have not needed to pay to do well! I obviously am not at the top of leaderboards, but I still have a fun time! Love the recent updates with the pets, island, and more ways to get more heroes! Also the dev team added a disable vibration option after I requested it, which is super appreciated. Thanks!

DO NOT SPEND MONEY ON THIS GAME!!! This game was fun, though not like the ad. In-game support sucks so don't waste your time on that. My other device broke so I switched to this one and all progress is gone. Support has no response. I was just talking to myself in there. There are other games of this type that will respond, be helpful and fix your problem. Play those ones.

Good graphics. However, it contains animal abuse in the exploration mini game. Not recommended for animal lovers. This game insisting to kill animal for fun. Very far from the advertisement. It's an interesting game idea but I personally find it to only be different from other similar games because of it's inclusion of an arctic apocalypse or something like that where you need to find other survivors and slowly build up your kingdom....other than that ...it's got good graphics and backstory for the heroes so I don't really have any complaints.

I played this game for about a year and a half. I was part of a great alliance and had a good time, but eventually the game just becomes a money grab. Of course you can play free to play, and that's all good, but it will be tough to progress as quickly as the alliance you join (if you're in an alliance with people who spend a fair amount of $). I worked hard to keep up pace and spent money myself, but ultimately felt like I could be spending that money elsewhere. Just depends on your play style

To be honest, I think the game is pretty good with everything, except when you get to a high enough level to the arena for the heroes. This is genuinely one of the better games I have played, despite the ads being false. I decided to try it for fun, but I was surprised to genuinely see no forced ads. One thing, there should be an offline mode. Overall, it's a great game with no ads, and great to kill time.

Really enjoying it and the amount of effort gone into making this game. There are so many elements, no ads! It's a really good game to play and you can just enjoy it instead of watching ads and spending money. It's the only game my partner and I can enjoy playing at the moment. Only downside is we can't friend each other cause we are indifferent states and you can't move states!

Awful, boring game. I only downloaded it becasue the ad for tjis game was equally fun and stupid but the actual "game" has nothing in common with the ad. Its a very addictive game where you can remain active all the day without waiting for any energy refills likei n many other games. You can put yopur brain at work by formulating strategies and ensuring your growth. The graphics are cool and makes your time spent worth it. I truly enjoy this game...The updates, events, UI all are very interesting and up to date.

I've been addicted to the game from the beginning. On my way to furnace lvl 28 and I have yet to spent money. No adds and a great online community. You do have to wait but I like this about the game. Also you get a lot of online rewards and you can get a lot of rewards in general because of the events. The events are also a lot of fun.

I really like the game for how new it is. If the developers stay with updating and maintaining this game, I could see it becoming really popular. Lol of things to do and you can pull an 8 to 10 hour session quick. It is addictive. And just for the record, I am not affiliated with Whiteout Survival. I'm just a player that is giving my review. Thanks

Great little game. It's a good time killer, it has fun combat mechanics that are more strategy based. The basebuilding is fun as you progress, and unlike a lot of other games that make you wait days on end near enough at the start of the game, this game really doesn't force that hand. The resources aren't impossible to get, the combat is very fair and well structured and overall I would say this is the perfect game for anyone looking for casual or more involved play. 5🌟game without question!

For once in my freaking life I found a strategy game that is consistent. The game progression doesnt die off and your able to be engaged. The alliance system is balanced and interactive mostly. Although, I do think the survivors are imbalanced, they get sick even if you max out all shelters and whatnot. Overall it's one of My fav games to play and was very surprised with how well it feels.

Not worth to play if you don't have money you will never win the game. I spend a lot of money get this graphics and never end to buy more pack. You can be spend 1000 and it will never be enough. It's a very fun game to help pass the time, you have to keep your survivors fed and warm So u naturally have to take care of things in the game And there's so much to do it keeps up with my racing brain minus how long it takes for the gathering of items and how long it takes 5 mins or longer for a hunt e.e but love the game so much love it

I love this game! The story basically everything. However, there are still a lot of things going around which will make you come back to it. This is not a time killer, this is addiction. Be very cautious of what you are downloading. Best part is you can progress through levels without spending money.

I had so much fun building my city, fighting little battles with my heros in my free time. It was a beautiful little escape. Then the endless wars came, while I was living my life. Everytime I would visit my little frozen city it would be on fire. It wasn't fun anymore. I didn't venture out and begin conflicts, I kept to myself. The constant attacks when I wasn't anywhere near the game just destroyed all the fun.

I've spent 418 continuous days (and counting) playing this game and as such I'll leave my honest review. This is a Play-To-Win game but one can still be competitive without spending a dime in-game. I'm CF5, though I won't be able to stand toe to toe to a whale CF8, combat wise, I'm able to withstand solo attacks from <CF7. Darn, I've reached limit

Great game. You are able to play just slower to grow without purchasing at a certain point. BUT, there are lots of ways to speed up the leveling without spending money too. More challenges or chances to grow without spending cash at all. The lack of ads is wonderful, and the interaction is fun. Lots to work with in this game.

This game is a lot of fun. There are events weekly, monthly, and seasonally as well as daily growth tasks. The play style is similar to ants and rok. That is part of the reason I enjoy it and also part of the reason I was willing to spend a little bit of money on this game to get some stuff a little faster.

Game is fun but it gets old real quick. Played it for 15 days less or more but as time went i lost interest.The main issue is the lack of gameplay mechanics. Edit 10/13/23 They actually listened! They added an ice fishing tournament coming soon. Surprisingly really good. The game mechanics is work really well. It has some learning curve, but the tutorial nailed it really well. No aggressive ads, and we can play it for free without even spent some money. If we want to pay for some item, the price is still reasonable. I'm definitely gonna spent money on this game just to praise the developer alone. Well done for all developers who develop this game. Can't wait for your next game guys.

I was pleasantly surprised by this game! ❄️ I usually hate ice-themed things, but this one is unique and creative. I gave an extra star for originality! I usually ignore game ads, but the reviews here convinced me to try it. I'm glad I did! 🎮 No annoying ads while playing is a HUGE plus. 👏👏 Why 4 stars instead of 5? Honesty! This game is awesome enough without needing fake ads. 😉

Not bad, it's pretty relaxed and progressive and ads aren't frustrating, you get a couple but it's not like other games, you can actually progress at a decent pace unhindered. Dislikes: -teleport prices should be less than 500 gems. - screen is very claustrophobic i keep wanting to zoom out more than it lets me.

Very fun. Not many issues, just two complaints. 1. This game needs to allow you to research and keep the building slot. 2. For the love of god, add a steel mill. It's incredibly tiresome to run out so quickly, and from what I've read, you need even more in the late game.

I played this game daily for almost a month. I built up my city as much as I could. I work,so I'm limited in available time to play. One day, someone attacked my settlement... about 100 times. There is no limit on how many times you can attack a settlement. I lost all the resources that took me days to build up.

Pros: NO ADS. Good graphics.... Cons: The games entertaining at first but it's been done a million times. Not much unique about it. Absolutely false advertisement. Game is nothing like the ads that pop up in other games. It's a solid game, I don't understand why it has to stoop to these levels.

Very good game overall. However....it is nothing like the ads. This is a military survival game. it does take a lot of time to advance far enough to be competitive. Many players simply buy their way up. One secret is to join a top 20 alliance in your state where you will not be attacked very much. Otherwise you may be attacked so often after the 5 day newbie phase that the game can be frustrating very quickly.

ok so i'm 5 months in now, I use to play 1st thing in the morning but quite bored now as it's really hard to play as upgrades are silly long to do without paying money, I totally get that game developers need to make money, but wow, makes me wish I was one for the amount they want for somthing thats virtual?! Patience is needed to play this game, but i'm running out.. I won't pay to play sorry, on a plus, there are no intrusive ads tbf 👌

I've been playing this game for a few months and am still enjoying it, primarily because I'm in a great alliance as well as the regular addition of new content which keeps it fresh even when it takes ages to upgrade everything now. It's cool. Not like ad advertised AT all. It's a group game, very detailed I can't say I'm not enjoying it a little but I don't usually play games that you have to rely on others and make allies etc and battle. Very intricate. Good for people who like to seriously game on a daily basis.

This game is really good I highly recommend this for time killing but the problem with this is that to be one of the best players in the state then you have to pay alot of money and the time it takes for the building to finish especially the embassy and furnace is too long reduce the time it takes for them to upgrade you are also false advertising with the ads so please change them

I'm not even gonna lie the ads of this came make it seem like a rip off of rise of kingdoms. But I was finally convinced to download it and I can def say its actually a bit different. Not the game I was expecting, but far be it for me to expect a game to match it's ads nowadays. This could be enjoyable to someone, but it just isn't for me. The graphics are good, the voice acting is... there.. and the gameplay is alright. Just not my style of game, but I could see someone else liking it. Give it a shot I guess, don't take this as an overtly negative review, it isn't one star cuz this isn't a one star game. Is it a 5 star game? Not to me, but give it a shot and see if it is 4 u

The game is highly addictive and a textbook example of "pay to play." You could end up spending tens or even hundreds of dollars per month, only to still lag behind the whales on your server (during last SvS we calculated in World Chat that an opponent has invested between $20-25k). Since gameplay heavily relies on social interactions with other players, you may find yourself unwillingly spending more and more just to keep up with your alliance—especially during special events. Stay away!!!

The game is completely different in appearance and mechanics from the advertisements. It's shown as you controlling a player, but it's actually a city builder. It's not a terrible game, but it's misleading and not why I'm here. I have plenty of high quality city builders on my PC.

Almost everything in the advertisments and promo art is fake, do not waste your time if you want to play whatever it is advertising. Other than that, solid game (5/5 if not for the blatant false advertising) although it seems to follow a very specific formula (basically a retexture) of a multitude of other games.

There's in app purchases that make your life easier but they're not necessary to play the game. There's no ads, just a pop up or two about content you could purchase. This is the perfect mobile game to scratch that video game itch without dedicating a large chunk of your time. Having said that, it's quite hard to put down sometimes. I enjoy the game. There's a social aspect that I enjoy. It updates frequently so you're constantly interacting with different content. I definitely recommend.

Boring app compared to others, limited event after you have completed the daily event no more to accomplish, limited options to upgrade, very expensive packages, limited source of speed up item in the store, very low rewards in every event, too many cons that need to be considered l, lot of similar games like this and it seems this game is more boring than other game . .
